request.description:
Starts a password reset by emailing either a 6-digit OTP or a magic link; always returns the same 200 message (anti-enumeration).

**Auth:** False | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** MaxBodyBytes(1 MiB) (auth group .Use, routes.go:113); RateLimitAuth(LoginPer15Min) (auth group .Use, routes.go:110/114; one per-IP bucket shared by all /api/v1/auth/* routes); CSRFProtection (global, main.go:3282) - path exempt
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/user_auth_handler.go:1270 UserAuthHandler.ForgotPassword`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "email": "string<email>",
  "method": "string enum: otp|magic_link"
}
```
**Required:** email, method
**Validation:**
- email trimmed in handler, then required,email,max=255 (e.g. 'email must be a valid email address')
- method: required,oneof=otp magic_link ('method must be one of: otp magic_link')
- No reCAPTCHA

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "message": "string"
  },
  "meta": {
    "timestamp": "string<date-time>",
    "request_id": "string"
  }
}
```
_data.message always "If this email is registered, you will receive password reset instructions shortly." - also when the per-email throttle is hit, the email is unknown, the account is not status=active, or the service errors (errors are only logged). No Set-Cookie. Same in dev and production._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid request body` - JSON bind fails
- 400: `<formatValidationErrors output>` - validation fails
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - per-IP auth limiter exceeded; body also has "retry_after": "<Go duration string>"
- 413: `Request body too large` - Content-Length header > 1 MiB (auth group MaxBodyBytes)

**Side effects:** Email lower-cased. Per-email throttle: counts password_reset_sessions rows for that email created within RATE_LIMIT_PASSWORD_RESET_WINDOW_MIN (default 60) and silently skips when >= RATE_LIMIT_PASSWORD_RESET_MAX (code default 3; Backend/.env 100000). For an existing active user: method=otp -> password_reset_sessions row (SHA-256 of a crypto-random 6-digit OTP, expires 10 min) + async OTP email; method=magic_link -> PASETO password-reset token (1h) stored hashed in password_reset_sessions (expires 1h) + async email with <FRONTEND_URL>/reset-password?token=<url-escaped token>. Earlier sessions are not invalidated.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- new: added 2026-10-06 as a necessary login endpoint

**Listed in:** login: `POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password` (added 2026-10-06: necessary login/sign-up endpoint (not in the md lists; called by LandingPage auth screens))

request.description:
Revokes the live session matched by the refresh token (cookie, else JSON body) and the session matched by the access token (cookie, else Bearer header), always clears both auth cookies, records a logout event for an authenticated caller, and answers 200 - or 401 when the caller proved no live session at all.

**Auth:** optional | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** MaxBodyBytes(1MiB) [auth group .Use]; RateLimitAuth(RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_PER_15MIN per IP / 15 min) [auth group .Use]; CSRFProtection (global app.Use, main.go:3282) - enforced except the native skip (csrf.go:113-115); ClientContextMiddleware (global app.Use, main.go:3291) - client header checks, see common.client_headers; OptionalAuthMiddleware (route variadic tail, routes.go:137-138; runs before the handler) - sets Locals user_id/user_role/claims when the access token (access_token cookie, else 'Authorization: Bearer' when ENVIRONMENT != 'production' or X-App-Platform ios|android) passes PASETO verify + revocation + active-session checks; never rejects
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/user_auth_handler.go:1481 UserAuthHandler.Logout`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "refresh_token": "string (optional; read only when the refresh_token cookie is absent - the native app sends it here)"
}
```
**Validation:**
- Body optional; bind errors are ignored

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "message": "string ('Logged out successfully')"
  },
  "meta": {
    "timestamp": "string (RFC3339)",
    "request_id": "string"
  }
}
```
Headers: {"Set-Cookie": ["access_token=; Max-Age=-1 (expire); Path=/; Domain=$COOKIE_DOMAIN; HttpOnly; Secure when ENVIRONMENT != 'development'; SameSite=Lax", "refresh_token=; Max-Age=-1 (expire); Path=/api/v1/auth; Domain=$COOKIE_DOMAIN; HttpOnly; Secure when ENVIRONMENT != 'development'; SameSite=Lax"]}
_Returned when OptionalAuthMiddleware identified the caller (valid access token, active non-revoked session) OR at least one revocation succeeded: refresh token of a live session (row exists, revoked_at NULL, expires_at in the future) or access token whose user_sessions row still has revoked_at NULL. A failed revocation is only logged. The cookie-clearing Set-Cookie headers are emitted for every caller, native included (handler is not native-aware)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 401: `Authentication required` - OptionalAuthMiddleware set no user_id AND neither revocation succeeded (no tokens sent; unknown, already-revoked or expired refresh token; access token with no un-revoked session row). Body is {success:false, error, meta{timestamp, request_id}}. The cookie-clearing Set-Cookie headers are still sent.
- 403: `CSRF token missing | CSRF token mismatch` - path not CSRF-exempt: X-CSRF-Token header must equal csrf_token cookie (dev: CSRF_STATIC_TOKEN also accepted) - not raised when the native skip applies (X-App-Platform ios|android + no access_token/refresh_token cookie)
- 413: `Request body too large` - Content-Length > 1 MiB (auth group MaxBodyBytes)
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - per-IP RateLimitAuth exceeded; body also has retry_after (Go duration string); X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset and Retry-After headers are set on every response

**Side effects:** Refresh token (cookie, else body): UPDATE user_sessions SET revoked_at=now(), updated_at=NOW() WHERE id = the session found by refresh_token_hash - only when that session is live (revoked_at NULL and expires_at > now); an already-revoked or expired session is no longer re-stamped. Access token (cookie, else Bearer): UPDATE user_sessions SET revoked_at, updated_at WHERE access_token_hash = hash AND revoked_at IS NULL. Always Set-Cookie clears access_token and refresh_token (also on the 401). When OptionalAuthMiddleware authenticated the caller and the DB role is seeker|solver|admin: INSERT logout_events (id UUIDv7, user_id, user_type=role, logout_type='user_action', ip_address, user_agent, logout_at, created_at; session_id/reason NULL); insert errors are only logged. No logout event when the caller proved a session only via the refresh token.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- 2026-10-09: CSRF is no longer always enforced: CSRFProtection skips the check for native requests - X-App-Platform ios|android (trimmed, case-insensitive) carrying neither an access_token nor a refresh_token cookie (csrf.go:113-115). Browsers, and any request that carries an auth cookie, still need X-CSRF-Token == csrf_token cookie. Native logout = refresh_token in JSON body + optional 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>', no CSRF token; handler token sources unchanged (refresh: cookie else body; access: cookie else Bearer).
- 2026-10-09 (21:10): the native CSRF skip no longer requires an 'Authorization: Bearer' header (csrf.go:113): X-App-Platform ios|android with no access_token/refresh_token cookie is enough, so a logged-out app call needs no CSRF token. The earlier rule (ios|android + any non-empty Bearer string + no auth cookies) is gone; the Authorization header plays no part in the CSRF decision.
- 2026-10-09 (21:10): OptionalAuthMiddleware now runs on this route (routes.go:137-138: handler 2nd, middleware in the variadic tail). Previously AuthMiddleware sat in Fiber v3's 2nd slot and never ran, so the endpoint was unauthenticated.
- 2026-10-09 (21:10): new 401 {success:false, error:'Authentication required', meta} when OptionalAuthMiddleware found no valid caller AND neither revocation succeeded (user_auth_handler.go:1499-1553); previously the endpoint always answered 200. Auth cookies are cleared on the 401 too.
- 2026-10-09 (21:10): a logout_events row is now written (user_type = DB role, logout_type 'user_action') whenever OptionalAuthMiddleware authenticated the caller; before, user_id was never set and no event was recorded.
- 2026-10-09 (21:10): user_login_service.go:647-651 - RevokeSessionByRefreshToken now returns an error for a session that is already revoked or expired instead of re-stamping revoked_at, so a stale refresh token neither counts as proof of a live session nor moves revoked_at.

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/auth/logout` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:2); solver: `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` (docs/audit/solver_endpoints.md:8)

request.description:
Finishes a first-time social signup after the role picker: reads the signed pending-signup token from the HttpOnly oauth_signup cookie, creates (or links) the account for the chosen role, issues a session and sets auth cookies.

**Auth:** False | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** MaxBodyBytes(1 MiB) (auth group .Use at routes.go:113 - matches raw prefix /api/v1/auth, so it also gates /api/v1/auth/oauth/*); RateLimitAuth(LoginPer15Min) (auth group .Use routes.go:114, shared /auth bucket); RateLimitAuth(LoginPer15Min) (oauthGroup .Use main.go:3351 - a second, separate per-IP bucket); CSRFProtection (global, main.go:3279) - path contains /auth/oauth/ so exempt; MaxBodyBytes(1 MiB) passed in the 2nd positional slot at main.go:3356 does NOT run (Fiber v3 ordering trap); the auth-group MaxBodyBytes above covers it
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/oauth_handler.go:336 OAuthHandler.CompleteSignup`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "role": "string enum: seeker|solver",
  "eula_accepted": "boolean"
}
```
**Required:** role
**Validation:**
- No validator tags; role lower-cased+trimmed, must be seeker or solver (else ErrOAuthRoleRequired)
- eula_accepted must be true to CREATE a new account (ErrOAuthEULARequired); not needed if the identity resolves to an existing active verified account (linked instead)
- Required cookie: oauth_signup (HttpOnly, Path=/api/v1/auth/oauth, set by GET /:provider/callback when the identity is unknown) - HMAC-SHA256-signed (OAUTH_STATE_SECRET) pending-signup payload, valid 30 min (oauthPendingSignupTTL), must carry provider/provider_user_id/email; rejected if that provider identity is already linked (single use)
- The cookie is read then cleared on every request (one attempt per provider round-trip), before role/eula are checked
- No reCAPTCHA (provider round-trip replaces it)

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "user_id": "string<uuid>",
    "role": "string enum: seeker|solver",
    "redirect_url": "string<url>"
  },
  "meta": {
    "timestamp": "string<date-time>",
    "request_id": "string"
  }
}
```
_redirect_url = app origin for the user's role (seeker: FRONTEND seeker URL, solver: OAuth SolverURL; falls back to landing FRONTEND_URL when unset) with trailing '/' trimmed + the in-app redirect path carried in the token. role is the resolved user's role (an existing linked account keeps its own role, not the requested one). Tokens are NOT in the body. Set-Cookie: access_token (HttpOnly, Path=/, Max-Age=3600 [AccessTokenExpiry 1h], SameSite=Lax, Secure outside development, Domain=COOKIE_DOMAIN); refresh_token (HttpOnly, Path=/api/v1/auth, Max-Age=2592000 [30 days], SameSite=Lax, Secure outside development); oauth_signup cleared (Max-Age=-1, Path=/api/v1/auth/oauth). Session is 'remember me' (refresh expiry RefreshTokenExpiryRemember)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid request body` - JSON bind fails (oauth_signup cookie is NOT cleared in this case - bind happens first)
- 400: `Your sign-in session expired, please try again` - oauth_signup cookie missing/blank, bad signature, older than 30 min, missing fields, or provider identity already linked (replay)
- 400: `Choose whether you are joining as a seeker or a solver, then try again` - role not seeker|solver
- 400: `You must accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to create an account` - new account would be created and eula_accepted is false
- 403: `This account is not available for sign-in` - an account with the same email exists but is not active or not email-verified, or it already has a different link for this provider, or resolved user status is not active
- 403: `This account has been banned` - resolved user status banned
- 400: `Sign-in failed, please try again` - any other error (DB/tx failure, session creation failure)
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - per-IP auth limiter exceeded; body also has "retry_after": "<Go duration string>"
- 413: `Request body too large` - Content-Length header > 1 MiB (auth group MaxBodyBytes)

**Side effects:** Case existing active+verified user with same email: inserts user_oauth_accounts link. Case new: ONE transaction - users row (UUIDv7, password_hash NULL, full_name from provider name/username/email local part), eula_acceptances (v1.0, IP, UA), users.signup_referral_code if the token carried a referral, user_oauth_accounts link, flip email_verified=true/status=active, role profile (seeker or solver rows as in verify-email); rolled back entirely on any failure. Then issueSession: user_sessions row (hashed access+refresh tokens, IP, UA) and eviction of older sessions beyond MaxConcurrentSessions.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- new: added 2026-10-06 as a necessary login endpoint

**Listed in:** login: `POST /api/v1/auth/oauth/complete-signup` (added 2026-10-06: necessary login/sign-up endpoint (not in the md lists; called by LandingPage auth screens))

request.description:
Backup-code login: validates a single-use recovery backup code for the email, consumes it atomically, revokes all the user's sessions, signs the user in (standard 7-day refresh, no remember-me), sets auth cookies and emails a recovery notice.

**Auth:** False | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** MaxBodyBytes(1MB, Content-Length pre-check; /auth group .Use); RateLimitAuth(RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_PER_15MIN per 15 min, keyed by client IP only; ONE limiter instance shared by every /api/v1/auth/* route incl. /login, /register, /refresh; /auth group .Use); CSRFProtection (global app.Use; path not exempt) - SKIPPED for native requests (X-App-Platform ios|android) carrying no access_token/refresh_token cookie (csrf.go:113-115); ClientContextMiddleware (global app.Use, main.go:3291) - client header checks, see common.client_headers
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/user_auth_handler.go:1592 UserAuthHandler.RecoverAccount`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "email": "string<email>",
  "backup_code": "string"
}
```
**Required:** email, backup_code
**Validation:**
- email: TrimSpace in handler, then required,email,max=255; lower-cased in service
- backup_code: required only (no length/format check); hashed as hex(SHA-512(backup_code + BACKUP_CODE_SALT)) exactly as sent -- no trim/upper-casing, so it must match the issued code verbatim. Codes from GenerateRecoveryBackupCode are 16 chars [A-Z0-9]
- validation failure messages: 'email ...', 'backupcode is required' (struct field name lower-cased), joined by '; '

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "message": "string",
    "user_id": "string<uuid>",
    "role": "string enum: seeker|solver|admin"
  },
  "meta": {
    "timestamp": "string",
    "request_id": "string"
  }
}
```
_Web/default variant, used when X-App-Platform is absent or not ios|android and not (ENVIRONMENT=='development' AND SHOW_TOKENS_IN_RESPONSE=='true'): message='Signed in with backup code'. Set-Cookie: access_token=<PASETO v4 public>; Path=/; Max-Age=3600 (usecases.AccessTokenExpiry 1h); HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure only when ENVIRONMENT!=development; Domain=COOKIE_DOMAIN if set. Set-Cookie: refresh_token=<PASETO>; Path=/api/v1/auth; Max-Age=604800 (7d, always; remember-me never honoured); HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure only when ENVIRONMENT!=development; Domain=COOKIE_DOMAIN if set._

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "access_token": "string (omitempty)",
    "refresh_token": "string (omitempty)",
    "user_id": "string<uuid>",
    "role": "string enum: seeker|solver|admin",
    "access_token_expires_in": "integer (omitempty)",
    "refresh_token_expires_in": "integer (omitempty)",
    "expires_in": "integer (omitempty)",
    "token_type": "string (omitempty)",
    "remember_me_duration": "integer (omitempty)",
    "mfa_required": "boolean (omitempty)",
    "mfa_session_token": "string (omitempty)",
    "mfa_method": "string (omitempty)"
  },
  "meta": {
    "timestamp": "string",
    "request_id": "string"
  }
}
```
_Web + dev variant (X-App-Platform absent or not ios|android): Dev variant when ENVIRONMENT=='development' AND SHOW_TOKENS_IN_RESPONSE=='true': raw LoginResponse with access_token, refresh_token, refresh_token_expires_in=604800, remember_me_duration=7, token_type='Bearer', expires_in/access_token_expires_in=3600. Same cookies._

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "access_token": "string (omitempty)",
    "refresh_token": "string (omitempty)",
    "user_id": "string<uuid>",
    "role": "string enum: seeker|solver|admin",
    "access_token_expires_in": "integer (omitempty)",
    "refresh_token_expires_in": "integer (omitempty)",
    "expires_in": "integer (omitempty)",
    "token_type": "string (omitempty)",
    "remember_me_duration": "integer (omitempty)",
    "mfa_required": "boolean (omitempty)",
    "mfa_session_token": "string (omitempty)",
    "mfa_method": "string (omitempty)"
  },
  "meta": {
    "timestamp": "string",
    "request_id": "string"
  }
}
```
Headers: {"Set-Cookie": "none (no access_token / refresh_token cookies are set for native clients)"}
_Native variant: X-App-Platform is ios or android (trimmed, case-insensitive), in ANY environment. data is the raw domain.LoginResponse with access_token, refresh_token, user_id, role, access_token_expires_in=3600, refresh_token_expires_in=604800 (7d, remember-me never honoured), remember_me_duration=7, expires_in=3600, token_type='Bearer'; mfa_* omitted. No auth cookies are set. The app must store the pair and send 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>' (accepted by AuthMiddleware in production only with X-App-Platform ios|android) and refresh via POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with refresh_token in the JSON body._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 401: `Account not found` - no user with that email (ErrInvalidCredentials). NOT uniform with the bad-code case -> account-enumeration oracle
- 401: `Invalid backup code` - no backup_codes row for (user_id, hash), or code expired
- 401: `Backup code has already been used` - matching code row has is_used=true
- 400: `Email not verified. Please verify your email first` - valid code but email_verified=false (checked before consuming, code not burned)
- 400: `Account has been banned` - valid code but status=banned
- 400: `Account is inactive` - valid code but status != active
- 400: `Account recovery failed` - other errors, incl. losing a concurrent-redeem race (MarkBackupCodeUsed affects 0 rows), DB lookup errors, issueSession failure
- 400: `<validation messages joined by '; '>` - validation failure
- 413: `Request body too large` - Content-Length > 1048576 (auth group MaxBodyBytes)
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - per-IP auth-group limiter exceeded (body also has retry_after: string Go duration); headers X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset + Retry-After are set on every response
- 400: `Invalid request body` - body is not valid JSON / field types mismatch
- 403: `CSRF token missing | CSRF token mismatch` - path not CSRF-exempt: X-CSRF-Token header must equal csrf_token cookie (dev: CSRF_STATIC_TOKEN also accepted) - not raised when the native skip applies (X-App-Platform ios|android + no access_token/refresh_token cookie)

**Side effects:** Every failure and the success record a login_attempts row (reason 'backup_code: user not found|invalid code|code already used|code expired|<gate reason>' / success 'backup_code'). No per-account attempt counter or lockout on this path; only the per-IP auth-group limiter throttles guessing. On success: backup_codes.is_used=true, used_at=now via UPDATE ... WHERE id=$2 AND is_used=false (atomic single-use); RevokeAllUserSessions(user) (failure only logged); then issueSession (shared by every login method): mints PASETO access token (1h) + refresh token (always 7d (remember_me forced false)), inserts user_sessions row (refresh/access token hashes, IP, User-Agent, expires_at), then revokes older active sessions beyond MaxConcurrentSessions=1 (single-device: every other session of the user is revoked), updates users last_login, async UpdateLoginStreak. Sends SendAccountRecoveryEmail(user.Email, IP, timestamp) via the bounded security-notice pool (async, sync fallback when saturated). No recaptcha.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live runs are limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- new: added 2026-10-09 (alternate login method)
- 2026-10-09: CSRF is no longer always enforced: CSRFProtection skips the check for native requests - X-App-Platform ios|android (trimmed, case-insensitive) carrying neither an access_token nor a refresh_token cookie (csrf.go:113-115). Browsers, and any request that carries an auth cookie, still need X-CSRF-Token == csrf_token cookie.
- 2026-10-09: native-app mode (user_auth_handler.go:1671-1675,1681): when X-App-Platform is ios|android the handler sets NO access_token/refresh_token cookies and always returns the raw domain.LoginResponse (access_token, refresh_token, expiry fields, token_type 'Bearer') in data, in every ENVIRONMENT (tokensInBody(native), :32-34). Web clients (header absent/web) are unchanged: cookies + {message,user_id,role}, or cookies + raw tokens when ENVIRONMENT=development AND SHOW_TOKENS_IN_RESPONSE=true.
- 2026-10-09 (21:10): the native CSRF skip no longer requires an 'Authorization: Bearer' header (csrf.go:113): X-App-Platform ios|android with no access_token/refresh_token cookie is enough, so a logged-out app call needs no CSRF token. The earlier rule (ios|android + any non-empty Bearer string + no auth cookies) is gone; the Authorization header plays no part in the CSRF decision.

```
Headers: {"Set-Cookie": "none (rotated pair is not written to cookies)"}
_Native variant (domain.RefreshTokenResponse): refresh_token supplied in the JSON body (no refresh_token cookie) AND X-App-Platform ios|android, in ANY environment. access_token + rotated refresh_token, expires_in=3600, refresh_token_expires_in=<remaining session seconds>, token_type='Bearer'._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Refresh token required` - no cookie and no body token (body includes meta)
- 401: `Session expired. Please login again` - unknown or expired refresh token, user not active, or any other service/DB error; auth cookies cleared (Set-Cookie Max-Age=-1) (cookie-clearing Set-Cookie headers are emitted for native callers too)
- 401: `Session has been revoked. Please login again` - session.revoked_at set; cookies cleared (cookie-clearing Set-Cookie headers are emitted for native callers too)
- 403: `Security alert: refresh token reuse detected. All sessions have been revoked. Please login again` - token matches a previously rotated refresh-token hash; every session of that user is revoked; cookies cleared (cookie-clearing Set-Cookie headers are emitted for native callers too)
- 413: `Request body too large` - Content-Length > 1 MiB (auth group MaxBodyBytes)
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - per-IP RateLimitAuth exceeded; body also has retry_after (Go duration string); X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset and Retry-After headers are set on every response

**Side effects:** UPDATE user_sessions (new access + refresh token hashes; previous refresh hash kept for reuse detection). Reuse detection: revokes all sessions of the user. Failure: Set-Cookie clears access_token and refresh_token.

request.description:
Creates a pending (unverified) seeker or solver account with EULA record, optional parked referral code and 5 backup codes, then emails a verification magic link; answers every accepted outcome (new or already-registered address) with one identical 201 body.

**Auth:** False | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** MaxBodyBytes(1 MiB) (auth group .Use, routes.go:113); RateLimitAuth(LoginPer15Min) (auth group .Use, routes.go:110/114; one per-IP bucket shared by all /api/v1/auth/* routes); CSRFProtection (global, main.go:3282) - path exempt
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/user_auth_handler.go:77 UserAuthHandler.RegisterUser`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "full_name": "string",
  "email": "string<email>",
  "password": "string",
  "confirm_password": "string",
  "role": "string enum: seeker|solver",
  "referral_code": "string | null (omitempty)",
  "eula_accepted": "boolean",
  "recaptcha_token": "string"
}
```
**Required:** full_name, email, password, confirm_password, role, eula_accepted, recaptcha_token
**Validation:**
- full_name: required,min=2,max=100
- email: required,email,max=255
- password: required,min=12,max=128
- confirm_password: required,eqfield=Password
- role: required,oneof=seeker solver
- referral_code: omitempty,min=5,max=20 (service trims + upper-cases it)
- eula_accepted: required,eq=true
- recaptcha_token: required
- Validator messages come from formatValidationErrors using the Go struct field name lower-cased, joined by '; ' (e.g. 'fullname is required', 'password must be at least 12 characters', 'role must be one of: seeker solver', 'confirmpassword is invalid' for eqfield, 'eulaaccepted is required' when false, 'recaptchatoken is required')
- Service: email normalised lower(trim); reCAPTCHA verified against Google siteverify with RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY and score threshold 0.5 (hard-coded in service); no code-level dev bypass. Backend/.env uses Google's public test secret (6LeIxAcTAAAAAGG-...), which makes siteverify succeed for ANY non-empty token, so in this dev env any non-empty recaptcha_token (e.g. 'dev-test') passes; in production a real token is required.
- Service password policy (utils.ValidatePassword): 12..128 chars, >=1 uppercase, >=1 lowercase, >=1 digit, >=1 special, must not contain the email, HIBP k-anonymity breach check (fails open if HIBP unreachable, 3s timeout)
- Referral code (if non-blank): must exist, not expired, usage count < MaxReferralUsages
- Password + referral validated BEFORE the existence lookup, and password is Argon2id-hashed before it, so errors/timing do not depend on whether the address exists

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "message": "string"
  },
  "meta": {
    "timestamp": "string<date-time>",
    "request_id": "string"
  }
}
```
_data.message is always "If this email is valid, you will receive a verification link shortly." - returned both for a newly created account and when the address already exists in users (any role, verified or not; ErrEmailAlreadyExists mapped to the same 201). No user_id/status/tokens returned, no Set-Cookie (except csrf_token is never set on POST). Same body in dev and production._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid request body` - JSON bind fails
- 400: `<formatValidationErrors output>` - struct validation fails (see validation)
- 400: `Passwords do not match` - password != confirm_password (service defence-in-depth; normally caught by eqfield)
- 400: `You must accept the EULA terms and conditions to proceed` - eula_accepted false (defence-in-depth; normally caught by validator)
- 400: `reCAPTCHA verification failed. Please try again` - siteverify call fails, success=false, or v3 score < 0.5
- 400: `<specific password rule, first letter capitalised> e.g. "Password must contain at least one uppercase letter" / "Password must not contain email address"` - utils.ValidatePassword rule fails (ErrPasswordTooWeak wraps the rule text)
- 400: `This password has been compromised in previous data breaches. Please choose a different password` - HIBP reports password breached
- 400: `Invalid referral code` - referral code not found
- 400: `Referral code has expired` - referral expires_at passed
- 400: `This referral code has already been used the maximum number of times` - usage count >= MaxReferralUsages
- 500: `Registration failed. Please try again later` - any other service error (referral lookup DB error, hash failure, tx/insert failure); returned by the handler's own JSON, not the global handler
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - per-IP auth limiter exceeded; body also has "retry_after": "<Go duration string>"
- 413: `Request body too large` - Content-Length header > 1 MiB (auth group MaxBodyBytes)

**Side effects:** If the address is new: one transaction inserts users (UUIDv7, status=pending, email_verified=false, full_name trimmed), eula_acceptances (version '1.0', IP, User-Agent), sets users.signup_referral_code when a valid referral was given, 5 backup_codes (1-year expiry), and an email_verification_tokens row (SHA-256 of a PASETO v4 token, expiry EMAIL_VERIFICATION_TOKEN_EXPIRY, default/.env 15m); after commit a welcome email with <FRONTEND_URL>/verify-email?token=<token> and all 5 backup codes is sent asynchronously (bounded goroutine, sync fallback). If the address exists, unverified and same role: ResendVerificationEmail is triggered for the existing owner (60s per-account cooldown); nothing is deleted or recreated. Existing verified/other-role address: nothing written. Role profile (seeker/solver row) is NOT created here - only at verify-email.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

- new: added 2026-10-06 as a necessary login endpoint

**Listed in:** login: `POST /api/v1/auth/register` (added 2026-10-06: necessary login/sign-up endpoint (not in the md lists; called by LandingPage auth screens))

request.description:
Step 1 of magic-link login: for an existing active account, mints a 24h PASETO magic-link token, stores its hash and emails a {FRONTEND_URL}/verify-magic-link?token=... link; replies 200 for unknown/inactive emails too, but 429 when the per-email cap is hit.

**Auth:** False | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** MaxBodyBytes(1MB, Content-Length pre-check; /auth group .Use); RateLimitAuth(RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_PER_15MIN per 15 min, keyed by client IP only; ONE limiter instance shared by every /api/v1/auth/* route incl. /login, /register, /refresh; /auth group .Use); CSRFProtection (global app.Use; path not exempt) - SKIPPED for native requests (X-App-Platform ios|android) carrying no access_token/refresh_token cookie (csrf.go:113-115); ClientContextMiddleware (global app.Use, main.go:3291) - client header checks, see common.client_headers
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/user_auth_handler.go:966 UserAuthHandler.RequestMagicLink`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "email": "string<email>"
}
```

Step 1 of OTP login: if the email belongs to a verified, active account (and the per-email request cap is not hit), generates a 6-digit OTP, supersedes any live OTP and emails the code; always answers with the same generic 200.

**Auth:** False | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** MaxBodyBytes(1MB, Content-Length pre-check; /auth group .Use); RateLimitAuth(RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_PER_15MIN per 15 min, keyed by client IP only; ONE limiter instance shared by every /api/v1/auth/* route incl. /login, /register, /refresh; /auth group .Use); CSRFProtection (global app.Use; path not exempt) - SKIPPED for native requests (X-App-Platform ios|android) carrying no access_token/refresh_token cookie (csrf.go:113-115); ClientContextMiddleware (global app.Use, main.go:3291) - client header checks, see common.client_headers

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "email": "string<email>"
}
```
**Required:** email
**Validation:**
- email: strings.TrimSpace in handler, then validate required,email,max=255
- validation failure -> 400 with messages joined by '; ' e.g. 'email is required', 'email must be a valid email address', 'email must not exceed 255 characters'
- service lower-cases the email before rate-limit count and lookup

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "message": "string"
  },
  "meta": {
    "timestamp": "string",
    "request_id": "string"
  }
}
```
_data.message is always 'If this email is registered, you will receive an OTP shortly.' -- returned identically on success AND on every service error (unknown email, unverified email, non-active status, per-email rate limit ErrRateLimitExceeded, DB/OTP-generation failures). }

request.description:
Consumes a registration email-verification token: marks it used, activates the user (email_verified=true, status=active) and creates the seeker/solver profile; if that fails, falls back to treating the token as a solver email-change token.

**Auth:** False | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** MaxBodyBytes(1 MiB) (auth group .Use, routes.go:113); RateLimitAuth(LoginPer15Min) (auth group .Use, routes.go:110/114; one per-IP bucket shared by all /api/v1/auth/* routes); CSRFProtection (global, main.go:3282) - path exempt
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/user_auth_handler.go:283 UserAuthHandler.VerifyEmail`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "token": "string"
}
```
**Required:** token
**Validation:**
- token: required (message 'token is required')
- token must be a valid PASETO v4 public email-verification token (issuer synap-mentor, not expired) whose SHA-256 hash exists in email_verification_tokens, is_used=false and expires_at in the future

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "message": "string",
    "email": "string<email>"
  },
  "meta": {
    "timestamp": "string<date-time>",
    "request_id": "string"
  }
}
```
_Fresh verification: message "Email verified successfully. Your account is now active.". If the user was already verified (token still unused): message "Email already verified" (token is NOT marked used). No Set-Cookie, no session/tokens issued - the user must log in afterwards._

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "message": "string"
  },
  "meta": {
    "timestamp": "string<date-time>",
    "request_id": "string"
  }
}
```
_Fallback path: primary verification failed but SolverProfileService.VerifyEmailChange accepted the token as a solver email-change token -> message "Email changed successfully" (only stores solvers.new_email)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid request body` - JSON bind fails
- 400: `token is required` - token empty/missing
- 400: `This verification link has already been used` - DB token row is_used=true (and email-change fallback also failed)
- 400: `This verification link has expired. Please request a new one` - PASETO expired (utils.ErrTokenExpired 'token has expired') or DB expires_at passed
- 400: `Verification token not found. Please register again` - PASETO valid but no DB row for its hash
- 500: `Account verification succeeded but profile creation failed. Please contact support.` - role profile creation failed (transaction rolled back, so the account is actually NOT verified)
- 400: `Invalid or expired verification token` - any other failure (bad signature, account not found, tx errors)

Step 2 of magic-link login: verifies the PASETO magic-link token and its stored row (not expired, not used), re-checks the account gate, marks the link used and signs the user in via issueSession; web clients get auth cookies (body = SecureLoginResponse, or raw tokens when ENVIRONMENT=development and SHOW_TOKENS_IN_RESPONSE=true), the native app (X-App-Platform ios|android) gets the tokens in the body and no cookies.

**Auth:** False | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** MaxBodyBytes(1MB, Content-Length pre-check; /auth group .Use); RateLimitAuth(RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_PER_15MIN per 15 min, keyed by client IP only; ONE limiter instance shared by every /api/v1/auth/* route incl. /login, /register, /refresh; /auth group .Use); CSRFProtection (global app.Use; path not exempt) - SKIPPED for native requests (X-App-Platform ios|android) carrying no access_token/refresh_token cookie (csrf.go:113-115); ClientContextMiddleware (global app.Use, main.go:3291) - client header checks, see common.client_headers
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/user_auth_handler.go:1047 UserAuthHandler.VerifyMagicLink`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "token": "string",
  "remember_me": "boolean"
}
```
**Required:** token
**Validation:**
- token: required (no length/format tag; must verify as PASETO v4 public with audience and purpose 'magic-link-login')
- remember_me: optional bool, default false
- validation failure -> 400 'token is required'

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "message": "string",
    "user_id": "string<uuid>",
    "role": "string enum: seeker|solver|admin",
    "expires_in": "integer",

Set-Cookie: access_token=<PASETO v4 public>; Path=/; Max-Age=3600 (usecases.AccessTokenExpiry 1h); HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure only when ENVIRONMENT!=development; Domain=COOKIE_DOMAIN if set. Set-Cookie: refresh_token=<PASETO>; Path=/api/v1/auth; Max-Age=604800 (7d) or 2592000 (30d) when remember_me=true; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure only when ENVIRONMENT!=development; Domain=COOKIE_DOMAIN if set._

Same cookies are set._

Headers: {"Set-Cookie": "none (no access_token / refresh_token cookies are set for native clients)"}
_Native variant: X-App-Platform is ios or android (trimmed, case-insensitive), in ANY environment. data is the raw domain.LoginResponse with access_token, refresh_token, user_id, role, access_token_expires_in=3600, refresh_token_expires_in=604800|2592000, remember_me_duration=7|30, expires_in=3600, token_type='Bearer'; mfa_* omitted. No auth cookies are set. The app must store the pair and send 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>' (accepted by AuthMiddleware in production only with X-App-Platform ios|android) and refresh via POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with refresh_token in the JSON body._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Magic link verification failed` - invalid/forged/expired PASETO, no DB row for the token hash, row expired, row already used, user not found, MarkMagicLinkTokenUsed/issueSession failure. The service returns fresh errors.New(...) values / ErrMagicLinkNotFound, never usecases.ErrInvalidMagicLink or ErrMagicLinkAlreadyUsed, so the handler's 401 'Invalid or expired magic link' branch is unreachable
- 400: `Email not verified. Please verify your email first` - valid link but users.email_verified=false
- 400: `Account has been banned` - valid link but status=banned
- 400: `Account is inactive` - valid link but status != active
- 400: `token is required` - token missing/empty
- 413: `Request body too large` - Content-Length > 1048576 (auth group MaxBodyBytes)
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - per-IP auth-group limiter exceeded (body also has retry_after: string Go duration); headers X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset + Retry-After are set on every response
- 400: `Invalid request body` - body is not valid JSON / field types mismatch
- 403: `CSRF token missing | CSRF token mismatch` - path not CSRF-exempt: X-CSRF-Token header must equal csrf_token cookie (dev: CSRF_STATIC_TOKEN also accepted) - not raised when the native skip applies (X-App-Platform ios|android + no access_token/refresh_token cookie)

**Side effects:** magic_link_tokens.is_used=true, used_at=now (UPDATE by id, not conditional on is_used=false, so two concurrent verifies of the same link can both pass the read-then-write check); purpose column is not checked on lookup (audience/purpose enforced in the PASETO). Then issueSession (shared by every login method): mints PASETO access token (1h) + refresh token (7d, or 30d when remember_me), inserts user_sessions row (refresh/access token hashes, IP, User-Agent, expires_at), then revokes older active sessions beyond MaxConcurrentSessions=1 (single-device: every other session of the user is revoked), updates users last_login, async UpdateLoginStreak. Records a successful login_attempts row (email, IP, User-Agent). No recaptcha. No per-token attempt limit beyond the IP group limiter.

- 2026-10-09: (superseded at 21:10) the handler was initially not native-aware: it set access_token/refresh_token cookies and returned the raw LoginResponse (tokens in body) to every client, including X-App-Platform ios|android.
- 2026-10-09 (21:10): the native CSRF skip no longer requires an 'Authorization: Bearer' header (csrf.go:113): X-App-Platform ios|android with no access_token/refresh_token cookie is enough, so a logged-out app call needs no CSRF token. **Endpoint-specific errors**
- 401: `Invalid or expired OTP` - no unused OTP row for the email (also for unknown emails -- uniform), row expired or superseded, already used, increment/re-read failed or a newer OTP superseded it mid-request, or hash mismatch
- 429: `Maximum OTP attempts exceeded` - failed_attempts >= MaxOTPAttempts before this try, or > MaxOTPAttempts after the pre-compare atomic increment (default 3; env RATE_LIMIT_MAX_OTP_ATTEMPTS, .env currently 100000)
- 400: `Email not verified. Please verify your email first` - correct OTP but users.email_verified=false (checkLoginAllowed)
- 400: `Account has been banned` - correct OTP but status=banned
- 400: `Account is inactive` - correct OTP but status != active
- 400: `OTP verification failed` - any other service error (user lookup failure, MarkOTPSessionUsed failure, issueSession/token/session-insert/UpdateLastLogin failure) -- handler maps these to 400, not 5xx
- 400: `<validation messages joined by '; '>` - validation failure
- 413: `Request body too large` - Content-Length > 1048576 (auth group MaxBodyBytes)
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - per-IP auth-group limiter exceeded (body also has retry_after: string Go duration); headers X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset + Retry-After are set on every response
- 400: `Invalid request body` - body is not valid JSON / field types mismatch
- 403: `CSRF token missing | CSRF token mismatch` - path not CSRF-exempt: X-CSRF-Token header must equal csrf_token cookie (dev: CSRF_STATIC_TOKEN also accepted) - not raised when the native skip applies (X-App-Platform ios|android + no access_token/refresh_token cookie)

**Side effects:** Every verification attempt (right or wrong) first atomically increments otp_sessions.failed_attempts (spent before comparing, so the count is attempts-used, not just failures); attempt count is carried to any newer OTP. On success: otp_sessions.is_used=true, used_at=now (UPDATE by id, not conditional on is_used=false); then issueSession (shared by every login method): mints PASETO access token (1h) + refresh token (7d, or 30d when remember_me), inserts user_sessions row (refresh/access token hashes, IP, User-Agent, expires_at), then revokes older active sessions beyond MaxConcurrentSessions=1 (single-device: every other session of the user is revoked), updates users last_login, async UpdateLoginStreak. No login_attempts row is recorded on this path. No recaptcha.

Lists a community's non-archived discussions (pinned first, then newest) for members.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireCompleteProfile (group .Use; evaluated for role=seeker only; no community/thread/event path is in ProfileGateAllows)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:521 CommunityHandler.GetThreads`

**Path params**
- `community_id` (string<uuid>) community id

**Query params**
- `page` (integer) required=False default=1 values that are not a positive integer are ignored (default used)
- `limit` (integer) required=False default=50 1..200; out-of-range or non-integer values are ignored (default used)

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "string<uuid>",
      "community_id": "string<uuid>",
      "creator_id": "string<uuid>",
      "title": "string",
      "description": "string",
      "thread_state": "string enum: open|resolved|partial|archived",
      "message_count": "integer",
      "file_count": "integer",
      "pinned": "boolean",
      "is_locked": "boolean",
      "created_at": "string<date-time>",
      "updated_at": "string<date-time>",
      "edited_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": "integer",
    "limit": "integer",
    "has_more": "boolean"
  }

```
_Excludes archived and deleted threads. Ordered pinned DESC, created_at DESC. has_more = (len(data) == limit). message_count/file_count count non-deleted messages. data may be JSON null if the community has no threads and the default-thread seed failed (repository returns nil slice)._

- Validator failures -> 400 'Validation failed: <msgs>' (e.g. 'title must be at least 5 characters'; joined with '; ')
- Service: utils.ValidateDiscussionTitle - trimmed, 5..200 runes, enough letters and a word of >=2 letters
- file_url / file_context are validated but NOT stored on the thread (service ignores them)

request.description:
Uploads a message attachment to R2 under the thread's prefix and returns the object key to send as file_url.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireCompleteProfile (group .Use; evaluated for role=seeker only; no community/thread/event path is in ProfileGateAllows); RequireFeatureAccess("community") (passed after the handler; Fiber v3 register() runs trailing middleware before the handler, so it runs)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:2882 CommunityHandler.UploadCommunityFile`

**Path params**
- `community_id` (string<uuid>) community id
- `thread_id` (string<uuid>) thread id; must belong to :community_id

**Request body** (multipart/form-data) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "file": "file (required)"
}
```
**Required:** file
**Validation:**
- file: size must be >0 and <= 10MB (10*1024*1024)
- extension allowlist (case-insensitive): .jpg .jpeg .png .gif .webp .bmp .mp4 .mov .webm .m4v .pdf .doc .docx .txt .csv
- MIME type is not checked; filename sanitized by utils.SanitizeFilename

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "file_key": "string",
    "file_url": "string",
    "file_size": "integer",
    "file_name": "string",
    "content_type": "string"
  }
}
```
_file_key = file_url = raw R2 key communities/<community_id>/threads/<thread_id>/<uuidv7>/<sanitized filename>. file_name is the original multipart filename; content_type is the multipart part's Content-Type header. Client passes the key as file_url when posting a message._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - role=seeker with missing mandatory profile fields (body also has error_code=PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, profile_incomplete=true, mandatory_missing_fields=[string])
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(community): caller has an active "community" feature restriction (body also has restricted=true, feature="community", source, optional reason, expires_at or permanent=true); fails open on lookup error
- 401: `Authentication required` - user_id missing from context (handler check)
- 400: `Invalid community ID` - :community_id not a UUID
- 400: `Invalid thread ID` - :thread_id not a UUID
- 400: `No file provided` - missing 'file' form field
- 400: `"<filename>" is <X.X>MB. Attachments must be 10MB or smaller.` - file > 10MB
- 400: `"<filename>" is empty.` - zero-byte file
- 400: `<ext|(no extension)> files are not supported. Allowed: images, video, PDF, Word documents and text files.` - extension not in allowlist
- 500: `Failed to read file` - multipart read failure
- 404: `Community not found` - community id does not exist
- 403: `Community is not active` - community status != 'active'
- 403: `You are banned from this community` - caller has an active community_bans row
- 403: `You are not a member of this community` - caller is not a member
- 404: `Thread not found` - thread missing/deleted or not in this community
- 403: `This thread is archived and no longer accepts messages` - thread_state = 'archived'
- 403: `This thread is locked and no longer accepts messages` - thread is_locked = true
- 500: `Failed to upload file` - file storage not configured or R2 error

**Side effects:** Uploads object to R2 (metadata community-id, thread-id, uploader-id); no DB write.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

- correction: R2 key layout is communities/<community_id>/threads/<thread_id>/<uuidv7>/<sanitized filename> (r2_client.go:322); previously listed as unresolved

**Not determinable from code:**
- RateLimitByUser(10, time.Minute) is the 2nd positional argument (handler slot) and never runs; communityRestrict (3rd arg) does run.

request.description:
Returns one community record with live member and thread counts to any authenticated caller who passes the community access check.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireCompleteProfile (group .Use; evaluated for role=seeker only; no community/thread/event path is in ProfileGateAllows)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:866 CommunityHandler.GetCommunityDetail`

**Path params**
- `id` (string<uuid>) community id

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "id": "string<uuid>",
    "name": "string",
    "purpose": "string",
    "scope": "string | null (omitempty)",
    "technologies": [
      "string"
    ],
    "member_limit": "integer | null (omitempty)",
    "owner_id": "string<uuid>",
    "owner_role": "string",
    "is_public": "boolean",
    "chat_mode": "string",
    "status": "string",
    "rules": "string (omitempty)",
    "invitation_code": "string | null (omitempty)",
    "member_count": "integer",
    "thread_count": "integer",
    "is_featured": "boolean (omitempty)",
    "featured_order": "integer (omitempty)",
    "created_at": "string<date-time>",
    "updated_at": "string<date-time>"
  }
}
```
_No status/is_public filter: any existing community id is returned. member_count and thread_count (non-archived, non-deleted threads) computed separately; left 0 if those counts fail. is_featured/featured_order/invitation_code not selected (omitted). technologies has json omitempty (omitted when null/empty)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - role=seeker with missing mandatory profile fields (body also has error_code=PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, profile_incomplete=true, mandatory_missing_fields=[string])
- 401: `Authentication required` - user_id missing from context (handler check)
- 400: `Invalid community ID` - community id path param is not a UUID
- 403: `You must complete KYC verification before accessing communities` - ValidateCommunityAccess: caller's verification_level (seekers, then solvers) is empty or 'none'
- 400: `A pseudo name is required to access the community` - ValidateCommunityAccess: caller has no pseudo_name
- 404: `Community not found` - community id does not exist
- 500: `Failed to retrieve community` - other errors
- 500: `Failed to retrieve community` - [live-verified 2026-10-06] seeker with no pseudo_name and no solvers row: CommunityRepository.GetUserPseudoName falls through to the solvers table, gets ErrNoRows -> 'user not found', which is not ErrPseudoNameRequired, so the handler's generic 500 is returned instead of 400 'A pseudo name is required to access the community' (Backend/internal/adapter/db/postgres/community_repository.go GetUserPseudoName).

**Side effects:** None (read-only).

**Live check 2026-10-06:** body_verified - seeker -> 200 (matches doc); solver -> 200 (matches doc)

request.description:
Joins or leaves a community for the caller.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireCompleteProfile (group .Use; evaluated for role=seeker only; no community/thread/event path is in ProfileGateAllows); RequireFeatureAccess("community") (passed after the handler; Fiber v3 register() runs trailing middleware before the handler, so it runs)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:355 CommunityHandler.CommunityAction`

**Path params**
- `id` (string<uuid>) community id

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "action": "string enum: join|leave",
  "pseudo_name": "string (omitempty)"
}
```
**Required:** action
**Validation:**
- action: validate required,oneof=join leave (failure -> 400 'Validation failed')
- pseudo_name is accepted but ignored; the pseudo name is read from the caller's profile

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "community_id": "string<uuid>",
    "action": "string enum: join|leave",
    "member_count": "integer"
  }
}
```
_member_count is re-read after the change._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - role=seeker with missing mandatory profile fields (body also has error_code=PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, profile_incomplete=true, mandatory_missing_fields=[string])
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(community): caller has an active "community" feature restriction (body also has restricted=true, feature="community", source, optional reason, expires_at or permanent=true); fails open on lookup error
- 401: `Authentication required` - user_id missing from context (handler check)
- 401: `User role not found` - user_role missing from context (handler check)
- 400: `Invalid community ID` - community id path param is not a UUID
- 400: `Invalid request format` - body is not valid JSON
- 400: `Validation failed` - action missing or not join/leave
- 403: `You must complete KYC verification before accessing communities` - join only: ValidateCommunityAccess verification level empty or 'none'
- 400: `A pseudo name is required to access the community` - join only: no pseudo name
- 403: `Complete your identity verification to join communities. You can keep browsing in the meantime.` - join: verification below join bar (seeker 'full', other roles 'standard'); body also has error_code=VERIFICATION_REQUIRED_TO_JOIN, verification_route="/verification"
- 403: `You are banned from this community` - join: caller banned
- 404: `Community not found` - join: community id not found
- 403: `Community is not active` - join: status != active
- 403: `Community is not public` - join: is_public=false
- 409: `You are already a member of this community` - join: already a member
- 403: `This community has reached its member limit` - join: member_limit reached (checked under row lock)
- 403: `You are not a member of this community` - leave: caller not a member
- 500: `Failed to perform community action` - leave by the community owner (service error 'community owner cannot leave their own community; transfer ownership first' is not mapped) or other DB errors

**Side effects:** join: inserts community_members row in a transaction with a row lock on the community; async activity log 'member_joined'; publishes community.member.joined (pseudo_name, user_role, member_count). leave: deletes member row in a transaction; async activity log 'member_left'; publishes community.member.left (member_count).

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- middleware: RequireFeatureAccess(community) now runs — route is now Post(path, CommunityAction, communityRestrict) (previously communityRestrict sat in the handler slot and never ran); adds the 403 feature-restriction error
- correction: KYC / pseudo-name checks (ValidateCommunityAccess) apply only to join; leave does not call them

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/communities/{id}/action` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:14); solver: `POST /api/v1/communities/{id}/action` (docs/audit/solver_endpoints.md:173)
**Evidence:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/routes/routes.go:1280`, `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:354-424`, `Backend/internal/core/usecases/community_service.go:463-576`, `Backend/internal/core/usecases/community_service.go:583-639`, `Backend/internal/core/usecases/community_service.go:343-364`, `Backend/internal/core/domain/community_dto.go:506-510`, `Backend/pkg/middleware/feature_restriction.go:39-95`

response.name: 200 OK - member_count is re-read after the change.

request.description:
Joins the caller to the community that owns the invitation code (works for private communities) after the same verification bar as a normal join.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireCompleteProfile (group .Use; evaluated for role=seeker only; no community/thread/event path is in ProfileGateAllows); RequireFeatureAccess("community") (passed after the handler; Fiber v3 register() runs trailing middleware before the handler, so it runs)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:1677 CommunityHandler.JoinViaInviteCode`

**Path params**
- `code` (string) percent-decoded; trimmed, upper-cased, 1..20 chars of A-Z/2-7

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "community_id": "string<uuid>",
    "action": "string enum: join",
    "member_count": "integer"
  }
}
```
_member_count re-read after commit. No is_public check (invite codes can join private communities)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - role=seeker with missing mandatory profile fields (body also has error_code=PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, profile_incomplete=true, mandatory_missing_fields=[string])
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(community): caller has an active "community" feature restriction (body also has restricted=true, feature="community", source, optional reason, expires_at or permanent=true); fails open on lookup error
- 401: `Authentication required` - user_id missing from context (handler check)
- 401: `User role not found` - user_role missing from context (handler check)
- 400: `Invitation code is required` - empty :code
- 404: `Invalid or expired invitation code` - code fails normalization or matches no active community
- 403: `You must complete KYC verification before accessing communities` - ValidateCommunityAccess: caller's verification_level (seekers, then solvers) is empty or 'none'
- 400: `A pseudo name is required to access the community` - ValidateCommunityAccess: caller has no pseudo_name
- 403: `Complete your identity verification to join communities. You can keep browsing in the meantime.` - verification below join bar (seeker: 'full'; other roles: 'standard'); body also has error_code=VERIFICATION_REQUIRED_TO_JOIN, verification_route="/verification"
- 403: `You are banned from this community` - caller has an active community_bans row
- 403: `Community is not active` - community status != 'active'
- 409: `You are already a member of this community` - already a member
- 403: `This community has reached its member limit` - member_limit set and current member count >= limit (checked in tx)
- 500: `Failed to join community` - ban-check/tx/DB failures

**Side effects:** Inserts community_members row (transaction, pseudo_name from profile, user_role from session); async activity log 'member_joined_via_invite' with invite_code; publishes community.member.joined (pseudo_name, user_role, member_count, via=invite_code) via outbox (fallback direct NATS).

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- middleware: RequireFeatureAccess(community) now runs — route is now Post(path, JoinViaInviteCode, communityRestrict) (previously communityRestrict sat in the handler slot and never ran); adds the 403 feature-restriction error

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/communities/invite/{id}/join` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:9); solver: `POST /api/v1/communities/invite/{id}/join` (docs/audit/solver_endpoints.md:175)

{

  "parent_comment_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)"
}
```
**Required:** message
**Validation:**
- message: validate:"required,min=1,max=2000"
- parent_comment_id: no validation (not checked to exist or to belong to the same content)
- message is stored HTML-escaped (html.EscapeString)

  "success": "boolean",
  "message": "string (\"Comment added\")"
}
```

- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - RequireCompleteProfile: a seeker whose mandatory profile fields are not all filled in. Body adds error_code "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete: true, mandatory_missing_fields: [string].

request.description:
Registers the caller for an event in-platform (capacity- and window-enforced) after explicit consent to share name and email with the host.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireCompleteProfile (group .Use; evaluated for role=seeker only; no community/thread/event path is in ProfileGateAllows); RequireVerification("standard") (eventsWrite := events.Group("", requireVerified) registers a USE on /api/v1/events after the GET routes, so it runs only for the write routes; role=admin bypasses)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:2030 CommunityHandler.RegisterForEvent`

**Path params**
- `event_id` (string<uuid>) event id

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "share_contact": "boolean"
}
```
**Required:** share_contact
**Validation:**
- Body is only parsed when non-empty; an empty body leaves share_contact=false
- share_contact must be true, otherwise 400 CONTACT_SHARE_CONSENT_REQUIRED (checked before the event lookup)

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "registered": "boolean",
    "registered_count": "integer",
    "max_attendees": "integer | null (omitempty)",
    "full": "boolean"
  }
}
```
_Community membership is not required; community bans are respected._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - role=seeker with missing mandatory profile fields (body also has error_code=PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, profile_incomplete=true, mandatory_missing_fields=[string])
- 403: `This feature requires identity verification. Please complete KYC verification to access bookings, payments, and communities.` - RequireVerification(standard): caller verification level below 'standard' (body also has exploration_mode=true, verification_level, required_level)
- 403: `Unable to verify account status` - RequireVerification: verification level lookup failed
- 403: `Invalid verification level` - RequireVerification: unknown non-empty verification level
- 401: `Authentication required` - user_id missing from context (handler check)
- 400: `Invalid event ID` - :event_id not a UUID
- 400: `Invalid request format` - body is not valid JSON
- 400: `Registering shares your name and email with the event host. Please confirm to continue.` - share_contact missing/false (body also has error_code=CONTACT_SHARE_CONSENT_REQUIRED)
- 404: `Event not found` - event missing
- 403: `You are banned from this community` - event belongs to a community that banned the caller
- 409: `You are already registered for this event` - already registered
- 409: `This event has reached its member limit` - registrations >= max_attendees
- 409: `Registration for this event is closed` - hosting community not active, effective status not upcoming/ongoing, past registration_end_time, or (no registration_end_time) past end_time
- 409: `Registration for this event has not opened yet` - before registration_start_time
- 500: `Failed to register for event` - DB errors, or status re-read failure after a successful registration

**Side effects:** Inserts event_registrations row with contact_shared_at=NOW() (event row locked FOR UPDATE); publishes community.event.rsvp_changed (event_id, status=registered, user_id); creates community_notifications 'event.registration_confirmed' for the caller and 'event.new_registration' (with registrant_count) for the hosting community owner when not the caller (best-effort).

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- request: new JSON body {share_contact: boolean}; share_contact must be true (previously no body)
- errors: new 400 'Registering shares your name and email with the event host. Please confirm to continue.' with error_code=CONTACT_SHARE_CONSENT_REQUIRED; new 400 'Invalid request format' for a malformed non-empty body
- errors: registration is refused with 409 'Registration for this event is closed' when the hosting community is not active
- side effect: event_registrations.contact_shared_at is now stored

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/events/{id}/registrations` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:27); solver: `POST /api/v1/events/{id}/registrations` (docs/audit/solver_endpoints.md:180)
**Evidence:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/routes/routes.go:1387-1393`, `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:2028-2050`, `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:94-99`, `Backend/internal/core/usecases/community_service.go:1448-1549`, `Backend/internal/adapter/db/postgres/community_repository.go:1713-1800`, `Backend/internal/core/domain/community_dto.go:423-428`, `Backend/pkg/middleware/auth.go:52-111`

**Query params**
- `key` (string) required=True default= trimmed; non-empty; must not contain '..'; needs >= 2 '/'-separated segments. Prefix RBAC: profiles/* any signed-in user; kyc/{userID}/* owner or admin; support/{ticketID}/* ticket owner or admin; sessions/{sessionID}/* participant or admin; chat/{sessionID}/* chat participant or admin; verification/{solverID}/* owner or admin; face-audit/* admin only; any other prefix (incl. content/) denied

**Response 200** (R2 object Content-Type) - field types from code:
_Streamed bytes (SendStream). Headers: Content-Type from the R2 object, Content-Length when known, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Cache-Control: chat/ and sessions/ -> 'private, max-age=60, no-transform'; profiles/ -> 'private, max-age=300, no-transform'; others -> 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, private, max-age=0' plus Pragma: no-cache and Expires: 0. - 403: `File not accessible` - other authorize error (not reachable with a non-empty key and user id)

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:

    {

request.description:
Posts a message (optionally reply/quote/attachment) to a thread the caller belongs to.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireCompleteProfile (group .Use; evaluated for role=seeker only; no community/thread/event path is in ProfileGateAllows); RequireFeatureAccess("community") (passed after the handler; Fiber v3 register() runs trailing middleware before the handler, so it runs)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:557 CommunityHandler.CreateMessage`

**Path params**
- `thread_id` (string<uuid>) thread id

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "message": "string",
  "file_url": "string | null (omitempty)",
  "file_context": {
    "why_exists": "string (omitempty)",
    "problem_solved": "string (omitempty)",
    "usage_instructions": "string (omitempty)",
    "file_name": "string (omitempty)",
    "file_size": "integer (omitempty)",
    "content_type": "string (omitempty)"
  },
  "parent_message_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
  "quoted_message_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)"
}
```
**Required:** message
**Validation:**
- message: required,min=1,max=5000
- file_url: omitempty,min=1,max=2048
- file_context: required_with=FileURL (object|null); any validator failure -> 400 'Validation failed'
- file_url must be an upload key of THIS thread: communities/<uuid = thread's community>/threads/<thread_id>/<rest>, no '..' segments; else 400 'Attachments must be uploaded to this discussion before they are sent'
- parent_message_id / quoted_message_id must exist and belong to the same thread
- message body HTML-sanitized; quoted_text snapshot truncated to 500 bytes + '…'

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "id": "string<uuid>",
    "thread_id": "string<uuid>",
    "sender_id": "string<uuid>",
    "sender_pseudo_name": "string",
    "message": "string",
    "file_url": "string | null (omitempty)",
    "file_context": {
      "why_exists": "string (omitempty)",
      "problem_solved": "string (omitempty)",
      "usage_instructions": "string (omitempty)",
      "file_name": "string (omitempty)",
      "file_size": "integer (omitempty)",
      "content_type": "string (omitempty)"
    },
    "parent_message_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
    "edited_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
    "is_pinned": "boolean (omitempty)",
    "quoted_message_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
    "quoted_text": "string | null (omitempty)",
    "mentions": [
      "string<uuid>"
    ],
    "sender_unavailable": "boolean (omitempty)",
    "reactions": [
      {
        "emoji": "string",
        "count": "integer",
        "mine": "boolean",
        "user_ids": [
          "string<uuid>"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "created_at": "string<date-time>"
  }
}
```
_sender_pseudo_name taken from the member record. file_url presigned (only for this thread's keys). mentions set when @pseudoname mentions resolve to members. If the caller is shadow-banned the same shape is returned but nothing is stored. file_context is an object | null (omitempty); mentions, reactions and reactions[].user_ids are omitempty arrays._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - role=seeker with missing mandatory profile fields (body also has error_code=PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, profile_incomplete=true, mandatory_missing_fields=[string])
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(community): caller has an active "community" feature restriction (body also has restricted=true, feature="community", source, optional reason, expires_at or permanent=true); fails open on lookup error
- 401: `Authentication required` - user_id missing from context (handler check)
- 400: `Invalid thread ID` - :thread_id not a UUID
- 400: `Invalid request format` - body is not valid JSON
- 400: `Validation failed` - DTO validation failed
- 404: `Thread not found` - thread missing or soft-deleted
- 403: `This thread is archived and no longer accepts messages` - thread_state = 'archived'
- 403: `This thread is locked and no longer accepts messages` - thread is_locked = true
- 403: `You are banned from this community` - caller has an active community_bans row

Adds one of the allowed reaction emojis to a message for the caller.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireCompleteProfile (group .Use; evaluated for role=seeker only; no community/thread/event path is in ProfileGateAllows); RequireFeatureAccess("community") (passed after the handler; Fiber v3 register() runs trailing middleware before the handler, so it runs)

  "emoji": "string enum: 👍|👏|❤️|🔥|😂|💯|👎|🔗|👋|🙋|🗣️|🥳|🎉|🙌|🤝|👊|😲|🙂|😆|🤩|✋|😮|😡|😱"
}
```

- emoji: required,min=1,max=32 (validator); failure -> 400 'Emoji is required (1-32 chars)'
- emoji must be in domain.AllowedCommunityReactions (exact string match) else 400 'This reaction is not supported'

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "message": "string"
}
```

- 404: `Message not found` - message missing or not in this thread
- 403: `You are not a member of this community` - caller not a member
- 403: `You are banned from this community` - caller has an active community_bans row

- 403: `This thread is locked and no longer accepts messages` - thread is_locked = true

request.description:
Removes the caller's reaction emoji from a message.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireCompleteProfile (group .Use; evaluated for role=seeker only; no community/thread/event path is in ProfileGateAllows); RequireFeatureAccess("community") (passed after the handler; Fiber v3 register() runs trailing middleware before the handler, so it runs)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:1377 CommunityHandler.RemoveReaction`

**Path params**
- `thread_id` (string<uuid>) thread id
- `message_id` (string<uuid>) message id (must belong to :thread_id)
- `emoji` (string) percent-decoded by the handler (falls back to raw if not valid escaping); 1..32 bytes after decoding; must be in the 24-emoji allowlist

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "message": "string"
}
```
_message is 'Reaction removed'. Also 200 when no matching reaction existed (only logged)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - role=seeker with missing mandatory profile fields (body also has error_code=PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, profile_incomplete=true, mandatory_missing_fields=[string])
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(community): caller has an active "community" feature restriction (body also has restricted=true, feature="community", source, optional reason, expires_at or permanent=true); fails open on lookup error
- 401: `Authentication required` - user_id missing from context (handler check)
- 400: `Invalid thread ID` - :thread_id not a UUID
- 400: `Invalid message ID` - :message_id not a UUID
- 400: `Invalid emoji` - decoded emoji empty or longer than 32 bytes
- 400: `This reaction is not supported` - emoji not in domain.AllowedCommunityReactions (24 emojis: 👍 👏 ❤️ 🔥 😂 💯 👎 🔗 👋 🙋 🗣️ 🥳 🎉 🙌 🤝 👊 😲 🙂 😆 🤩 ✋ 😮 😡 😱); checked before any membership lookup
- 404: `Thread not found` - thread missing or soft-deleted
- 404: `Message not found` - message missing or not in this thread
- 403: `You are not a member of this community` - caller not a member
- 403: `You are banned from this community` - caller has an active community_bans row
- 500: `Failed to remove reaction` - DB error

**Side effects:** Deletes message_reactions row; publishes community.message.unreacted (action=remove) even when nothing was deleted.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- middleware: RequireFeatureAccess(community) now runs — route is now Delete(path, RemoveReaction, communityRestrict); adds the 403 feature-restriction error
- validation: emoji must be in the 24-emoji allowlist; new 400 'This reaction is not supported'

**Listed in:** seeker: `DELETE /api/v/threads/{id}/messages/{id}/reactions/{id}` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:166); solver: `DELETE /api/v1/threads/{id}/messages/{id}/reactions/{id}` (docs/audit/solver_endpoints.md:170)
**Evidence:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/routes/routes.go:1355`, `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:23-43`, `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:1376-1402`, `Backend/internal/core/usecases/community_service.go:2784-2804`, `Backend/internal/adapter/db/postgres/community_repository.go:2684-2702`, `Backend/pkg/middleware/feature_restriction.go:39-95`
