request.description:
Lists the caller's in-app notifications newest first, optionally unread only, with total count.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware (from userMentions := api.Group("/users").Use, registered before /users/notifications; raw-prefix match); RequireVerification("standard") (userMentions .Use on prefix /api/v1/users also matches /api/v1/users/notifications; role=admin bypasses); AuthMiddleware (userNotifs group; returns Next immediately because the earlier run set the auth-verified sentinel)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:1849 CommunityHandler.GetNotifications`

**Query params**
- `unread` (boolean) required=False default=false case-insensitive 'true' enables unread-only; anything else = all
- `page` (integer) required=False default=1 values that are not a positive integer are ignored (default used)
- `limit` (integer) required=False default=50 1..200; out-of-range or non-integer values are ignored (default used)

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "notifications": [
      {
        "id": "string<uuid>",
        "user_id": "string<uuid>",
        "community_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
        "thread_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
        "message_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
        "event_type": "string",
        "title": "string",
        "body": "string (omitempty)",
        "link": "string (omitempty)",
        "data": "any (omitempty)",
        "is_read": "boolean",
        "read_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
        "created_at": "string<date-time>"
      }
    ],
    "total": "integer",
    "page": "integer",
    "limit": "integer",
    "unread_only": "boolean"
  }
}
```
_Ordered created_at DESC. notifications is [] when none. data is the stored JSONB (COALESCE '{}'), free-form. body/link COALESCE '' so they are omitted when empty._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `This feature requires identity verification. Please complete KYC verification to access bookings, payments, and communities.` - RequireVerification(standard): caller verification level below 'standard' (body also has exploration_mode=true, verification_level, required_level)
- 403: `Unable to verify account status` - RequireVerification: verification level lookup failed
- 403: `Invalid verification level` - RequireVerification: unknown non-empty verification level
- 401: `Authentication required` - user_id missing from context (handler check)
- 500: `Failed to fetch notifications` - DB error

_Messages are dropped (connection kept) when the 1024-slot per-connection send buffer stays full > 250 ms. Notifications whose type is disabled in the recipient's settings are dropped by the notification gate._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 401: `Authentication required | Invalid or expired token | Session has been revoked. Please login again | Session has been revoked or client identity mismatch. Please login again` - only when R2 is configured: /api/v1-wide AuthMiddleware runs before the hub
- 429: `Too many WebSocket connections from this IP` - open connections from the IP >= WS_MAX_CONNS_PER_IP (config default 10000; hub floor 10 when <= 0); JSON, before upgrade
- 500: `Internal server error` - upgrade failed (Origin rejected, not a WebSocket request, bad headers): the upgrader error is returned to Fiber's global ErrorHandler, which answers 500 {success:false,error:'Internal server error'}
- 101: `{"error":"authentication required"} (plaintext frame, then close)` - no token found
- 101: `{"error":"invalid token"} (plaintext frame, then close)` - PASETO verification failed
- 101: `{"error":"too many connections for this user"} (plaintext frame, then close)` - user already has 10000 connections
- 101: `{"error":"failed to generate encryption key"} (plaintext frame, then close)` - crypto/rand failure
- 101: `{"type":"error","error":"secure transport (wss://) required"} (plaintext frame, then close)` - ENVIRONMENT != 'development' and request scheme is not https

**Side effects:** Registers the connection in the in-memory hub (user id + role from token claims; admin index). On disconnect: leaves all joined chat sessions, unregisters, broadcasts presence.update offline if it was the user's last connection. Inbound chat.* frames call ChatService (message insert, delete, typing, read receipts, reactions; fan-out via NATS/hub).

request.description:
Email + password login for every role: optional reCAPTCHA check, per-email failed-attempt limit, account-status gate (incl. 30-day deactivation auto-reactivation), then the shared issueSession routine (session row + single-device cap) and HttpOnly auth cookies.

**Auth:** False | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** MaxBodyBytes(1MiB) [auth group .Use]; RateLimitAuth(RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_PER_15MIN per IP / 15 min) [auth group .Use]; ClientContextMiddleware (global app.Use, main.go:3291) - client header checks, see common.client_headers
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/user_auth_handler.go:403 UserAuthHandler.Login`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "email": "string<email>",
  "password": "string",
  "remember_me": "boolean",
  "recaptcha_token": "string"
}
```
**Required:** email, password, recaptcha_token
**Validation:**
- email: validate required,email,max=255 (not trimmed before validation; the service then lower-cases + trims)
- password: required
- recaptcha_token: required by the validate tag even when RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY is unset
- reCAPTCHA verified (score threshold 0.5) only when env RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY is non-empty
- Per-account limit: failed login_attempts for this email within LoginAttemptWindow (default 15 min) >= maxLoginAttempts (RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_PER_15MIN, default 5) -> 429, checked before the user lookup
- Validation error text = '; '-joined '<field> is required' / '<field> must be a valid email address' / '<field> must not exceed N characters'; field = lower-cased Go struct field name (email, password, recaptchatoken) because no JSON tag-name func is registered

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid request body` - JSON bind failed (body includes meta)
- 400: `<field> is required | <field> must be a valid email address | <field> must not exceed 255 characters ('; '-joined)` - validate tag failure
- 400: `reCAPTCHA verification failed. Please try again.` - RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY set and Google verification fails / score < 0.5
- 401: `Invalid email or password` - no users row with that email (users.email only) or wrong password
- 401: `This account was created with GitHub. Please use the "Continue with GitHub" button to sign in.` - users.password_hash empty/NULL (OAuth-only account)
- 429: `Too many attempts. Please try again later` - per-email failed-attempt limit reached (ErrRateLimitExceeded)
- 400: `Email not verified. Please verify your email first` - email_verified=false (after password check)
- 403: `This account is scheduled for deletion. You can cancel the deletion to keep using it.` - users.status='deleted'; body also has data:{error_code:'ACCOUNT_DELETION_SCHEDULED'} and meta
- 400: `Account is inactive` - status 'inactive' or any non-active status not handled elsewhere
- 400: `Account has been banned` - status 'banned'
- 400: `Login failed` - any other service error: permanently_closed account, deactivated > 30 days (also flips it to permanently_closed), deactivated without profile/timestamp, reactivation failure, DB error, session creation error
- 500: `Login failed. Please try again later.` - service returned MFARequired (dead path - MFA disabled platform-wide)
- 413: `Request body too large` - Content-Length > 1 MiB (auth group MaxBodyBytes)
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - per-IP RateLimitAuth exceeded; body also has retry_after (Go duration string); X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset and Retry-After headers are set on every response

**Side effects:** INSERT login_attempts (success or failure with reason). Deactivated seeker/solver within 30 days: profile account_status=active + users.status=active; past 30 days: users.status=permanently_closed. On success issueSession: INSERT user_sessions (hashed access+refresh tokens, IP, UA, expires_at = now + 7d or 30d), THEN revoke oldest active sessions except the new one until at most MaxConcurrentSessions (1) remain, UPDATE users.last_login_at, async login-streak update.

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- Session issuance now goes through the shared issueSession: the new user_sessions row is inserted FIRST and older sessions are then revoked (RevokeOldestSessionExcept) down to the cap of 1; v1 described evict-oldest-before-insert
- Account lookup is users.email only (GetUserByEmail WHERE email = $1; code comment marks it as the 2026-10-04 change); v1 did not state the lookup column
- correction: validation-message field label resolved - no RegisterTagNameFunc exists, so the label is the lower-cased struct field name (e.g. 'recaptchatoken is required'); v1 listed this as unresolved
- 2026-10-09: native-app mode (user_auth_handler.go:539-543,550): when X-App-Platform is ios|android the handler sets NO access_token/refresh_token cookies and always returns the raw domain.LoginResponse (access_token, refresh_token, expiry fields, token_type 'Bearer') in data, in every ENVIRONMENT (tokensInBody(native), :32-34). request.description:
Provider redirect target: burns the oauth_nonce cookie, verifies the signed state against it, exchanges the code for a verified email identity, then logs in / links / provisions the user (one transaction, EULA recorded) and 302-redirects to the role's app with auth cookies, or to the role picker for an unknown identity.

**Auth:** False | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** MaxBodyBytes(1MiB) [routes.go auth group .Use - raw prefix /api/v1/auth also matches /api/v1/auth/oauth]; RateLimitAuth [routes.go auth group, shared limiter instance with login/refresh]; RateLimitAuth(RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_PER_15MIN) [main.go oauthGroup .Use, separate limiter]
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/oauth_handler.go:241 OAuthHandler.Callback`

**Path params**
- `provider` (string enum: github|google) Same parsing as /start

**Query params**
- `code` (string) required=True default=None Authorization code from the provider
- `state` (string) required=True default=None Signed state from /start; signature valid, issued <= 15 min ago (and not > 1 min in the future), nonce must equal the oauth_nonce cookie (constant-time)
- `error` (string) required=False default=None Provider error; any non-empty value -> 'Sign-in was cancelled' redirect

**Response 302** (None) - field types from code:
Headers: {"Location": "<app URL for role, trailing '/' trimmed> + <state.redirect>; seeker -> SEEKER_APP_URL, solver -> SOLVER_APP_URL, otherwise (or when unset) FRONTEND_URL", "Set-Cookie": ["oauth_nonce=; Max-Age=-1; Expires=<past>; Path=/api/v1/auth/oauth; HttpOnly (always cleared)", "access_token=<PASETO v4 access token>; Max-Age=3600; Path=/; Domain=$COOKIE_DOMAIN (omitted when unset); HttpOnly; Secure when ENVIRONMENT != 'development'; SameSite=Lax", "refresh_token=<PASETO v4 refresh token>; Max-Age=2592000 (30d; social login treated as remember-me); Path=/api/v1/auth; Domain=$COOKIE_DOMAIN (omitted when unset); HttpOnly; Secure when ENVIRONMENT != 'development'; SameSite=Lax"]}
_Login or new signup completed._

**Response 302** (None) - field types from code:
Headers: {"Location": "<FRONTEND_URL>/register?email=<provider email>&oauth_signup=1&provider=<provider>", "Set-Cookie": ["oauth_nonce cleared", "oauth_signup=<signed pending-signup token>; Max-Age=1800; Path=/api/v1/auth/oauth; HttpOnly; Secure when ENVIRONMENT != 'development'; SameSite=Lax (no Domain)"]}
_Identity verified but not linked to any account and the state did not allow signup (login page, or register page without eula). Finish with POST /api/v1/auth/oauth/complete-signup {role, eula_accepted}; the token is valid 30 min and single-use._

**Response 302** (None) - field types from code:
Headers: {"Location": "<FRONTEND_URL>/login?oauth_error=<url-escaped reason>"}
_Failure (reasons under errors)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 302: `Unsupported sign-in provider` - invalid provider (redirect to /login?oauth_error=...)
- 302: `Sign-in was cancelled` - ?error present
- 302: `Sign-in response was incomplete, please try again` - code or state empty
- 302: `This sign-in method is not available right now` - provider not configured
- 302: `Your sign-in session expired, please try again` - bad signature, state too old, or nonce cookie missing/mismatched
- 302: `Your account has no verified email address. Verify your email with the provider and try again` - provider email unverified or empty
- 302: `This account has been banned` - resolved user status banned
- 302: `This account is not available for sign-in` - resolved user not active; or same-email account exists but is not active+verified; or that user already has a different link for this provider
- 302: `You must accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to create an account` - provisioning reached without EULA flag (defensive; state normally routes to role picker instead)
- 302: `Sign-in failed, please try again` - any other error (code exchange, provider API, DB, transaction)
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - either per-IP RateLimitAuth exceeded (JSON)

**Side effects:** Clears oauth_nonce. Linked provider account: touch oauth account last login. Same verified active email: INSERT user_oauth_accounts link. New identity with signup+EULA: ONE transaction - INSERT users (pending, NULL password), INSERT EULA acceptance (version CurrentEULAVersion, IP, UA), park referral code, link provider, mark email verified/active, create seeker/solver profile; rollback on any failure. Then issueSession(rememberMe=true): INSERT user_sessions (30d), revoke older sessions down to 1, UPDATE last_login, async streak update.

**Live check:** skipped - needs a real GitHub authorization code; calling it would create/link accounts

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- Pending-signup token moved out of the URL: callback now sets HttpOnly cookie oauth_signup (Max-Age 1800, Path /api/v1/auth/oauth) and the Location is /register?email=..&oauth_signup=1&provider=..; v1 had ?oauth_signup=<signed token> in the redirect
- New signups require the EULA flag signed at /start (eula=1); without it the identity goes to the role picker instead of being provisioned
- Provisioning now runs in a single DB transaction and records an EULA acceptance row; any failure rolls back (no orphan pending users row)
- Session cap enforced after insert by the shared issueSession (v1: evict-oldest before insert)
- correction/resolved: pending-signup token = base64url(json).base64url(HMAC-SHA256), TTL 30 min (v1 listed as unresolved)

**Listed in:** seeker: `GET api/v/auth/oauth/github/callback` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:5)

request.description:
Starts a social login: signs a 15-minute HMAC state (nonce, role, referral code, redirect, signup+EULA flags), sets the oauth_nonce cookie and 302-redirects the browser to GitHub or Google.

**Auth:** False | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** MaxBodyBytes(1MiB) [routes.go auth group .Use - raw prefix /api/v1/auth also matches /api/v1/auth/oauth]; RateLimitAuth [routes.go auth group, shared limiter instance with login/refresh]; RateLimitAuth(RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_PER_15MIN) [main.go oauthGroup .Use, separate limiter]
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/oauth_handler.go:181 OAuthHandler.Start`

**Path params**
- `provider` (string enum: github|google) Trimmed, lower-cased and percent-decoded, then checked against the allowlist; the provider must also have client id + secret configured (OAUTH_GITHUB_* / OAUTH_GOOGLE_*)

**Query params**
- `role` (string enum: seeker|solver) required=False default=seeker (when signup is off) Lower-cased/trimmed. Must be seeker|solver when signup=1/true, otherwise ignored and forced to seeker
- `ref` (string) required=False default=None Referral code; trimmed + upper-cased; carried in the signed state
- `redirect` (string) required=False default=None In-app path only: must start with '/', not '//' or '/\', no '\', CR, LF, TAB, no '://'; otherwise silently dropped
- `signup` (string) required=False default=None '1' or 'true' = started from the register page (role required)
- `eula` (string) required=False default=None '1' or 'true' = Terms box ticked. Account creation straight from the callback happens only when signup AND eula are both set; signup without eula is downgraded to login behaviour (unknown identity goes to the role picker)

**Response 302** (None) - field types from code:
Headers: {"Location": "github: https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize?allow_signup=true&client_id=..&redirect_uri=<OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE_URL>/api/v1/auth/oauth/github/callback&scope=read:user user:email&state=<signed> | google: https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?client_id=..&nonce=<nonce>&prompt=select_account&redirect_uri=<base>/api/v1/auth/oauth/google/callback&response_type=code&scope=openid email profile&state=<signed> (query keys url-encoded, sorted)", "Set-Cookie": ["oauth_nonce=<64 hex>; Max-Age=900; Path=/api/v1/auth/oauth; HttpOnly; Secure when ENVIRONMENT != 'development'; SameSite=Lax (no Domain)", "csrf_token=<64 hex>; Max-Age=86400; Path=/; Domain=$COOKIE_DOMAIN; not HttpOnly; Secure+SameSite=Strict when environment != 'development', else SameSite=Lax (global CSRFProtection seeds it on any GET without a csrf_token cookie)"]}
_Success. State format: base64url(json{n,r,rc,rd,s,e,iat...}) + '.' + base64url(HMAC-SHA256(OAUTH_STATE_SECRET))._

**Response 302** (None) - field types from code:
Headers: {"Location": "<FRONTEND_URL>/login?oauth_error=<url-escaped reason>"}
_Every failure is a redirect to the landing login page (reasons under errors)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 302: `Unsupported sign-in provider` - provider not github|google (Location <FRONTEND_URL>/login?oauth_error=...)
- 302: `<provider> sign-in is not available right now` - provider credentials not configured
- 302: `Choose whether you are joining as a seeker or a solver, then try again` - signup=1/true and role not seeker|solver
- 302: `Could not start sign-in, please try again` - nonce/state generation error
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - either per-IP RateLimitAuth exceeded (JSON, not a redirect)

**Side effects:** None server-side (no DB writes); sets oauth_nonce cookie.

**Live check 2026-10-06:** status_verified - anonymous -> 302 (matches doc); seeker -> 302 (matches doc)

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- New query param 'eula' (1|true), signed into the state; without it (or without signup) no account is created from the callback - the unknown identity is sent to the role picker instead

request.description:
Signed-in seeker view of a solver's custom (code-based) booking link: solver card, fixed session, availability (legacy links only) and whether booking opens a KYC grace window.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); tzMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile(profileGate)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/booking_link_handler.go:590 BookingLinkHandler.SeekerCustomLinkView`

**Path params**
- `code` (string) solver_booking_links.link_code (trimmed)

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "code": "string",
    "solver": {
      "id": "string<uuid>",
      "name": "string (full name, else pseudo name, else \"Solver\")",
      "avatar_url": "string (raw solvers.avatar_url)",
      "bio": "string",
      "rating": "number",
      "sessions": "integer",
      "verified": "boolean (solver verification_level standard|full)"
    },
    "session": {
      "title": "string",
      "description": "string (omitempty)",
      "duration_minutes": "integer",
      "price_per_minute": "number",
      "total_price": "number",
      "currency": "string",
      "expires_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
      "seats_left": "integer | null (omitempty)",
      "scheduled_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
      "session_mode": "string",
      "wallet_minutes": "integer"
    },
    "allowed_modes": [
      "string"
    ],
    "availability": [
      {
        "start": "string<date-time>",
        "end": "string<date-time>"
      }
    ],
    "kyc_required": "boolean",
    "kyc_grace_hours": "integer"
  }
}
```
_Pinned slot (scheduled_at set): availability [] and allowed_modes [session_mode]. Legacy link without scheduled_at: availability computed from solver windows minus confirmed bookings (min notice/max advance/buffer from slug-link settings, defaults 15 min / 30 days / 0) and allowed_modes ["meet","chat"]. session_mode defaults to "meeting". total_price = custom_price x duration. wallet_minutes = duration_minutes. kyc_required true when seeker verification level is below 'standard'. kyc_grace_hours = configured grace hours (default 24)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `link code required` - empty :code
- 404: `LINK_NOT_FOUND` - unknown code or solver card missing; body also has message "booking link not found"
- 410: `LINK_INACTIVE` - link is_active=false; message "this booking link is no longer active"
- 410: `LINK_EXPIRED` - expires_at <= now; message "this booking link has expired"
- 410: `LINK_FULL` - bookings_used >= max_bookings; message "this booking link has reached its maximum bookings"
- 500: `internal error` - repository error
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window and the path is not in VerificationLockAllowedPaths and does not contain the graced booking id; body also carries error_code "VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message "Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - RequireCompleteProfile: seeker's mandatory profile fields are missing and usecases.ProfileGateAllows(method,path) is false; body also has error_code "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete:true, mandatory_missing_fields:[string]

**Side effects:** May call EnsureScheduleHorizon for the solver (legacy links without a pinned slot). Otherwise read-only.

**Live check 2026-10-06:** status_verified - seeker -> 404 (matches doc)

**Not determinable from code:**
- Per-route bookingRateLimiter is in the 2nd positional slot (Get(path, bookingRateLimiter, handler)) and never runs.
- solver.avatar_url is returned as the raw DB value; no URL resolution in this path (may be an R2 object key).

_data is always an array (empty [] when none). review is only attached when rating, review_helpful and review_learning_outcome are all non-null. recording only when session.recording_url is non-empty (transcript_language fixed 'en-US'). currency='INR' when seeker country unknown or INR; display_amount/fx_rate_applied only for non-INR countries with successful FX conversion. solver_name falls back to 'Solver' when the card lookup fails. seeker_alias only on anonymous bookings. solver_skills carries omitempty (json:"solver_skills,omitempty"), so it is absent when the solver card has no skills._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace lock and the request path neither starts with an allowed prefix nor contains the graced booking id. Body also carries error_code:"VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message:"Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - RequireCompleteProfile: seeker has missing mandatory profile fields and usecases.ProfileGateAllows(method,path) is false for this path. Body also carries error_code:"PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete:true, mandatory_missing_fields:[string]

Body also carries restricted:true, feature:"booking", source, reason (when set), expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true
- 500: `Failed to retrieve booking history` - service/repo failure; NOTE: status=in_progress passes the handler allowlist but the repository rejects it ('invalid booking status filter'), so ?status=in_progress always yields this 500

**Side effects:** None (read-only).

request.description:
Creates a booking (normal/anonymous/group/podcast, chat or meeting) for the seeker, freezing wallet minutes and creating a session row in one transaction; supports solver auto-assignment and custom booking-link codes.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(booking)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/booking_handler.go:299 BookingHandler.CreateBooking`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "solver_id": "string<uuid> | null",
  "booking_type": "string enum: normal|anonymous|group|podcast",
  "session_mode": "string enum: chat|meeting",
  "title": "string",
  "scheduled_start_time": "string<date-time>",
  "local_date": "string<date> (omitempty)",
  "local_time": "string (omitempty)",
  "timezone": "string (omitempty)",
  "duration_minutes": "integer",
  "group_size": "integer (omitempty)",
  "group_participant_ids": [
    "string<uuid>"
  ],
  "description": "string | null (omitempty)",
  "category": "string (omitempty)",
  "sub_category": "string (omitempty)",
  "idempotency_key": "string",
  "recording_consent": "boolean | null (omitempty)",
  "payment_mode": "string (omitempty) enum: pay_all|split",
  "booking_link_code": "string (omitempty)"
}
```
**Required:** booking_type, session_mode, title, duration_minutes, idempotency_key, scheduled_start_time OR (local_date + local_time + timezone)
**Validation:**
- Body must decode as JSON else 400 'Invalid request format'
- local_date/local_time/timezone: all three or none; partial -> 400; triple + scheduled_start_time together -> 400
- timezone must be an IANA name (time.LoadLocation); local_date+local_time parsed with layout '2006-01-02 15:04' in that zone, then converted to UTC
- validator tags (any failure -> 400 'Invalid booking parameters'): booking_type required oneof=normal anonymous group podcast; session_mode required oneof=chat meeting; title required min=3 max=255; local_date len=10; local_time len=5; timezone max=64; duration_minutes required min=10 max=480; group_size min=2 max=8; group_participant_ids max=8; description max=1000; category/sub_category max=100; idempotency_key required min=1 max=64; payment_mode oneof=pay_all split; booking_link_code min=6 max=20
- title and description are TrimSpace'd; description control chars (<32 except \n\r\t) stripped; service caps description at 2000
- Service: duration must be 10..180 (stricter than the 480 tag); podcast >= 60; anonymous <= 60
- Service: podcast requires session_mode=meeting and recording_consent=true; recording_consent ignored for other types
- Service: is_anonymous/is_group derived from booking_type only (never from request)
- Service: group: group_size (or len(group_participant_ids)) 2..8; payment_mode defaults pay_all; payment_mode on non-group -> error
- Service: start not more than 2 min in the past, not more than 30 days ahead; group >= 6h ahead; solver's min_advance_booking_minutes applies (except custom-link bookings)
- Service: KYC — non-anonymous, non-custom-link bookings require seeker verification level 'full'
- Service: booking_link_code overrides solver, booking_type(normal), title, duration, session_mode, start time and clears group fields
- Service: no solver_id -> random available solver for the slot (filtered by category/sub_category when given)
- Service pricing: solver_price below 1 is raised to 1, above 100 -> 400 'solver pricing exceeds maximum allowed rate (₹100/min)'; price_multiplier = max(1, solver_price / platform_settings(pricing, base_minute_value)) with default 5 when the setting is missing/invalid

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "booking_id": "string<uuid>",
    "session_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
    "booking_type": "string",
    "session_mode": "string",
    "scheduled_start_time": "string<date-time>",
    "duration_minutes": "integer",
    "minutes_deducted": "integer",
    "price_multiplier": "number",
    "status": "string enum: confirmed|pending",
    "invite_code": "string (omitempty)",
    "invite_url": "string (omitempty)",
    "solver_online": "boolean | null (omitempty)",
    "solver_price_per_min": "number | null (omitempty)",
    "total_cost": "number | null (omitempty)",
    "solver_presence_warning": "string | null (omitempty)"
  }
}
```
_Serialized as domain.APIResponse. booking_type is stored as 'individual' when 'normal' was sent. Individual/anonymous/podcast -> status 'confirmed'; group -> 'pending'. invite_code (32 hex chars) / invite_url ('/join/<code>') only for group bookings. solver_price_per_min/total_cost only for anonymous. solver_presence_warning only when solver is offline and the session starts within 2h. Idempotent replay (same idempotency_key for this seeker) returns 201 with only booking_id, session_id, booking_type, scheduled_start_time, duration_minutes, status populated (session_mode '', minutes_deducted 0, price_multiplier 0). price_multiplier = max(1, solver_price / base_minute_value) where base_minute_value is platform_settings(pricing, base_minute_value) read via WalletService.GetBaseMinuteValueINR (default 5.0 on lookup/parse failure); minutes_deducted per seat = ceil(duration_minutes * price_multiplier), x anonymous multiplier for anonymous, x group_size for pay_all groups._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace lock and the request path neither starts with an allowed prefix nor contains the graced booking id. Body also carries error_code:"VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message:"Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - RequireCompleteProfile: seeker has missing mandatory profile fields and usecases.ProfileGateAllows(method,path) is false for this path. Body also carries error_code:"PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete:true, mandatory_missing_fields:[string]
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(booking): feature 'booking' is restricted for the user/role/platform. Body also carries restricted:true, feature:"booking", source, reason (when set), expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true
- 400: `Invalid request format` - body not valid JSON
- 400: `Incomplete timezone payload - local_date, local_time and timezone must all be provided together` - partial local triple
- 400: `Send either scheduled_start_time OR (local_date + local_time + timezone) - not both` - both formats sent
- 400: `Invalid timezone - must be an IANA name (e.g. Asia/Kolkata)` - bad timezone
- 400: `Invalid local date/time - expected YYYY-MM-DD and HH:MM` - unparseable local date/time
- 400: `Missing scheduled start time - send either scheduled_start_time or (local_date + local_time + timezone)` - no start time
- 400: `Invalid booking parameters` - validator tag failure
- 409: `you have a completed session that still needs a review — please review it before booking a new one | you have N completed sessions that still need a review — please review them before booking a new one` - PendingReviewBlockError: caller owes a mandatory review. Body: {success:false, error, code:"pending_review_block", pending_count:integer, oldest_session_id:string<uuid>, role:"seeker"}
- 400: `you must complete KYC verification (identity and document) before booking a session` - non-anonymous booking and seeker level != full
- 400: `this booking link no longer exists | this booking link is no longer active | this booking link has expired | you cannot book your own link | this booking link has no session time set - ask the solver to update it | this session time has already passed | this booking link is fully booked | booking links are unavailable right now` - booking_link_code checks
- 400: `podcast bookings are only available as video meetings | podcast bookings require you to accept that the session will be recorded` - podcast rules
- 400: `title must be between 3 and 255 characters | duration must be a positive number | duration must be between 10 and 180 minutes | podcast bookings require a minimum duration of 60 minutes | anonymous bookings must be between 10 and 60 minutes | description must not exceed 2000 characters` - service input checks
- 400: `group booking requires at least 2 participants | group bookings cannot exceed 8 participants | invalid payment_mode: must be 'pay_all' or 'split' | payment_mode is only valid for group bookings` - group checks
- 400: `cannot book sessions in the past | cannot book sessions more than 30 days in advance | group bookings must be scheduled at least 6 hours in advance` - time checks
- 400: `no solver verified in <category> → <sub_category> is available at the requested time. Please choose a different time slot or focus area | no solver verified in <category> is available at the requested time. Please choose a different time slot or skill | no solvers available at the requested time. Please choose a different time slot or select a specific solver | solver_id is required when auto-assignment is not available` - auto-assignment found nobody
- 400: `you cannot book a session with yourself | this solver is not currently available for bookings` - self booking / solver not fully verified
- 409: `This solver has not finished setting up their profile and cannot take bookings yet. Please choose a different solver.` - ErrSolverProfileIncomplete (error_code SOLVER_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE)
- 400: `you have reached the maximum of N active bookings. Please complete or cancel existing bookings first` - MAX_ACTIVE_BOOKINGS_PER_SEEKER > 0 and reached
- 400: `no solvers available for anonymous booking at this time. Please try again or choose a specific solver | no availability at the requested time. Please choose a different time or solver | this solver is currently unavailable. Please choose a different time or solver` - solver anonymous setting off / daily cap or min-notice / presence hard-block
- 400: `solver pricing exceeds maximum allowed rate (₹100/min) | unable to verify solver availability, please try again later` - pricing / availability lookup failure
- 409: `The solver is not available at the requested time. Please choose a different slot.` - ErrSolverUnavailable (availability re-check inside tx)
- 409: `You already have a session booked during this time. Please pick a slot that does not overlap your existing sessions.` - seeker overlap (error_code SEEKER_DOUBLE_BOOKED)
- 409: `This time slot is already booked. Please choose a different time.` - solver overlap / GiST exclusion (ErrSlotAlreadyBooked)
- 400: `insufficient Synap Minutes balance for this booking | failed to reserve wallet balance, please try again` - wallet freeze failure
- 400: `Failed to create booking` - internal failures whose message contains 'something went wrong'

**Side effects:** In one DB tx: INSERT bookings (held->confirmed for non-group, pending for group), wallet freeze of minutes_deducted (ceil(duration*max(1, solver_price/base_minute_value)) where base_minute_value = platform_settings(pricing, base_minute_value), default 5, x anonymous multiplier for anonymous, x group_size for pay_all groups), INSERT sessions (status scheduled), outbox event booking.confirmed (non-group) or booking.intent (group). Post-commit: custom-link seat claim/attach + KYC grace window for unverified seekers, wallet freeze event, hold-expiration scheduling for pending group bookings, group invite row (booking_invites), async availability integration (calendar carve + reminders).

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- price_multiplier / minutes_deducted (response fields and the wallet freeze) are now computed against the admin-set base minute value platform_settings(pricing, base_minute_value) via resolveBaseMinuteValueINR (default 5.0 on failure) instead of a fixed ₹5 base

**Not determinable from code:**
- Booking-link seat/grace internals (customLinks, customLinkGrace) not traced beyond the service call sites.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** no

```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "booking_id": "string<uuid>",
    "solver_id": "string<uuid>",

    "session_mode": "string",

    "face_verified_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",

    "solver_face_verified": "boolean",
    "solver_face_verified_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
    "solver_face_verify_status": "string | null (omitempty)",
    "face_verify_blocked": "boolean",
    "is_group": "boolean",
    "recording_consent": "boolean",
    "minutes_deducted": "integer",
    "price_multiplier": "number",
    "session_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
    "session_status": "string | null (omitempty)",
    "extension_status": "string | null (omitempty) enum: pending|approved|declined|expired",
    "extension_remaining_seconds": "integer | null (omitempty)",
    "extension_extra_minutes": "integer | null (omitempty)",
    "review": {
      "rating": "integer",
      "helpful": "string (omitempty)",
      "unclear": "string (omitempty)",
      "would_book_again": "boolean | null (omitempty)",
      "feedback": "string (omitempty)",
      "learning_outcome": "string (omitempty)"
    },
    "recording": {
      "has_recording": "boolean",
      "view_url": "string",
```

_solver_price / platform_fee / solver_earnings (omitempty) are never set on this seeker path, so they never serialize. review (object|null, omitempty) only when session.rating is set; recording (object|null, omitempty) only when recording_url non-empty. A pending extension whose expires_at has passed is reported as 'expired'. currency/display_amount only when timezone lookup succeeds and fxService is wired._

- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace lock and the request path neither starts with an allowed prefix nor contains the graced booking id. - 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(booking): feature 'booking' is restricted for the user/role/platform. Body also carries restricted:true, feature:"booking", source, reason (when set), expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true
- 400: `Invalid booking ID` - :booking_id is not a valid UUID
- 404: `Booking not found` - booking row not found (ErrBookingNotFound)
- 403: `You are not authorized to perform this action` - caller is not the owning participant (ErrUnauthorized)

request.description:
Moves one of the seeker's live bookings to a new start time after availability/overlap checks.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(booking); RateLimitBooking(RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_ACTION_PER_MIN, default 10/min per IP)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/booking_handler.go:1050 BookingHandler.RescheduleBooking`

**Path params**
- `booking_id` (string<uuid>) bookings.id

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "new_scheduled_start_time": "string<date-time>",
  "new_local_date": "string<date>",
  "new_local_time": "string",
  "timezone": "string"
}
```
**Required:** new_scheduled_start_time OR (new_local_date + new_local_time + timezone)
**Validation:**
- validator: new_local_date len=10, new_local_time len=5, timezone max=64 (failure -> 400 'Invalid reschedule parameters')
- partial local triple -> 400; when full triple present it wins over new_scheduled_start_time
- timezone must be IANA; date/time parsed with '2006-01-02 15:04'
- Service: booking must be confirmed|pending|held; original start must be >= 1h away; new start not in the past; group bookings >= 6h ahead; solver min advance notice and availability must pass

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "booking_id": "string<uuid>",
    "old_scheduled_start_time": "string<date-time>",
    "new_scheduled_start_time": "string<date-time>",
    "booking_status": "string",
    "seeker_timezone": "string (omitempty)",
    "seeker_local_start_time": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
    "solver_timezone": "string (omitempty)",
    "solver_local_start_time": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)"
  }
}
```

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace lock and the request path neither starts with an allowed prefix nor contains the graced booking id. Body also carries error_code:"VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message:"Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - RequireCompleteProfile: seeker has missing mandatory profile fields and usecases.ProfileGateAllows(method,path) is false for this path. Body also carries error_code:"PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete:true, mandatory_missing_fields:[string]
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(booking): feature 'booking' is restricted for the user/role/platform. Body also carries restricted:true, feature:"booking", source, reason (when set), expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - Per-IP booking rate limiter exceeded (body also has retry_after). X-RateLimit-Limit / X-RateLimit-Remaining / X-RateLimit-Reset / Retry-After headers are set on every response through this limiter
- 400: `Invalid booking ID` - :booking_id is not a valid UUID
- 400: `Invalid request format` - body not valid JSON
- 400: `Invalid reschedule parameters` - validator failure
- 400: `Incomplete reschedule payload - new_local_date, new_local_time and timezone must all be provided together` - partial triple
- 400: `Invalid timezone - must be an IANA name (e.g. Asia/Kolkata)` - bad timezone
- 400: `Invalid local date/time - expected YYYY-MM-DD and HH:MM` - bad local date/time
- 400: `Missing new scheduled start time - send either new_scheduled_start_time or (new_local_date + new_local_time + timezone)` - no time given
- 404: `Booking not found` - booking row not found (ErrBookingNotFound)
- 403: `You are not authorized to perform this action` - caller is not the owning participant (ErrUnauthorized)
- 400: `This booking has been cancelled and cannot be rescheduled.` - status cancelled
- 400: `This booking has been completed and cannot be rescheduled.` - status completed
- 400: `This action is not allowed for the current booking status.` - status declined/expired/other, or DB update found it no longer reschedulable
- 409: `This session starts in less than an hour and can no longer be rescheduled.` - original start < 1h away (error_code RESCHEDULE_WINDOW_CLOSED)
- 400: `Cannot schedule a session in the past. Please select a future time.` - new time in the past
- 400: `group bookings must be scheduled at least 6 hours in advance` - group within 6h
- 409: `The solver is not available at the requested time. Please choose a different slot.` - min notice / availability check fails
- 400: `unable to verify solver availability, please try again later` - availability lookup error
- 409: `This time slot is already booked. Please choose a different time.` - solver overlap
- 409: `You already have a session booked during this time. Please pick a slot that does not overlap your existing sessions.` - seeker overlap (error_code SEEKER_DOUBLE_BOOKED)
- 400: `insufficient Synap Minutes balance for the new schedule | failed to adjust wallet for reschedule | Failed to reschedule booking` - wallet delta adjust failure / internal errors

**Side effects:** Tx: UPDATE bookings start/end; recompute minutes for plain individual bookings and unfreeze/freeze the delta (with booking audit log). Post-commit: publishes booking.rescheduled event with per-party local times.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

request.description:
Verifies the Razorpay payment for the seeker's slug-link booking, confirms it and returns the hydrated booking detail.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); tzMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile(profileGate); RequireFeatureAccess(booking) via bookings.Use; RateLimitBooking(RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_ACTION_PER_MIN, per IP)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/booking_link_handler.go:267 BookingLinkHandler.SeekerVerifyPayment`

**Path params**
- `id` (string<uuid>) booking id; overrides any booking_id in the body

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "booking_id": "string<uuid> (ignored; replaced by :id)",
  "razorpay_order_id": "string",
  "razorpay_payment_id": "string",
  "razorpay_signature": "string"
}
```
**Required:** razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature
**Validation:**
- razorpay_order_id/razorpay_payment_id/razorpay_signature validate:required
- booking_id set from path then validate:required
- razorpay_order_id must equal the booking's stored link order id
- Razorpay signature verified

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "booking": {
      "id": "string<uuid>",
      "solver_pseudo_name": "string",
      "solver_avatar_url": "string",
      "session_mode": "string enum: chat|meet",
      "scheduled_start_time": "string<date-time>",
      "duration_minutes": "integer",
      "status": "string",
      "amount_paise": "integer",
      "currency": "string",
      "is_guest_booking": "boolean",
      "chat_thread_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
      "livekit_room_name": "string (omitempty)",
      "seeker_joined_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
      "solver_joined_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
      "session_started_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
      "session_ended_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
      "guest_token_expires_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)"
    },
    "magic_link": "string",
    "thank_you_message": "string | null"
  }
}
```
_Idempotent: if booking already confirmed/in_progress/completed returns success without re-verifying. magic_link is "" for authed seekers (no guest token). thank_you_message from the solver's booking-link settings (null if unset)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `invalid booking id` - :id not a UUID
- 400: `<bind/validator error text>` - malformed body or missing razorpay_* fields
- 404: `booking not found` - no link booking with this id
- 403: `user is not a participant of this booking` - booking.seeker_id != caller
- 400: `booking is not in a valid state for this action` - status not pending_payment (and not already confirmed/in_progress/completed)
- 400: `invalid payment signature` - order id mismatch or bad Razorpay signature
- 500: `internal error` - payment gateway unavailable or repository/tx error
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(booking): feature 'booking' restricted for the caller; body also has restricted:true, feature:"booking", source, reason (if set), expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - per-IP limiter exceeded; body also has retry_after (duration string); X-RateLimit-* and Retry-After headers set
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window and the path is not in VerificationLockAllowedPaths and does not contain the graced booking id; body also carries error_code "VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message "Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."

**Side effects:** Tx: MarkBookingConfirmed (payment id + signature), chat mode creates chat thread, best-effort AppendLinkMinuteLedger; after commit invalidates public view cache, emits EventSolverBookingLinkConfirmed, AfterCustomLinkConfirmed opens a KYC grace window for custom-link bookings (booking_link_id set) of seekers below 'standard' and emits EventSeekerKYCGraceStarted.

**Not determinable from code:**
- requireLight (2nd positional slot) never runs.
- Profile gate allows this path (profileGateBookingAction regex); verification lock allows it only when the path contains the graced booking id.
- GetLinkBookingByID does not filter link_source; non-link bookings owned by the seeker fail with 'invalid payment signature' (no link_order_id).

request.description:
Authenticated seeker books a slot through a solver's slug booking link; creates a pending_payment booking and a Razorpay order.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); tzMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile(profileGate); RequireFeatureAccess(booking) via bookings.Use; RateLimitBooking(RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_ACTION_PER_MIN, per IP)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/booking_link_handler.go:244 BookingLinkHandler.SeekerCreateFromLink`

**Path params**
- `slug` (string) solver booking-link slug; lower-cased and trimmed by the service

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "slot_time": "string<date-time>",
  "duration_minutes": "integer",
  "session_mode": "string enum: chat|meet",
  "pre_booking_answers": [
    {
      "q": "string",
      "a": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```
**Required:** slot_time, duration_minutes, session_mode
**Validation:**
- slot_time validate:required
- duration_minutes validate:required,gte=1,lte=180
- session_mode validate:required,oneof=chat meet
- duration_minutes must be in link's allowed_durations; session_mode must be in allowed_modes
- slot_time >= now + min_notice_minutes and <= now + max_advance_days
- pre_booking_answers items accept {q,a} or {question,answer} (custom UnmarshalJSON); len <= number of link questions; answers paired by index, client question text ignored, each answer trimmed and truncated to 2000 chars
- requested slot must fit inside a free availability slot (re-checked inside the tx)

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "booking_id": "string<uuid>",
    "razorpay_order_id": "string",
    "amount": "integer",
    "currency": "string",
    "key_id": "string",
    "guest_access_token": "string (omitempty)"
  }
}
```
_amount is in smallest currency unit (ComputeBookingPrice(price_per_minute, duration, price_overrides)); guest_access_token never set on this authed path._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `<go-playground/fiber error text>` - body bind or validator failure (err.Error() returned verbatim)
- 404: `booking link settings not found` - no settings for slug
- 400: `booking link is disabled` - settings.enabled=false
- 400: `duration is not allowed for this link` - duration not in allowed_durations
- 400: `session mode is not allowed for this link` - mode not in allowed_modes
- 400: `slot is in the past or within minimum notice` - slot before min notice
- 400: `slot exceeds maximum advance window` - slot after max advance
- 400: `booking is not in a valid state for this action: too many pre-booking answers (max N)` - more answers than questions
- 409: `SLOT_UNAVAILABLE` - slot not free (pre-check or in-tx re-check)
- 409: `You already have a session booked during this time. Please pick a slot that does not overlap it.` - seeker overlap rejection on insert (ErrSeekerSlotConflict); body also has error_code SEEKER_DOUBLE_BOOKED
- 500: `internal error` - payment gateway unavailable, Razorpay order failure, repository/tx errors
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(booking): feature 'booking' restricted for the caller; body also has restricted:true, feature:"booking", source, reason (if set), expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - per-IP limiter exceeded; body also has retry_after (duration string); X-RateLimit-* and Retry-After headers set
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window and the path is not in VerificationLockAllowedPaths and does not contain the graced booking id; body also carries error_code "VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message "Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - RequireCompleteProfile: seeker's mandatory profile fields are missing and usecases.ProfileGateAllows(method,path) is false; body also has error_code "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete:true, mandatory_missing_fields:[string]

**Side effects:** Creates Razorpay order (notes booking_id/slug/type=booking_link); inserts bookings row (link_source='link', status pending_payment, pre_booking_answers jsonb) in a tx; invalidates the public view cache for the slug; emits EventSolverBookingLinkCreated.

- requireLight is in the 2nd positional slot (Post(path, requireLight, bookingRateLimiter, handler)) so it never runs: no KYC level is enforced on this endpoint.

request.description:
Toggles the caller's reaction on a content item: adds one when the caller has none, otherwise removes the existing one.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker, solver, admin | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireCompleteProfile (profile gate; evaluated for seekers only); RequireVerification(standard) (admins bypass)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/content_handler.go:755 ContentHandler.ToggleReaction`

**Path params**
- `content_id` (string<uuid>) parsed with uuid.Parse; invalid -> 400

**Query params**
- `type` (string) required=False default=like used only when the JSON body is absent/invalid or has an empty reaction_type; enum: like|love|insightful|helpful

**Request body** (application/json (optional)) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "reaction_type": "string enum: like|love|insightful|helpful"
}
```
**Validation:**
- body reaction_type wins over ?type; default 'like'
- value must be one of like|love|insightful|helpful (checked before the toggle)
- toggle is keyed on (content_id, user_id) only: an existing reaction of any type is removed

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "liked": "boolean",
  "message": "string enum: Reaction added|Reaction removed"
}
```
_liked=true when a reaction was added_

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - RequireCompleteProfile: a seeker whose mandatory profile fields are not all filled in. Body adds error_code "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete: true, mandatory_missing_fields: [string].
- 403: `This feature requires identity verification. Please complete KYC verification to access bookings, payments, and communities.` - RequireVerification: caller's verification_level is below 'standard'. Body adds exploration_mode: true, verification_level, required_level: "standard".
- 403: `Unable to verify account status` - RequireVerification: verification level lookup failed
- 403: `Invalid verification level` - RequireVerification: stored level is not light|standard|full (and not empty)
- 400: `Invalid content ID` - content_id is not a UUID
- 404: `Content not found` - content missing or soft-deleted (owner lookup failed)
- 403: `You cannot react to your own content` - caller is the content owner
- 400: `invalid reaction type` - reaction type not in like|love|insightful|helpful (error_code "INVALID_REACTION_TYPE")
- 500: `Failed to toggle reaction` - DB/outbox failure (error_code "INTERNAL_ERROR")

**Side effects:** INSERT (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) or DELETE content_reactions; like_count maintained by DB trigger; content.reaction.added / content.reaction.removed event via generic outbox in the same tx when wired.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/content/{id}/react` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:23)
**Evidence:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/routes/routes.go:574`, `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/content_handler.go:755-810`, `Backend/internal/core/usecases/content_service.go:2499-2559`, `Backend/internal/adapter/db/postgres/content_repository.go:734-756`

```json

  "success": "boolean",
  "message": "string (\"Content unsaved\")"
}
```

request.description:
Mints a 7-day share link token for a published content item (or the caller's own content).

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile (seeker profile gate); RequireVerification(standard) (per-route, variadic slot: runs)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/content_extended_handler.go:145 ContentExtendedHandler.ShareContent`

**Path params**
- `content_id` (string<uuid>) parsed with uuid.Parse; invalid -> 400

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "share_token": "string",
    "share_url": "string",
    "share_id": "string<uuid>"
  }
}
```
_share_token is 32 hex chars (16 random bytes). share_url = "<SEEKER_APP_URL>/shared/<share_token>" (cfg.Frontend.SeekerURL, trailing '/' trimmed) — the Seeker app page that redeems the token; empty string when SEEKER_APP_URL is not configured. Link expires 7 days after creation._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker inside an open custom-booking-link KYC grace window (path not in the allow-list and not the graced booking). Body adds error_code "VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message "Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - RequireCompleteProfile: a seeker whose mandatory profile fields are not all filled in. Body adds error_code "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete: true, mandatory_missing_fields: [string].
- 403: `This feature requires identity verification. Please complete KYC verification to access bookings, payments, and communities.` - RequireVerification: caller's verification_level is below 'standard'. Body adds exploration_mode: true, verification_level, required_level: "standard".
- 403: `Unable to verify account status` - RequireVerification: verification level lookup failed
- 403: `Invalid verification level` - RequireVerification: stored level is not light|standard|full (and not empty)
- 401: `Authentication required` - handler-level check: user_id missing from request locals
- 400: `Invalid content ID` - content_id is not a UUID
- 500: `Failed to create share link` - caller is not the owner and the content is not published (ErrShareNotAllowed has no case in writeContentExtendedError, so it reaches this generic branch), content missing/soft-deleted (pgx 'no rows in result set' does not contain 'not found'), token generation or insert failure (error_code "INTERNAL_ERROR")
- 404: `Content not found` - DB error text contains 'not found' or 'violates foreign key' (error_code "CONTENT_NOT_FOUND")

**Side effects:** Reads content (solver_id, status) where deleted_at IS NULL; INSERT content_shares (share_url column stored as '/shared/<token>', expires_at = now + 7d); fire-and-forget content.shared event carrying share_token.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- data.share_url is now "<SEEKER_APP_URL>/shared/<share_token>" (Seeker app redeem page), or "" when SEEKER_APP_URL is not configured; previously "/api/v1/public/shared/<share_token>"
- Not-owner + unpublished content (ErrShareNotAllowed) now returns 500 "Failed to create share link" (INTERNAL_ERROR): writeContentExtendedError has no ErrShareNotAllowed case; previously documented as 403 "you do not have access to share this content"

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/seeker/contentextended/{id}/share` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:55)

request.description:
Preview heartbeat: charges server-measured viewing time against the seeker's 10-minute/24h free preview and returns the new usage.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile (seeker profile gate)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/content_extended_handler.go:333 ContentExtendedHandler.ConsumePreviewTime`

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "minutes_used": "number",
    "max_minutes": "number",
    "remaining_minutes": "number",
    "is_preview_exhausted": "boolean",
    "reset_at": "string<date-time>"
  }
}
```
_Charge recorded, cap not reached._

**Response 402** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean (false)",
  "error": "string (\"preview time exhausted, subscription required\")",
  "error_code": "string (\"PREVIEW_EXHAUSTED\")",
  "data": {
    "minutes_used": "number",
    "max_minutes": "number",
    "remaining_minutes": "number",
    "is_preview_exhausted": "boolean",
    "reset_at": "string<date-time>"
  }
}
```
_minutes_used reached 10 after this charge; data holds the usage._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker inside an open custom-booking-link KYC grace window (path not in the allow-list and not the graced booking). Body adds error_code "VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message "Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - RequireCompleteProfile: a seeker whose mandatory profile fields are not all filled in. Body adds error_code "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete: true, mandatory_missing_fields: [string].
- 401: `Authentication required` - handler-level check: user_id missing from request locals
- 500: `Failed to record preview usage` - upsert failed (error_code "INTERNAL_ERROR")

**Side effects:** Upserts seeker_preview_usage in one statement: charges 0.25 min when there is no metering point in the last 45s, else the real elapsed time since last_metered_at; rolls the window when reset_at has passed (reset_at = now + 24h); clamps minutes_used at 10; sets last_metered_at = NOW(). No request body is read.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

request.description:
Lists the seeker's named content folders with item counts.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile (seeker profile gate)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/content_extended_handler.go:389 ContentExtendedHandler.GetFolders`

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "string<uuid>",
      "user_id": "string<uuid>",
      "name": "string",
      "item_count": "integer",
      "created_at": "string<date-time>",
      "updated_at": "string<date-time>"
    }
  ]
}
```
_Ordered by created_at. data is null (nil slice) when the seeker has no folders. item_count = saved_content rows with that folder_id; updated_at falls back to created_at._

- 401: `Authentication required` - handler-level check: user_id missing from request locals
- 500: `Failed to get folders` - query failed (error_code "INTERNAL_ERROR")

**Side effects:** None (read-only).

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile (seeker profile gate)

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json

  "content_id": "string<uuid>",
  "folder_id": "string<uuid> | null"
}
```
**Required:** content_id
**Validation:**
- content_id: validate:"required" (nil UUID fails)
- folder_id: optional; absent/null targets the default bucket (folder_id IS NULL)
- a non-UUID string in either field fails JSON binding -> 'Invalid request format'

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "message": "string (\"Content saved to folder\")"
}
```
_Idempotent: a repeat save is a no-op (WHERE NOT EXISTS for the default bucket, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for folders) and still returns 200._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker inside an open custom-booking-link KYC grace window (path not in the allow-list and not the graced booking). Body adds error_code "VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message "Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."

- 400: `content_id is required` - validator failure
- 403: `folder not found or not owned by user` - folder_id given but not owned by the caller (error_code "FOLDER_NOT_OWNED")
- 409: `content already saved to this folder` - duplicate-key error (error_code "CONTENT_ALREADY_SAVED")
- 409: `<raw DB error message>` - other insert failure, e.g. FK violation for an unknown content_id (error_code "SAVE_FAILED")

**Side effects:** INSERT saved_content (folder_name = folder's name or 'Default', folder_id or NULL). Content visibility/status is not checked.

request.description:
Creates (or idempotently returns) a pending Razorpay order for a minute pack, applying an optional coupon and GST.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); tzMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile(profileGate); RequireFeatureAccess(wallet) via seekerPayments.Use; RateLimitPayment(RATE_LIMIT_PAYMENT_PER_15MIN, per user, 15m)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/payment_handler.go:30 PaymentHandler.BuyMinutes`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "minute_pack_id": "string<uuid>",
  "coupon_code": "string",
  "currency": "string"
}
```
**Required:** minute_pack_id
**Validation:**
- minute_pack_id validate:required
- coupon_code validate:omitempty,min=3,max=50 (upper-cased+trimmed before lookup)
- currency validate:omitempty,len=3; non-INR must be in allowedCurrencyCodes
- pack must exist and be active
- coupon must exist, be active, unexpired, applies_to minute_packs|both (or empty), under max_usage and per_user_limit
- total (price + GST) must not exceed maxMinutePackAmount safety cap

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "order_id": "string<uuid>",
    "status": "string",
    "base_amount": "number",
    "discount_amount": "number",
    "tax_amount": "number",
    "total_amount": "number",
    "currency_code": "string",
    "gateway_order_id": "string",
    "razorpay_key_id": "string (omitempty)",
    "gateway_amount": "integer",
    "display_amount": "number | null (omitempty)",
    "display_currency": "string (omitempty)",
    "fx_rate_applied": "number | null (omitempty)",
    "coupon_minutes": "integer",
    "total_minutes": "integer",
    "tax_percentage": "number",
    "expires_at": "string<date-time>"
  }
}
```
_Identical request (seeker+pack+currency+coupon) within 5 minutes returns the existing pending order. Unsupported-by-Razorpay currency or international disabled or stale FX rate -> charged in INR (display_* carry the requested currency when convertible). expires_at = created_at + 30 min. total_minutes = base + bonus + coupon bonus._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid request format` - body bind failure
- 400: `Validation failed: minute_pack_id is required` - any validator failure
- 404: `Minute pack not found` - pack missing or inactive
- 400: `Invalid coupon code` - coupon not found
- 400: `Coupon has expired` - coupon expired
- 400: `Coupon usage limit reached` - current_usage >= max_usage
- 400: `Coupon is not active` - coupon inactive
- 503: `Payment gateway temporarily unavailable. Please try again.` - Razorpay CreateOrder failed
- 500: `Failed to create payment order. Please try again or contact support.` - any other error: subscription-only coupon, per-user coupon limit, unsupported currency, tax config unavailable, safety cap, FX conversion failure/out-of-bounds rate, persistence failure
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(wallet): feature 'wallet' restricted for the caller; body also has restricted:true, feature:"wallet", source, reason (if set), expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true
- 429: `Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.` - per-user limiter exceeded (userOrIPRateLimit keyed by user_id); body also has retry_after_seconds
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window and the path is not in VerificationLockAllowedPaths and does not contain the graced booking id; body also carries error_code "VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message "Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - RequireCompleteProfile: seeker's mandatory profile fields are missing and usecases.ProfileGateAllows(method,path) is false; body also has error_code "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete:true, mandatory_missing_fields:[string]

**Side effects:** Expires superseded pending orders for the same idempotency key; creates Razorpay order; inserts payment_orders row (status pending, order_type minute_pack). No wallet credit until verify/webhook.

request.description:
Creates a pending subscription enrollment and a Razorpay order for a plan (monthly/yearly), applying launch discount, optional coupon and GST.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); tzMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile(profileGate); RequireFeatureAccess(wallet) via seekerPayments.Use; RequireVerification(full); RateLimitPayment(RATE_LIMIT_PAYMENT_PER_15MIN, per user, 15m)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/payment_handler.go:346 PaymentHandler.BuySubscription`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "plan_id": "string<uuid>",
  "billing_cycle": "string enum: monthly|yearly",
  "currency": "string",
  "coupon_code": "string (omitempty)"
}
```
**Required:** plan_id, billing_cycle
**Validation:**
- plan_id validate:required
- billing_cycle validate:required,oneof=monthly yearly
- currency validate:omitempty,len=3; non-INR must be in allowedCurrencyCodes
- coupon_code validate:omitempty,max=64 (upper-cased+trimmed)
- optional header X-Idempotency-Key (truncated to 128 bytes) returns an existing pending order with that key
- no active subscription expiring more than 7 days out; no pending enrollment
- plan must exist (fresh read) and be active
- coupon must exist, be active, unexpired, applies_to subscription_plans|both, under max_usage and per-user limit
- total must not exceed maxSubscriptionAmount

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "order_id": "string<uuid>",
    "enrollment_id": "string<uuid>",
    "plan_name": "string",
    "billing_cycle": "string",
    "base_amount": "number",
    "discount_amount": "number",
    "tax_amount": "number",
    "total_amount": "number",
    "currency_code": "string",
    "gateway_order_id": "string",
    "razorpay_key_id": "string (omitempty)",
    "gateway_amount": "integer",
    "display_amount": "number | null (omitempty)",
    "display_currency": "string (omitempty)",
    "fx_rate_applied": "number | null (omitempty)"
  }
}
```
_discount_amount = launch_discount_pct of base; coupon contributes bonus minutes (not money). Tax falls back to 0% if tax config unreadable._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid request format` - body bind failure
- 400: `Validation failed: plan_id and billing_cycle are required` - validator failure
- 409: `You already have an active subscription` - active subscription with > 7 days left
- 404: `Subscription plan not found` - plan lookup failed
- 400: `Subscription plan is not active` - plan inactive
- 502: `Payment gateway temporarily unavailable` - Razorpay CreateOrder failed (enrollment set to cancelled)
- 500: `<service error text>` - any other error returned verbatim, e.g. "a subscription purchase is already in progress", "unsupported currency code: X", "coupon not found", "coupon is not active", "coupon has expired", "coupon does not apply to subscriptions", "coupon usage limit reached", "subscription amount exceeds safety limit, please contact support", "currency conversion unavailable, please try again", "exchange rate outside acceptable bounds", "failed to create enrollment", "failed to create payment order"
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(wallet): feature 'wallet' restricted for the caller; body also has restricted:true, feature:"wallet", source, reason (if set), expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true
- 403: `This feature requires identity verification. Please complete KYC verification to access bookings, payments, and communities.` - RequireVerification(full): caller's verification level is below 'full'; body also has exploration_mode:true, verification_level, required_level:"full". Same middleware also returns 403 "Unable to verify account status" (level lookup error) or "Invalid verification level" (unknown level)
- 429: `Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.` - per-user limiter exceeded (userOrIPRateLimit keyed by user_id); body also has retry_after_seconds
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window and the path is not in VerificationLockAllowedPaths and does not contain the graced booking id; body also carries error_code "VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message "Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - RequireCompleteProfile: seeker's mandatory profile fields are missing and usecases.ProfileGateAllows(method,path) is false; body also has error_code "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete:true, mandatory_missing_fields:[string]

**Side effects:** Inserts subscription_enrollments (pending_payment, auto_renew true), creates Razorpay order, inserts payment_orders (order_type subscription).
