request.description:
Client-side Razorpay verification for a minute-pack order: marks it paid and credits wallet minutes in one transaction.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); tzMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile(profileGate); RequireFeatureAccess(wallet) via seekerPayments.Use; RateLimitPaymentVerify(10/min, per user)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/payment_handler.go:108 PaymentHandler.VerifyPayment`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "order_id": "string<uuid>",
  "gateway_payment_id": "string",
  "gateway_signature": "string"
}
```
**Required:** order_id, gateway_payment_id, gateway_signature
**Validation:**
- order_id validate:required
- gateway_payment_id validate:required,min=1,max=255
- gateway_signature validate:required,min=1,max=512
- order must belong to caller
- order age <= 30 min (60 min for subscription orders)
- Razorpay signature over gateway_order_id|payment_id

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "message": "string"
  }
}
```
_message = "Payment verified and minutes credited". Also returned idempotently when the order is already 'paid' (e.g. webhook processed first)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid request format` - body bind failure
- 400: `Validation failed: order_id, gateway_payment_id and gateway_signature are required` - validator failure
- 404: `Payment order not found` - order missing or owned by another seeker
- 409: `Payment already completed` - order status not pending and not paid (ErrOrderAlreadyPaid)
- 400: `Invalid payment signature` - signature mismatch
- 500: `Failed to verify payment` - order expired (also force-marks it 'expired'), status transition/credit/receipt/commit failure
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(wallet): feature 'wallet' restricted for the caller; body also has restricted:true, feature:"wallet", source, reason (if set), expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true
- 429: `Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.` - per-user limiter exceeded (userOrIPRateLimit keyed by user_id); body also has retry_after_seconds
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window and the path is not in VerificationLockAllowedPaths and does not contain the graced booking id; body also carries error_code "VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message "Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - RequireCompleteProfile: seeker's mandatory profile fields are missing and usecases.ProfileGateAllows(method,path) is false; body also has error_code "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete:true, mandatory_missing_fields:[string]

**Side effects:** Single tx: payment_orders -> paid, wallet credit (money INR + base+bonus+coupon minutes, reason minute_pack_purchase:order_<id>), coupon redemption (savepoint), payment transaction receipt. On failure after capture parks the order as captured-but-unapplied for reconcile. Post-commit: wallet cache invalidation + minute-pack purchased event.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); tzMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile(profileGate); RequireFeatureAccess(wallet) via seekerPayments.Use; RequireVerification(full); RateLimitPaymentVerify(10/min, per user)

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "order_id": "string<uuid>",
  "gateway_payment_id": "string",
  "gateway_signature": "string"
}
```

**Validation:**
- order_id validate:required
- gateway_payment_id validate:required,min=1,max=255
- gateway_signature validate:required,min=1,max=512
- order must belong to caller
- order age <= 60 min for subscription orders (30 for others)

```json
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "message": "string"
  }
}
```

- 409: `Payment already completed` - order status not pending/paid
- 400: `Invalid payment signature` - signature mismatch
- 500: `Failed to verify subscription payment` - expired order (marked expired), enrollment missing/unexpected state, activation failure (triggers auto-refund), credit/receipt/commit failure
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(wallet): feature 'wallet' restricted for the caller; body also has restricted:true, feature:"wallet", source, reason (if set), expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true
- 403: `This feature requires identity verification. Please complete KYC verification to access bookings, payments, and communities.` - RequireVerification(full): caller's verification level is below 'full'; body also has exploration_mode:true, verification_level, required_level:"full". Same middleware also returns 403 "Unable to verify account status" (level lookup error) or "Invalid verification level" (unknown level)

- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window and the path is not in VerificationLockAllowedPaths and does not contain the graced booking id; body also carries error_code "VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message "Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - RequireCompleteProfile: seeker's mandatory profile fields are missing and usecases.ProfileGateAllows(method,path) is false; body also has error_code "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete:true, mandatory_missing_fields:[string]

**Side effects:** Tx: order -> paid, enrollment activated (re-pends a sweeper-cancelled enrollment < 24h old), coupon usage, coupon bonus minutes, plan free minutes, receipt. Activation failure -> refund. Post-commit: wallet cache invalidation, subscription reward, NotifySubscriptionRenewed.

request.description:
Schedules the seeker account for permanent deletion after a ~6-month (180-day) cooling-off period, after password re-check.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/seeker_profile_handler.go:553 SeekerProfileHandler.DeleteAccount`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "confirmation_text": "string (must equal \"DELETE MY ACCOUNT\")",
  "current_password": "string"
}
```
**Required:** confirmation_text, current_password
**Validation:**
- validate: confirmation_text required,eq=DELETE MY ACCOUNT; current_password required -> 400 'Validation failed. Please check your input' (the later explicit confirmation check is unreachable)

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",

    "success": "boolean",
    "message": "string",
```

request.description:
Partially updates the seeker's personal info (only fields that differ from the stored value are written) and returns the refreshed profile plus mandatory-profile verdict.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(profile_edit)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/seeker_profile_handler.go:237 SeekerProfileHandler.UpdatePersonalInfo`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "first_name": "string | null",
  "last_name": "string | null",
  "bio": "string | null",
  "country": "string | null",
  "city": "string | null",
  "gender": "string | null enum: male|female|other|prefer_not_to_say (lower-cased before validation)",
  "date_of_birth": "string<date> | null (YYYY-MM-DD)",
  "phone": "string | null (E.164)",
  "phone_country_code": "string | null (accepted, max 5, IGNORED - derived from country)",
  "timezone": "string | null (IANA)"
}
```
**Validation:**
- empty strings for phone, country, city, gender, date_of_birth, bio are treated as absent (first_name/last_name/timezone are not)
- tags: first_name/last_name omitempty,min=1,max=50; bio max=1000; country min=2,max=50; city min=2,max=100; gender oneof; date_of_birth datetime=2006-01-02; phone e164; phone_country_code max=5; timezone max=50 -> 400 '<Field label> is not valid. Please check the format and try again'
- first_name: 2-50 letters, no digits/special chars (utils.ValidateFirstName); last_name: 1-50 (ValidateLastName); city 2-100 (ValidateCity); names are normalised
- bio trimmed; 30-1000 chars and must read as prose (utils.ValidateBio)
- country can only be set once (when stored country is empty); must resolve to a known ISO code with a currency ('Please select your country from the list'); currency is derived; seeker_settings.country synced
- date_of_birth: real date, not in future, age 13..100; locked once verification_level is standard/full and a DOB is stored
- phone validated against the country's length rule (ValidatePhoneForCountry); dial code stored from country
- timezone canonicalised; must load and contain '/', and lie inside the country ('The selected timezone is not in your country...'); if country set first time and stored tz not in it: single-zone country auto-sets, multi-zone -> 'Please select your timezone - <country> has more than one'
- field-rule failures return 400 with the rule's own message

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "success": "boolean",
    "message": "string (\"Profile updated successfully\")",

      "email": "string<email>",
      "first_name": "string (omitempty)",
      "last_name": "string (omitempty)",

      "phone": "string (omitempty)",
      "phone_country_code": "string (omitempty; dial code derived from country)",
      "new_email": "string (omitempty)",
      "referral_code": "string (omitempty)",
      "date_of_birth": "string<date-time> (omitempty)",
      "country": "string (omitempty)",
```

_A save with no changed fields performs no write and still returns 200._

**Endpoint-specific errors**

- 400: `Invalid request data. Please check your input` - JSON bind fails
- 400: `<Field label> is not valid. Please check the format and try again` - validate-tag failure (label from profileFieldLabel)
- 400: `<field rule message>` - ProfileValidationError from utils name/bio/city/DOB/phone/timezone/country rules

- 400: `One of the fields is too long. Please shorten it and try again` - Postgres SQLSTATE 22001
- 500: `Unable to update profile` - other repository errors

request.description:
Changes the seeker's password after verifying the current one, then invalidates all sessions and emails a notification.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(profile_edit)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/seeker_profile_handler.go:374 SeekerProfileHandler.ChangePassword`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "current_password": "string",
  "new_password": "string",
  "confirm_password": "string"
}
```
**Required:** current_password, new_password, confirm_password
**Validation:**
- validate: current_password required,min=8; new_password and confirm_password required,min=12,max=128
- new_password must equal confirm_password
- new_password != current_password
- utils.ValidatePassword: 12-128 chars, upper, lower, digit, special, must not contain the email, HIBP breach check (fail-open)

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "success": "boolean",
    "message": "string (\"Password changed successfully. All sessions have been invalidated. Please log in again.\")"
  }
}
```

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(profile_edit): feature blocked for the user (source user) / platform_all / platform_seeker|platform_solver; body also has restricted: true, feature: "profile_edit", source, optional reason, expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent: true
- 400: `Invalid request data. Please check your input` - JSON bind fails
- 400: `Validation failed. Please check your input` - validate-tag failure
- 400: `New password and confirm password do not match` - mismatch
- 401: `The current password you entered is incorrect` - current password wrong
- 400: `New password must be different from current password` - same password
- 400: `This password has appeared in known data breaches and should not be used` - HIBP hit
- 400: `password must be at least 12 characters | password must contain at least one uppercase letter | ... | password must not contain email address` - complexity rule failed (utils.ErrPassword* text)
- 500: `Unable to change password` - other errors

**Side effects:** Updates users password hash (Argon2id); invalidates all user sessions (best-effort); async password-change notification email.

```json
}
```

```json
{
  "success": "boolean",

  }
```

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "pseudo_name": "string"
}
```
**Required:** pseudo_name
**Validation:**
- validate: required,min=3,max=20
- utils.ValidatePseudoName: trimmed, 3-20 chars of [A-Za-z0-9._-], no reserved words, no profanity
- uniqueness is case-insensitive across both roles; keeping the name already held is not a clash

```json
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "success": "boolean",
    "message": "string (\"Pseudo name customized successfully and locked\")",
    "pseudo_name": "string",
    "is_locked": "boolean (true)"
  }
}
```

- 400: `Validation failed. Please check your input` - validate-tag failure
- 400: `Your pseudo name has already been customized and cannot be changed` - is_locked already true

request.description:
Converts reward points into wallet minutes at the admin-configured rate, crediting only whole minutes.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireVerification(standard)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/seeker_extended_handler.go:319 SeekerExtendedHandler.ConvertPoints`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "points": "integer"
}
```
**Required:** points
**Validation:**
- validator.Struct: points required,min=1 (failure message says 'at least 100' but the tag is min=1)
- usable = floor(points / rate) * rate where rate = reward_configurations points_per_minute (100 if <=0); usable <= 0 -> 400 'Minimum 100 points required for conversion' (message hard-codes 100 regardless of rate)
- only `usable` points are deducted; the remainder stays in the balance

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "points_deducted": "integer",
    "minutes_credited": "integer"
  }
}
```

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker-group RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-booking-link KYC grace window and the path is not under VerificationLockAllowedPaths(); body also has error_code "VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message "Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - seeker-group RequireCompleteProfile: mandatory profile fields missing and the path is not exempted by ProfileGateAllows; body also has error_code "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete: true, mandatory_missing_fields: [string]
- 403: `This feature requires identity verification. Please complete KYC verification to access bookings, payments, and communities.` - RequireVerification(standard): verification level below standard; body also has exploration_mode: true, verification_level, required_level: "standard"
- 403: `Unable to verify account status` - RequireVerification: level lookup failed
- 403: `Invalid verification level` - RequireVerification: unknown non-empty level
- 400: `Invalid request body` - JSON bind fails
- 400: `Validation failed: points is required and must be at least 100` - points missing/0/negative
- 400: `Minimum 100 points required for conversion` - points < configured rate
- 400: `Insufficient reward points` - reward_wallets.total_points < usable (conditional UPDATE affected 0 rows, including when no reward_wallets row exists)
- 500: `Failed to convert points` - any other DB error in the transaction

**Side effects:** Single transaction: reward_wallets.total_points -= usable; lock-or-create seeker wallet; insert seeker_wallet_ledger REWARD_CONVERT row (minutes_delta=minutes, idempotency key reward_convert:<id>); set seeker_wallets.minutes_balance; insert seeker_rewards row reward_type 'conversion', status 'redeemed'. After commit the wallet cache is invalidated.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); tzMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile(profileGate); RequireVerification(standard) via rewards.Use

```json
{
  "solver_public_id": "string<uuid>",
  "violation_type": "string enum: inappropriate_behavior|no_show|poor_quality|spam|harassment|fake_content|other",
  "details": "string",
  "evidence_urls": [
    "string<url>"
  ]
}
```
**Required:** solver_public_id, violation_type, details
**Validation:**
- solver_public_id validate:required,uuid
- violation_type validate:required,oneof=... plus ValidSolverReportViolationTypes allowlist
- details validate:required,min=10,max=2000
- evidence_urls validate:omitempty,dive,url,max=512

```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "report_id": "string<uuid>",
  "status": "string",
  "message": "string"
}
```
_Top-level fields (no data wrapper). status = report status ("pending"). message = "Report submitted successfully. Reward will be issued after admin validation."_

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid request body` - body bind failure
- 400: `Validation failed: solver_public_id (uuid), violation_type, details (10-2000 chars) are required` - validator failure
- 400: `Unknown violation_type` - violation_type not in ValidSolverReportViolationTypes
- 400: `Invalid solver_public_id` - uuid.Parse fails
- 409: `A pending report already exists for this solver` - pending report exists for this seeker/solver pair; body also has report_id of the existing report
- 503: `Reporting temporarily unavailable` - report repository not wired
- 500: `Failed to submit report` - unknown solver public id or any other repository error
- 403: `This feature requires identity verification. Please complete KYC verification to access bookings, payments, and communities.` - RequireVerification(standard): caller's verification level is below 'standard'; body also has exploration_mode:true, verification_level, required_level:"standard". request.description:
Uploads a chat attachment to R2, stores it as a file-type chat message and broadcasts it to the session in real time.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(chat)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/chat_handler.go:198 ChatHandler.UploadFile`

**Path params**
- `session_id` (string<uuid>) sessions.id (not booking id); parsed with uuid.Parse

**Request body** (multipart/form-data) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "file": "file (required)",
  "client_message_id": "string<uuid> (optional form field; invalid value is logged and ignored)"
}
```
**Required:** file
**Validation:**
- file.Size > 25 MiB (domain.MaxChatFileSize) -> 400
- file name sanitized; empty -> error
- type derived from content + extension (detectChatFileType) and must be in AllowedChatFileTypes: jpg/jpeg, png, gif, webp, bmp, svg, pdf, doc, xls, ppt, docx, xlsx, pptx, rtf, txt, csv, md/markdown, py, js, json, xml, html/htm, zip, rar, 7z, tar, gz/tgz, mp3, m4a, wav, ogg/oga, mp4, mov, webm, avi; the declared Content-Type is ignored
- per user+session file rate limit CHAT_FILE_UPLOAD_RATE_LIMIT (default 30) per rolling 1-minute window
- service call bounded by a 5-minute context

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "id": "string<uuid>",
    "session_id": "string<uuid>",
    "sender_id": "string<uuid>",
    "sender_role": "string",
    "message_type": "string",
    "content": "string",
    "file_url": "string (omitempty)",
    "file_name": "string (omitempty)",
    "file_size": "integer (omitempty)",
    "reply_to_id": "string<uuid> (omitempty)",
    "is_edited": "boolean",
    "edited_at": "string<date-time> (omitempty)",
    "is_deleted": "boolean",
    "deleted_at": "string<date-time> (omitempty)",
    "client_message_id": "string<uuid> (omitempty)",
    "metadata": "string (omitempty)",
    "created_at": "string<date-time>",
    "reactions": [
      {
        "emoji": "string",
        "count": "integer",
        "user_ids": [
          "string<uuid>"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "delivery_status": {
      "delivered_to": "integer",
      "read_by": "integer",
      "all_read": "boolean"
    },
    "reply_preview": {
      "id": "string<uuid>",
      "sender_role": "string",
      "content": "string",
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}
```
_message_type='file', content=file_name=sanitized name, file_url = auth-proxy path (see below). Retry with the same client_message_id by the same sender in the same session returns the existing message (201) without re-uploading. reactions/delivery_status/reply_preview are omitempty; delivery_status and reply_preview are never populated on these code paths. file_url: chat/ keys are private (utils.IsPrivateFileKey), so TransformR2URL rewrites the stored R2 key to the authenticated proxy path '/api/v1/files/secure?key=<url.QueryEscape(key)>' (not a presigned R2 URL); an already-absolute http(s) URL is left unchanged._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid session ID` - session_id is not a UUID
- 400: `File is required` - no 'file' form field
- 400: `File size exceeds 25MB limit` - file.Size > 25*1024*1024
- 500: `Failed to read uploaded file` - multipart file could not be opened/read fully
- 404: `failed to verify session participation: session not found` - session_id does not exist (error text passed through)
- 403: `You are not a participant of this session` - caller is neither the booking's seeker nor solver
- 412: `solver face verification required before uploading files | face verification required before uploading files` - same face rules as chat send; body adds error_code:'FACE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED'
- 409: `Session is not active` - session status completed or cancelled (no time-window check on this path)
- 400: `file type is not allowed, or the file's content does not match its extension` - content/extension check failed
- 429: `file upload rate limit exceeded - please wait a minute` - file_upload_count over limit
- 500: `file uploads are not configured | invalid file name | failed to upload file, please try again | failed to save file message: ...` - unmapped service errors (raw text via handleChatError default)
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - feature 'chat' is blocked for the user/role (RequireFeatureAccess). Body also has restricted:true, feature:'chat', source, optional reason, and expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true. Fails open on lookup error.
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window. No allowed prefix covers /api/v1/seeker/sessions, and sessions.id is always generated independently of the booking id (uuid.NewV7 in BookingService / gen_random_uuid in the schema backfill), so the graced-booking substring exemption never matches this path: a locked seeker is always refused here. Body: {success:false,error:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',error_code:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',message:'Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected.'}

**Side effects:** Upserts chat_rate_limits.file_upload_count; uploads object to R2 under chat/<session_id>/...; INSERT session_chats row (message_type=file); on DB failure deletes the R2 object async; publishes ChatEvent 'chat.message' with file_url rewritten to the /api/v1/files/secure?key=... proxy path (stored column keeps the raw R2 key) (sender_id zeroed for anonymous). Per-route chatRateLimiter in 2nd slot does not execute.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- correction: AuthMiddleware is registered once on the seeker group (routes.go:195); the previous text said it was registered twice
- correction: VERIFICATION_LOCKED is unconditional for a locked seeker on this path - sessions.id is never the booking id (fresh uuid v7 / gen_random_uuid), so the graced-booking exemption cannot match; the previous unresolved item is closed
- correction: file_url in the response (and in the chat.message WS payload) is the authenticated proxy path /api/v1/files/secure?key=<QueryEscape(R2 key)>, not a presigned R2 URL (chat/ is a private key prefix)

request.description:
Registers the caller in the session's WebSocket chat room, promotes the session to active, starts the per-session timer broadcast and posts a one-time '<role> has joined' system message.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(chat)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/chat_handler.go:570 ChatHandler.JoinChat`

**Path params**
- `session_id` (string<uuid>) sessions.id (not booking id); parsed with uuid.Parse

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "message": "string"
  }
}
```
_data.message = 'Joined session chat'_

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid session ID` - session_id is not a UUID
- 404: `failed to verify session participation: session not found` - session_id does not exist (error text passed through)
- 403: `You are not a participant of this session` - caller is neither the booking's seeker nor solver
- 410: `this session has ended` - session status completed/cancelled, or now is after scheduled_start + duration + extended_minutes
- 409: `<PendingReviewBlockError message>` - solver owes a mandatory review for another session (EnsureSolverMayEnterSession). Body adds code:'pending_review_block', pending_count, oldest_session_id, role
- 412: `<service message containing 'face verification required'>` - solver: bookings.solver_face_verified false (always, anonymous included); seeker: non-anonymous booking, face_verified false and SeekerFacePolicy requires it. Body adds error_code:'FACE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED'
- 425: `chat opens 3 minutes before the session - please wait in the lobby` - now < bookings.scheduled_start_time - 3 min
- 500: `<raw service error text>` - any unmapped service error; handleChatError's default returns err.Error() directly (not the global 'Internal server error')
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - feature 'chat' is blocked for the user/role (RequireFeatureAccess). Body also has restricted:true, feature:'chat', source, optional reason, and expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true. Fails open on lookup error.
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window. No allowed prefix covers /api/v1/seeker/sessions, and sessions.id is always generated independently of the booking id (uuid.NewV7 in BookingService / gen_random_uuid in the schema backfill), so the graced-booking substring exemption never matches this path: a locked seeker is always refused here. Body: {success:false,error:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',error_code:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',message:'Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected.'}

**Side effects:** hub.JoinSession (in-memory WS room); sessionActivator.JoinSession (scheduled -> active, records join time; best-effort); starts 10s session.timer broadcast goroutine; inserts a deterministic-client_message_id system chat message '<role> joined' once per session+role and publishes it (best-effort).

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- correction: AuthMiddleware is registered once on the seeker group (routes.go:195); the previous text said it was registered twice
- correction: VERIFICATION_LOCKED is unconditional for a locked seeker on this path - sessions.id is never the booking id (fresh uuid v7 / gen_random_uuid), so the graced-booking exemption cannot match; the previous unresolved item is closed

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/seeker/sessions/{id}/chat/join` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:99)

request.description:
Sends a text/code/link/system chat message in a session (file messages are rejected here), with idempotency on client_message_id.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(chat)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/chat_handler.go:33 ChatHandler.SendMessage`

**Path params**
- `session_id` (string<uuid>) sessions.id (not booking id); parsed with uuid.Parse

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "content": "string",
  "message_type": "string enum: text|file|code|link|system",
  "file_url": "string<url> (omitempty)",
  "file_mime_type": "string (omitempty)",
  "file_size_bytes": "integer (omitempty)",
  "reply_to_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
  "client_message_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
  "metadata": "string | null (omitempty)"
}
```
**Required:** message_type, content (unless file_url set)
**Validation:**
- content: required_without=FileURL, max=4096
- message_type: required, oneof=text file code link system
- file_url: omitempty,url,max=2048
- file_mime_type: omitempty,max=128
- file_size_bytes: omitempty,min=0
- metadata: omitempty,max=2048 (HTML-sanitized before storage)
- content is HTML-tag-stripped and trimmed; empty after sanitizing with message_type=text -> error; longer than ChatConfig.MaxMessageLength (default 4096) -> error
- message_type=file always rejected ('files must be sent with the file upload endpoint')
- per user+session DB rate limit: CHAT_MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT (default 60) messages per rolling 1-minute window

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "message_id": "string<uuid>",
    "session_id": "string<uuid>",
    "sender_role": "string",
    "message_type": "string",
    "content": "string",
    "client_message_id": "string<uuid> (omitempty)",
    "created_at": "string<date-time>"
  }
}
```
_If client_message_id matches an existing non-deleted message by the same sender in the same session, that message is returned (still 201) and nothing is written._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid session ID` - session_id is not a UUID
- 400: `Invalid request body` - body is not valid JSON
- 400: `Validation failed` - validator.Struct failed; body adds 'details' (validator.ValidationErrors marshalled as-is)
- 404: `failed to verify session participation: session not found` - session_id does not exist (error text passed through)
- 403: `You are not a participant of this session` - caller is neither the booking's seeker nor solver
- 412: `<service message containing 'face verification required'>` - solver: bookings.solver_face_verified false (always, anonymous included); seeker: non-anonymous booking, face_verified false and SeekerFacePolicy requires it. Body adds error_code:'FACE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED'
- 409: `Session is not active` - session status completed/cancelled (or not active/scheduled/pending), or now > scheduled_start + duration + extended_minutes
- 425: `chat opens 3 minutes before the session - please wait in the lobby` - now < bookings.scheduled_start_time - 3 min
- 429: `rate limit exceeded, please slow down` - message_count in the current 1-minute window exceeds CHAT_MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT
- 500: `message content cannot be empty | message exceeds maximum length | files must be sent with the file upload endpoint` - these service errors are not mapped by handleChatError and fall to its 500 default with the raw text
- 500: `<raw service error text>` - any unmapped service error; handleChatError's default returns err.Error() directly (not the global 'Internal server error')
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - feature 'chat' is blocked for the user/role (RequireFeatureAccess). Body also has restricted:true, feature:'chat', source, optional reason, and expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true. Fails open on lookup error.
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window. No allowed prefix covers /api/v1/seeker/sessions, and sessions.id is always generated independently of the booking id (uuid.NewV7 in BookingService / gen_random_uuid in the schema backfill), so the graced-booking substring exemption never matches this path: a locked seeker is always refused here. Body: {success:false,error:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',error_code:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',message:'Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected.'}

**Side effects:** Upserts chat_rate_limits.message_count; INSERT session_chats row (UUID v7); ensureHubPresence; publishes ChatEvent 'chat.message' (sender_id zeroed for anonymous bookings; fire-and-forget). Per-route chatRateLimiter is registered in the 2nd positional slot and does not execute (Fiber v3).

```json
{
  "is_typing": "boolean"
}
```
**Validation:**
- body optional; when the body is empty is_typing defaults to true

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean"
}
```
_Always {success:true} once the session_id parses and the body (if any) is valid JSON; service errors (not a participant, publish failure) are only logged._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid session ID` - session_id is not a UUID
- 400: `Invalid request body` - non-empty body that is not valid JSON
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - feature 'chat' is blocked for the user/role (RequireFeatureAccess).     "request_id": "string<uuid>",

```json
    "remaining_minutes": "integer",

    "ended_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
    "message": "string (omitempty)"
  }
}
```
_status 'pending_approval'; requested_by_role = caller role; remaining_seconds = approval window (platform_settings session.early_end_approval_timeout_seconds, 30..600, default 120); message 'Waiting for the other participant to approve'._

request.description:
Approves or declines the other participant's pending early-end proposal; approval completes the session with a pro-rated settlement.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RateLimitBooking(RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_ACTION_PER_MIN, default 10/min per IP)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/booking_handler.go:1337 BookingHandler.RespondEndSessionRequest`

**Path params**
- `session_id` (string<uuid>) sessions.id

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "approve": "boolean"
}
```
**Validation:**
- Body must be valid JSON (empty body fails decode -> 400 'Invalid request format'); missing approve = false = decline

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "request_id": "string<uuid>",
    "session_id": "string<uuid>",
    "status": "string enum: pending_approval|approved|declined|expired|cancelled|none",
    "requested_by_role": "string (omitempty) enum: seeker|solver",
    "total_minutes": "integer",
    "elapsed_minutes": "integer",
    "remaining_minutes": "integer",
    "seeker_refund_minutes": "integer",
    "solver_credit_minutes": "integer",
    "remaining_seconds": "integer (omitempty)",
    "ended_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
    "message": "string (omitempty)"
  }
}
```
_Decline: status 'declined', message 'The session will continue for its full booked time'. Approve: status 'approved', settlement recomputed at approval time, ended_at set, message 'Session ended early — N minute(s) returned to the seeker's wallet'._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace lock and the request path neither starts with an allowed prefix nor contains the graced booking id. Body also carries error_code:"VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message:"Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - Per-IP booking rate limiter exceeded (body also has retry_after). X-RateLimit-Limit / X-RateLimit-Remaining / X-RateLimit-Reset / Retry-After headers are set on every response through this limiter
- 400: `Invalid session ID` - :session_id is not a valid UUID
- 400: `Invalid request format` - body not valid JSON
- 403: `Ending a session early is not enabled on this platform.` - platform_settings(session, early_end_enabled) is not true (code: early_end_disabled)
- 404: `Session not found` - session row not found (ErrSessionNotFound)
- 403: `You are not authorized to perform this action` - caller is not the owning participant (ErrUnauthorized)
- 404: `Booking not found` - booking row not found (ErrBookingNotFound)
- 404: `There is no end-session request awaiting your response.` - no pending request or lost race (code early_end_not_found)
- 403: `The other participant has to approve this request.` - caller raised the request (code early_end_self_approval)
- 410: `The end-session request has expired. The session is continuing.` - request past expires_at (code early_end_expired)
- 409: `<reason>` - approve on a non-live session ('the session is no longer live') or settlement no longer eligible (code early_end_not_eligible)
- 400: `session already completed` - approve: the request was claimed but finalizeSession lost the conditional completion flip to a concurrent end/sweeper (ErrSessionAlreadyCompleted is not mapped, falls to the default branch)
- 400: `Failed to respond to the end-session request` - internal failure

**Side effects:** Decline: resolve request 'declined', booking audit 'early_end_declined', publish session.end_declined. Approve: resolve 'approved' with settlement, finalizeSession (session+booking completed, early-end audit columns, solver credited used minutes and seeker refunded remainder via idempotent wallet ops, session.completed event, rewards/streak), publish session.end_approved.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- correction: added 400 'session already completed' (finalizeSession race on approve passes through handleBookingError's default branch); code unchanged

request.description:
Requests extra session time (pending solver approval) and freezes the extension's wallet minutes.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/booking_handler.go:1497 BookingHandler.ExtendSession`

**Path params**
- `session_id` (string<uuid>) sessions.id

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "extra_minutes": "integer"
}
```
**Required:** extra_minutes
**Validation:**
- validator: extra_minutes required min=10 max=60 (failure -> 400 'Invalid extension parameters')
- Service: session must be active; only within the last 5 minutes before session end; booking duration + extensions + extra <= MAX_SESSION_MINUTES_TOTAL (default 240); no other pending non-expired request

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "request_id": "string<uuid>",
    "new_duration_minutes": "integer",
    "minutes_reserved": "integer (omitempty)",
    "remaining_seconds": "integer",
    "status": "string enum: pending_approval|approved|declined",
    "new_end_time_utc": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
    "seeker_timezone": "string (omitempty)",
    "seeker_local_end_time": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
    "solver_timezone": "string (omitempty)",
    "solver_local_end_time": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)"
  }
}
```
_status 'pending_approval'; new_duration_minutes is the prospective total; minutes_reserved = frozen wallet minutes; remaining_seconds = EXTENSION_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (default 120). Time fields absent._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace lock and the request path neither starts with an allowed prefix nor contains the graced booking id. Body also carries error_code:"VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message:"Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - RequireCompleteProfile: seeker has missing mandatory profile fields and usecases.ProfileGateAllows(method,path) is false for this path. Body also carries error_code:"PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete:true, mandatory_missing_fields:[string]
- 400: `Invalid session ID` - :session_id is not a valid UUID
- 400: `Invalid request format` - body not valid JSON
- 400: `Invalid extension parameters` - validator failure
- 404: `Session not found` - session row not found (ErrSessionNotFound)
- 403: `You are not authorized to perform this action` - caller is not the owning participant (ErrUnauthorized)
- 400: `can only extend active sessions | total session time cannot exceed N minutes | an extension request is already pending for this session | insufficient Synap Minutes balance for extension | failed to reserve balance for extension | failed to retrieve booking for extension | Failed to extend session` - service checks / internal failure
- 409: `You can request extra time only in the last 5 minutes of the session. Your minutes have not been deducted.` - code extension_too_early
- 409: `The solver is not available for the extra time - they have another session booked right after this one. Your minutes have not been deducted.` - code solver_unavailable_for_extension
- 409: `You have another session booked right after this one, so this session can't run any longer. Your minutes have not been deducted.` - code seeker_busy_for_extension

**Side effects:** INSERT session_extension_requests (pending, expires_at now+timeout); keyed wallet freeze 'freeze-<booking>-ext-<request>' (request marked declined if freeze fails); schedules auto-expiry; publishes booking.extension_requested.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/seeker/sessions/{id}/extend` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:110)
**Evidence:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/routes/routes.go:433`, `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/booking_handler.go:1497`, `Backend/internal/core/usecases/booking_service.go:3386`, `Backend/internal/core/domain/booking_dto.go:256`, `Backend/internal/core/domain/booking_dto.go:474`, `Backend/internal/core/usecases/seeker_profile_service.go:456`

request.description:
Records the caller's join time and activates the session when both participants have joined (only from scheduled start until scheduled end incl. extensions).

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RateLimitBooking(RATE_LIMIT_BOOKING_ACTION_PER_MIN, default 10/min per IP)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/booking_handler.go:1193 BookingHandler.JoinSession`

**Path params**
- `session_id` (string<uuid>) sessions.id

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "session_id": "string<uuid>",
    "status": "string enum: scheduled|active",
    "both_joined": "boolean",
    "joined_at": "string<date-time>",
    "message": "string (omitempty)",
    "remaining_time_seconds": "integer",
    "total_duration_seconds": "integer",
    "session_mode": "string",
    "meeting_room_endpoint": "string (omitempty)"
  }
}
```
_domain.APIResponse. message 'Successfully joined session as <role>'. meeting_room_endpoint only for meeting mode: '/api/v1/<role>/sessions/<session_id>/meeting/room'._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace lock and the request path neither starts with an allowed prefix nor contains the graced booking id. Body also carries error_code:"VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message:"Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - Per-IP booking rate limiter exceeded (body also has retry_after). X-RateLimit-Limit / X-RateLimit-Remaining / X-RateLimit-Reset / Retry-After headers are set on every response through this limiter
- 400: `Invalid session ID` - :session_id is not a valid UUID
- 403: `User role not found in session. Please log in again. | Invalid user role` - role local missing / not seeker|solver
- 404: `Session not found` - session row not found (ErrSessionNotFound)
- 403: `You are not authorized to perform this action` - caller is not the owning participant (ErrUnauthorized)
- 400: `cannot join a session with status: <status> | failed to retrieve booking for session | the session hasn't started yet - please wait in the lobby until the scheduled start time | session join window has ended | Failed to join session` - status not scheduled/active, before scheduled start, after end, internal failure

**Side effects:** Tx: re-check status, record seeker/solver join time, transition session to active (actual_start_time) when both joined.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/seeker/sessions/{id}/join` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:111)

Marks the participant ready in the lobby (with recording consent / notes) and reports whether both participants are ready.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/session_lobby_handler.go:128 SessionLobbyHandler.MarkReady`

**Path params**
- `session_id` (string<uuid>) sessions.id; if no session has this id the lobby service retries it as a booking id (GetSessionByBookingID), so the booking id is also accepted

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "recording_consent": "boolean",
  "notes": "string | null (omitempty)"
}
```

- Body optional (empty body skips decoding)
- notes max=4096 (failure -> 400 Validation failed)
- recording_consent must be true for podcast bookings

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "state": {
      "id": "string<uuid>",
      "session_id": "string<uuid>",
      "user_id": "string<uuid>",
      "role": "string enum: seeker|solver",
      "device_check_passed": "boolean",
      "device_check_details": {
        "camera": "boolean",
        "mic": "boolean",
        "speaker": "boolean",
        "browser": "string (omitempty)",
        "user_agent": "string (omitempty)"
      },
      "network_quality": "string | null (omitempty) enum: excellent|good|poor|failed",
      "network_details": {
        "bandwidth_mbps": "number",
        "latency_ms": "integer",
        "packet_loss_pct": "number",
        "turn_reachable": "boolean"
      },
      "face_verified": "boolean",
      "face_verified_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
      "ready_state": "string enum: waiting|ready|joined",
      "recording_consent": "boolean",
      "pre_session_notes": "string | null (omitempty)",
      "entered_lobby_at": "string<date-time>",
      "ready_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
      "joined_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
      "updated_at": "string<date-time>"
    },
    "peer_ready": "boolean",
    "both_ready": "boolean"
  }
}
```
_both_ready when >= 2 lobby rows are in ready/joined. state may be null._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace lock and the request path neither starts with an allowed prefix nor contains the graced booking id. Body also carries error_code:"VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message:"Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 400: `Invalid session ID` - :session_id is not a valid UUID
- 400: `Invalid request body` - non-empty body not valid JSON
- 400: `Validation failed` - notes too long
- 404: `Session not found` - neither a session with this id nor a session for a booking with this id exists, or its booking is missing (code: session_missing)
- 403: `You are not a participant of this session` - caller is neither the session's seeker nor solver, or (role-specific reads) caller's resolved role does not match the endpoint side
- 400: `This session is recorded. Please accept the recording notice to continue.` - podcast booking without recording_consent (code RECORDING_CONSENT_REQUIRED)
- 500: `Failed to mark ready` - any unmapped service/DB error; body also carries details:<raw error string> (written directly by handleLobbyError, not the global error handler)

**Side effects:** Ensures lobby row; UPDATE ready_state=ready with recording_consent/notes; mirrors seeker/solver ready onto sessions; WS broadcast lobby.peer.ready; when both ready, WS lobby.both_ready and event 'lobby.both_ready' via eventPublisher.

request.description:
Ends the session's meeting room for everyone (either participant may call it), marking all active participants as left.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(meeting)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/meeting_handler.go:209 MeetingHandler.EndRoom`

**Path params**
- `session_id` (string<uuid>) sessions.id (not booking id); parsed with uuid.Parse

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "session_id": "string<uuid>",
    "total_duration_seconds": "integer",
    "recording_status": "string (omitempty)",
    "message": "string"
  }
}
```
_message = 'Meeting has ended'; recording_status = 'none' unless recording enabled (then latest recording's status); total_duration_seconds = now - started_at (0 if never started)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid session ID` - session_id is not a UUID
- 403: `You are not a participant of this session` - any verifySessionParticipant failure (session missing, booking missing or non-participant) — the service wraps it as 'not a participant: ...'
- 404: `no meeting room found for session <id>: meeting room not found for session` - no meeting_rooms row for the session
- 500: `Failed to end meeting` - room already ended ('meeting room <id> has already ended' is not mapped) or DB failure
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - feature 'meeting' is blocked for the user/role (RequireFeatureAccess). Body also has restricted:true, feature:'meeting', source, optional reason, and expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true. Fails open on lookup error.
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window. No allowed prefix covers /api/v1/seeker/sessions, and sessions.id is always generated independently of the booking id (uuid.NewV7 in BookingService / gen_random_uuid in the schema backfill), so the graced-booking substring exemption never matches this path: a locked seeker is always refused here. Body: {success:false,error:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',error_code:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',message:'Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected.'}

**Side effects:** UPDATE meeting_participants left_at for all active; hub.LeaveSession for each; UPDATE meeting_rooms status ended; async 'meeting.session.ended' event + WS broadcast to the session. Does not change sessions.session_status.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- correction: AuthMiddleware is registered once on the seeker group (routes.go:195); the previous text said it was registered twice
- correction: VERIFICATION_LOCKED is unconditional for a locked seeker on this path - sessions.id is never the booking id (fresh uuid v7 / gen_random_uuid), so the graced-booking exemption cannot match; the previous unresolved item is closed

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/seeker/sessions/{id}/meeting/end` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:116)

request.description:
Joins the session's meeting room and returns a LiveKit access token plus connection details, enforcing face verification, start time, session window and capacity.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(meeting)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/meeting_handler.go:85 MeetingHandler.JoinRoom`

**Path params**
- `session_id` (string<uuid>) sessions.id (not booking id); parsed with uuid.Parse

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "recording_consent": "boolean"
}
```
**Validation:**
- empty body allowed; malformed JSON -> 400
- recording_consent is parsed but not used by MeetingService.JoinRoom

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "room_id": "string<uuid>",
    "room_name": "string",
    "token": "string",
    "livekit_url": "string",
    "features": {
      "chat": "boolean",
      "reactions": "boolean",
      "raise_hand": "boolean",
      "whiteboard": "boolean",
      "captions": "boolean",
      "recording": "boolean",
      "screen_share": "boolean"
    },
    "ice_servers": [
      {
        "urls": [
          "string"
        ],
        "username": "string (omitempty)",
        "credential": "string (omitempty)"
      }
    ],
    "participant_sid": "string (omitempty)",
    "session_duration_seconds": "integer",
    "remaining_time_seconds": "integer"
  }
}
```
_token TTL scoped to effective session end (base + approved extensions) + 10 min, capped by config TokenTTL; default 30 min. features.recording = room.recording_enabled; screen_share false only for podcast bookings; captions always false. remaining_time_seconds = effective end - now (>=0); session_duration_seconds grown to remaining when joining early. Reconnect (existing active participant row) skips face/start/capacity checks._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid session ID` - session_id is not a UUID
- 400: `Invalid request body` - non-empty body not valid JSON
- 404: `session not found: session not found` - session_id does not exist (raw error text)
- 403: `You are not a participant of this session` - caller is neither sessions.seeker_id nor sessions.solver_id
- 409: `<PendingReviewBlockError message>` - solver owes a mandatory review for another session (EnsureSolverMayEnterSession). Body adds code:'pending_review_block', pending_count, oldest_session_id, role
- 404: `no meeting room found for session <id>: meeting room not found for session` - no meeting_rooms row for the session
- 403: `face verification blocked for this booking - contact support` - bookings.face_verify_blocked; body adds error_code:'FACE_VERIFICATION_BLOCKED'
- 412: `face verification required before joining session | solver face verification required before joining session` - first join: seeker on non-anonymous booking without face_verified while SeekerFacePolicy requires it; solver without solver_face_verified. Body adds error_code:'FACE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED'
- 409: `session has not started yet - please wait in the lobby until the scheduled start time` - first join, session not active and now < scheduled_start_time. Body adds error_code:'SESSION_NOT_STARTED'
- 410: `session window has ended - cannot join` - now > effective session end + 5 min. Body adds error_code:'SESSION_WINDOW_ENDED'
- 409: `Meeting room is at maximum capacity` - new participant and active count >= max_participants
- 500: `Failed to join meeting` - unmapped: booking not found, solver already in another active session, room status not created/active, LiveKit key/secret missing, DB errors
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - feature 'meeting' is blocked for the user/role (RequireFeatureAccess). Body also has restricted:true, feature:'meeting', source, optional reason, and expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true. Fails open on lookup error.
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window. No allowed prefix covers /api/v1/seeker/sessions, and sessions.id is always generated independently of the booking id (uuid.NewV7 in BookingService / gen_random_uuid in the schema backfill), so the graced-booking substring exemption never matches this path: a locked seeker is always refused here. Body: {success:false,error:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',error_code:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',message:'Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected.'}

**Side effects:** INSERT meeting_participants (or increments join_count on reconnect); increments sessions participant_count + appends participants_joined (new participant, best-effort); sets room started (status active) when >=2 active participants + async 'meeting.session.started' event; sessionActivator.JoinSession (scheduled -> active, async retries); hub.JoinSession; async 'meeting.participant.joined' event + WS notify to peers; presence upsert 'in_meeting'. Per-route meetingRateLimiter in 2nd slot does not execute.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- correction: AuthMiddleware is registered once on the seeker group (routes.go:195); the previous text said it was registered twice
- correction: VERIFICATION_LOCKED is unconditional for a locked seeker on this path - sessions.id is never the booking id (fresh uuid v7 / gen_random_uuid), so the graced-booking exemption cannot match; the previous unresolved item is closed

**Not determinable from code:**
- The chat-mode guard (booking.SessionMode == 'chat') can never fire: MeetingRepository.GetBookingBySessionID does not SELECT session_mode, so SessionMode is always empty.

```json
}
```

request.description:
Issues a fresh LiveKit token for a participant already active in the session's meeting room.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(meeting)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/meeting_handler.go:136 MeetingHandler.RefreshToken`

**Path params**
- `session_id` (string<uuid>) sessions.id (not booking id); parsed with uuid.Parse

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "room_id": "string<uuid>",
    "room_name": "string",
    "token": "string",
    "livekit_url": "string",
    "features": {
      "chat": "boolean",
      "reactions": "boolean",
      "raise_hand": "boolean",
      "whiteboard": "boolean",
      "captions": "boolean",
      "recording": "boolean",
      "screen_share": "boolean"
    },
    "ice_servers": [
      {
        "urls": [
          "string"
        ],
        "username": "string (omitempty)",
        "credential": "string (omitempty)"
      }
    ],
    "participant_sid": "string (omitempty)",
    "session_duration_seconds": "integer",
    "remaining_time_seconds": "integer"
  }
}
```
_Same shape as join. Token TTL = effective session end + 10 min (capped by config TokenTTL), fallback 5 min. participant_sid = meeting_participants.id. session_duration_seconds is not grown for early joins here._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid session ID` - session_id is not a UUID
- 404: `not a session participant: session not found: session not found` - session_id does not exist
- 403: `You are not a participant of this session` - caller is neither sessions.seeker_id nor sessions.solver_id
- 404: `no meeting room found for session <id>: meeting room not found for session` - no meeting_rooms row for the session (message contains 'room not found', mapped to 404 by handleMeetingError)
- 500: `Failed to refresh token` - booking not found for the session, room status not active/created ('meeting room is not active, current status: ...'), caller has no active participant row ('user ... is not an active participant in room ...'), LiveKit key/secret missing, or DB error
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - feature 'meeting' is blocked for the user/role (RequireFeatureAccess). Body also has restricted:true, feature:'meeting', source, optional reason, and expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true. Fails open on lookup error.
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window. No allowed prefix covers /api/v1/seeker/sessions, and sessions.id is always generated independently of the booking id (uuid.NewV7 in BookingService / gen_random_uuid in the schema backfill), so the graced-booking substring exemption never matches this path: a locked seeker is always refused here. Body: {success:false,error:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',error_code:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',message:'Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected.'}

**Side effects:** None (read-only; token minted in memory). Per-route meetingRateLimiter in 2nd slot does not execute.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- correction: AuthMiddleware is registered once on the seeker group (routes.go:195); the previous text said it was registered twice
- correction: VERIFICATION_LOCKED is unconditional for a locked seeker on this path - sessions.id is never the booking id (fresh uuid v7 / gen_random_uuid), so the graced-booking exemption cannot match; the previous unresolved item is closed
- correction: a session with no meeting room answers 404 with the raw 'no meeting room found for session <id>: meeting room not found for session' text, not 500 'Failed to refresh token'

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/seeker/sessions/{id}/meeting/refresh` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:119)

request.description:
Creates the LiveKit meeting room record for a session (or returns the existing non-ended room).

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(meeting)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/meeting_handler.go:29 MeetingHandler.CreateRoom`

**Path params**
- `session_id` (string<uuid>) sessions.id (not booking id); parsed with uuid.Parse

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "session_id": "string<uuid> (ignored; overwritten with the path value)",
  "recording_consent": "boolean",
  "e2ee_enabled": "boolean"
}
```
**Validation:**
- empty body allowed; malformed JSON -> 400
- session_id validate:required is always satisfied because the handler sets it from the path
- e2ee_enabled=true forces E2EE; false keeps the config default
- recording only enabled if recording_consent=true (or podcast booking with podcast recording enabled) AND consent checker agrees (both participants for normal bookings; podcast rule for podcasts)

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "id": "string<uuid>",
    "session_id": "string<uuid>",
    "room_name": "string",
    "room_sid": "string (omitempty)",
    "room_status": "string",
    "max_participants": "integer",
    "recording_enabled": "boolean",
    "e2ee_enabled": "boolean",
    "created_at": "string<date-time>",
    "started_at": "string<date-time> (omitempty)",
    "ended_at": "string<date-time> (omitempty)",
    "metadata": "string (omitempty)"
  }
}
```
_Also 201 when an existing room (status != 'ended') is returned. room_name = 'session-<session_id>', room_status='created', max_participants = 2 for individual bookings / group size for group bookings, clamped to LiveKit MaxRoomSize._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid session ID` - session_id is not a UUID
- 400: `Invalid request body` - non-empty body not valid JSON
- 400: `Validation failed` - validator.Struct failed; body adds 'details'
- 404: `session not found: session not found` - session_id does not exist (raw error text)
- 403: `You are not a participant of this session` - caller is neither sessions.seeker_id nor sessions.solver_id
- 500: `Failed to create meeting room` - booking not found for session, DB insert failure, or other unmapped error
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - feature 'meeting' is blocked for the user/role (RequireFeatureAccess). Body also has restricted:true, feature:'meeting', source, optional reason, and expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true. Fails open on lookup error.
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window. No allowed prefix covers /api/v1/seeker/sessions, and sessions.id is always generated independently of the booking id (uuid.NewV7 in BookingService / gen_random_uuid in the schema backfill), so the graced-booking substring exemption never matches this path: a locked seeker is always refused here. Body: {success:false,error:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',error_code:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',message:'Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected.'}

**Side effects:** INSERT meeting_rooms (UUID v7); updates sessions.livekit_room_id (best-effort); async publishes MeetingEvent 'meeting.room.created'. Per-route meetingRateLimiter in 2nd slot does not execute.

- correction: AuthMiddleware is registered once on the seeker group (routes.go:195); the previous text said it was registered twice
- correction: VERIFICATION_LOCKED is unconditional for a locked seeker on this path - sessions.id is never the booking id (fresh uuid v7 / gen_random_uuid), so the graced-booking exemption cannot match; the previous unresolved item is closed

- The chat-mode guard (booking.SessionMode == 'chat') can never fire: MeetingRepository.GetBookingBySessionID does not SELECT session_mode, so SessionMode is always empty.

- `session_id` (string<uuid>) sessions.id (not booking id); parsed with uuid.Parse

```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "room_id": "string<uuid>",
    "room_status": "string",
    "participants": [
      {
        "user_id": "string<uuid>",
        "user_role": "string",

      }

    "remaining_time_seconds": "integer"
  }

```
_participants = rows with left_at NULL; null when none (nil slice). display_name = '<role>-<first 8 chars of user_id>'; is_audio_muted/is_video_muted/is_screen_sharing always false. recording_active true if any recording has status 'recording' or 'started'._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid session ID` - session_id is not a UUID
- 404: `session not found: session not found` - session_id does not exist (raw error text)
- 403: `You are not a participant of this session` - caller is neither sessions.seeker_id nor sessions.solver_id
- 404: `no meeting room found for session <id>: meeting room not found for session` - no meeting_rooms row for the session
- 500: `Failed to get meeting status` - booking not found or participant query failure
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - feature 'meeting' is blocked for the user/role (RequireFeatureAccess). Body also has restricted:true, feature:'meeting', source, optional reason, and expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true. Fails open on lookup error.
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window. No allowed prefix covers /api/v1/seeker/sessions, and sessions.id is always generated independently of the booking id (uuid.NewV7 in BookingService / gen_random_uuid in the schema backfill), so the graced-booking substring exemption never matches this path: a locked seeker is always refused here. Body: {success:false,error:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',error_code:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',message:'Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected.'}

request.description:
Returns the session's saved Excalidraw whiteboard scene, or an empty version-0 scene if none exists.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(meeting)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/whiteboard_handler.go:23 WhiteboardHandler.GetSnapshot`

**Path params**
- `session_id` (string<uuid>) sessions.id (not booking id); parsed with uuid.Parse

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "session_id": "string<uuid>",
    "elements": "any (raw JSON, Excalidraw elements)",
    "app_state": "any (raw JSON)",
    "version": "integer",
    "updated_by": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
    "updated_at": "string<date-time>"
  }
}
```
_No saved row -> elements=[], app_state={}, version=0, updated_by omitted, updated_at zero time (0001-01-01T00:00:00Z)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid session ID` - session_id is not a UUID
- 403: `user is not a participant of this session` - caller is neither the booking's seeker nor solver
- 500: `Failed to load whiteboard` - session_id not found (participant lookup error) or DB error
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - feature 'meeting' is blocked for the user/role (RequireFeatureAccess). Body also has restricted:true, feature:'meeting', source, optional reason, and expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true. Fails open on lookup error.
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window. No allowed prefix covers /api/v1/seeker/sessions, and sessions.id is always generated independently of the booking id (uuid.NewV7 in BookingService / gen_random_uuid in the schema backfill), so the graced-booking substring exemption never matches this path: a locked seeker is always refused here. Body: {success:false,error:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',error_code:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',message:'Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected.'}

**Side effects:** None (read-only).

**Live check 2026-10-06:** status_verified - seeker -> 500 (matches doc)
_Observation: A non-existent session id returns 500 'Failed to load whiteboard' (whiteboardError has no not-found mapping), not 404._

- correction: AuthMiddleware is registered once on the seeker group (routes.go:195); the previous text said it was registered twice
- correction: VERIFICATION_LOCKED is unconditional for a locked seeker on this path - sessions.id is never the booking id (fresh uuid v7 / gen_random_uuid), so the graced-booking exemption cannot match; the previous unresolved item is closed

variable.description: string enum: email_alerts|calendar_reminders|push_notifications|message_notifications|weekly_digest|anonymous_pool_response Exact, case-sensitive match against validTypes in SeekerSettingsService.UpdateNotificationSetting (raw c.Params value); each maps 1:1 to the same-named seeker_settings column. What each value controls (NotificationSettingsGate, notification_gate.go): email_alerts = master switch for the EMAIL channel (off = no notification email at all; extension / session.end_* prompts always delivered); push_notifications = master switch for the browser PUSH channel AND the in-app hub 'push' bucket (booking*, solver_booking*, session*, payment*, wallet*, *slot*, *earning*, *withdrawal*, *refund*, *minute_pack*, *subscription*, *proceed_to_payment*); message_notifications = 'message' bucket (community.*, content.*, chat.*, ticket.*, *message*, *comment*, *reaction*, *mention*, *follower*, *feedback*) on in-app, email and push; calendar_reminders = 'calendar' bucket (*reminder*, *session_ready*, *calendar*) on in-app, email and push; weekly_digest = stored and returned by GET /seeker/settings only - no code reads it to gate or send anything; anonymous_pool_response = stored and returned only - no code reads it. The gate fails open on lookup errors; session_completed is never suppressed on the in-app hub.

**Path params**
- `type` (string enum: email_alerts|calendar_reminders|push_notifications|message_notifications|weekly_digest|anonymous_pool_response) Exact, case-sensitive match against validTypes in SeekerSettingsService.UpdateNotificationSetting (raw c.Params value); each maps 1:1 to the same-named seeker_settings column. What each value controls (NotificationSettingsGate, notification_gate.go): email_alerts = master switch for the EMAIL channel (off = no notification email at all; extension / session.end_* prompts always delivered); push_notifications = master switch for the browser PUSH channel AND the in-app hub 'push' bucket (booking*, solver_booking*, session*, payment*, wallet*, *slot*, *earning*, *withdrawal*, *refund*, *minute_pack*, *subscription*, *proceed_to_payment*); message_notifications = 'message' bucket (community.*, content.*, chat.*, ticket.*, *message*, *comment*, *reaction*, *mention*, *follower*, *feedback*) on in-app, email and push; calendar_reminders = 'calendar' bucket (*reminder*, *session_ready*, *calendar*) on in-app, email and push; weekly_digest = stored and returned by GET /seeker/settings only - no code reads it to gate or send anything; anonymous_pool_response = stored and returned only - no code reads it. The gate fails open on lookup errors; session_completed is never suppressed on the in-app hub.

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "value": "boolean"
}
```
**Validation:**
- c.Bind().JSON; the validate:"required" tag on value is never executed (no validator call), so an omitted value is stored as false
- :type checked before any DB access

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean (true)",
  "message": "string (\"Notification setting updated successfully\")",
  "setting": "string (always \"\" - never populated)",
  "value": "boolean (always false - never populated)"
```

**Endpoint-specific errors**
