request.description:
Switches a seeker with an existing solver profile to solver mode and revokes all of the user's sessions in the same transaction.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock (applies: /api/v1/seeker/settings not allowlisted); RequireCompleteProfile (no-op: /api/v1/seeker/settings allowlisted)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/solver_application_handler.go:342 SolverApplicationHandler.SwitchToSolver`

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "message": "string",
  "data": {
    "switched_to": "string enum: solver"
  }
}
```
_message = 'Role switched. You have been logged out of all devices - please log in again.' No body is read._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker has an open custom-booking-link KYC grace lock (RequireNoVerificationLock); body {success:false,error:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',error_code:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',message:'Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected.'}
- 409: `You have active or upcoming sessions. Complete or cancel them before switching roles.` - any pending/confirmed booking (as seeker or solver) with scheduled_end_time >= NOW()
- 409: `This account has no solver profile yet. Apply to become a solver first.` - no solvers row
- 409: `Your account is not in a state that allows switching right now.` - users.role != 'seeker', users.status != 'active', or solvers.account_status != 'active' (the seekers row is only locked FOR UPDATE, its account_status is NOT checked on this path)
- 500: `Failed to switch role. Please try again.` - DB/transaction error

**Side effects:** Single transaction: locks users/solvers/seekers rows, sets solvers.is_role_switched=FALSE, users.role='solver', revokes all user_sessions and upserts revoked_sessions(reason 'role_switch_to_solver'); post-commit re-stamps the revocation store. Caller must log in again.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- correction: 409 'Your account is not in a state that allows switching right now.' is not raised for a non-active seeker profile on this path - SwitchToSolver only checks users.role/status and solvers.account_status (seekers row is locked but its status is not read)

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/seeker/settings/switchrole` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:132)

request.description:
Returns the sorted list of dates (in the seeker's timezone) in a month on which the solver has bookable availability from today on.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RateLimitAvailability
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/solver_availability_handler.go:239 SolverAvailabilityHandler.GetAvailableDates`

**Query params**
- `solver_id` (string<uuid>) required=True default=None missing -> 400 'solver_id is required'; not a UUID -> 400 'Invalid solver ID format'
- `month` (string) required=False default=current month (server time, YYYY-MM) YYYY-MM; unparsable -> 500

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": [
    "string<date>"
  ]
}
```
_Dates before today (display tz) and windows ending before the earliest bookable start are excluded. Bookings are NOT subtracted. Always an array._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker-group RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-booking-link KYC grace window and the path is not under VerificationLockAllowedPaths(); body also has error_code "VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message "Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - seeker-group RequireCompleteProfile: mandatory profile fields missing and the path is not exempted by ProfileGateAllows; body also has error_code "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete: true, mandatory_missing_fields: [string]
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - per-IP rate limiter (RateLimitAvailability, RATE_LIMIT_AVAILABILITY_READ_PER_MIN, default 30/min per IP, group-level on /seeker/solver-availability) exceeded; body also has retry_after (Go duration string); X-RateLimit-Limit/-Remaining/-Reset and Retry-After headers are set on every response through the limiter
- 400: `solver_id is required` - missing solver_id
- 400: `Invalid solver ID format` - bad UUID
- 500: `Failed to get available dates` - bad month format or window query failure

**Side effects:** ensureScheduleHorizon may extend the solver's recurring weekly pattern into solver_availability_windows (and update the schedule horizon) when it is materialised less than ~58 days ahead.

**Live check 2026-10-06:** body_verified - seeker -> 200 (matches doc)

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RateLimitAvailability
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/solver_availability_handler.go:497 SolverAvailabilityHandler.MatchSolverForSkill`

**Query params**
- `category` (string) required=False default=None skill name; trimmed; at least one of category/sub_category required; max 120 bytes
- `sub_category` (string) required=False default=None focus area; trimmed; max 120 bytes; if nobody holds category+sub_category the match widens once to category alone

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "solver_id": "string<uuid>",
    "category": "string (trimmed input echo)",
    "sub_category": "string (trimmed input echo)"
  }
}
```
_Candidates: solvers with an unexpired 'sessions' availability window who are active, is_verified, skill_verification_status verified, not role-switched, with light/standard/full KYC all verified, and verified (approved portfolio) in the skill pair; up to 50 random candidates, one picked with crypto/rand._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker-group RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-booking-link KYC grace window and the path is not under VerificationLockAllowedPaths(); body also has error_code "VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message "Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - seeker-group RequireCompleteProfile: mandatory profile fields missing and the path is not exempted by ProfileGateAllows; body also has error_code "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete: true, mandatory_missing_fields: [string]
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - per-IP rate limiter (RateLimitAvailability, RATE_LIMIT_AVAILABILITY_READ_PER_MIN, default 30/min per IP, group-level on /seeker/solver-availability) exceeded; body also has retry_after (Go duration string); X-RateLimit-Limit/-Remaining/-Reset and Retry-After headers are set on every response through the limiter
- 400: `category or sub_category is required` - both blank
- 400: `category or sub_category is too long` - either > 120 bytes
- 404: `No solver is available for that skill right now. Try another skill, or browse solvers yourself.` - no candidate
- 500: `Failed to match a solver. Please try again.` - query or crypto/rand failure

**Side effects:** topUpStaleSchedules: extends the materialised weekly schedule of every solver whose horizon is stale before matching.

request.description:
Returns a solver's bookable free time ranges for one date in the seeker's profile timezone (or raw saved windows with raw=true).

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RateLimitAvailability
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/solver_availability_handler.go:162 SolverAvailabilityHandler.GetAvailability`

**Query params**
- `solver_id` (string<uuid>) required=False default=authenticated user's id uuid.Parse must succeed -> else 400 'Invalid solver ID format'
- `date` (string<date>) required=False default=today in the display timezone YYYY-MM-DD; unparsable -> 400 'Failed to get availability. Please try again.'
- `raw` (string) required=False default=false "true" or "1" -> raw mode: stored windows as saved, no booking subtraction or past trimming, displayed in the SOLVER's profile timezone

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "solver_id": "string<uuid>",
    "date": "string<date>",
    "solver_timezone": "string (omitempty; solver profile tz or UTC)",
    "display_timezone": "string (omitempty)",
    "available_slots": [
      {
        "start_time": "string (HH:MM in display tz)",
        "end_time": "string (HH:MM; \"24:00\" when the range ends at the day boundary)",
        "display_text": "string (\"HH:MM - HH:MM\")",
        "is_available": "boolean (true)"
      }
    ],
    "unavailable_slots": [
      {
        "start_time": "string (\"HH:00\")",
        "end_time": "string (\"HH:00\")",
        "display_text": "string (e.g. \"9:00 AM - 10:00 AM\")",
        "is_available": "boolean (false)"
      }
    ],
    "total_slots": "integer (available + unavailable)",
    "is_recurring": "boolean (first window's is_recurring)",
    "has_saved_windows": "boolean (windows on this date or any stored weekly schedule)",
    "explicit_off": "boolean (omitempty; true when the date has no slots and is an explicit day-off)"
  }
}
```
_Display timezone = user_timezone local from TimezoneMiddleware (seeker profile), else X-Timezone header (IANA, must contain '/'), else UTC. available_slots are contiguous free ranges (not hourly), serializes null when empty (var slice). Non-raw mode subtracts confirmed/held bookings, applies the window buffer after bookings, drops ranges < 10 min and trims to the earliest bookable start (now + max(5, solver min_advance_booking_minutes) min, rounded up to 5 min). unavailable_slots = the 24 hourly options whose exact HH:MM-HH:MM key is not in available_slots (only built when <= 24 available ranges; [] otherwise)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker-group RequireNoVerificationLock: seeker has an open custom-booking-link KYC grace window and the path is not under VerificationLockAllowedPaths(); body also has error_code "VERIFICATION_LOCKED" and message "Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected."
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - seeker-group RequireCompleteProfile: mandatory profile fields missing and the path is not exempted by ProfileGateAllows; body also has error_code "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE", profile_incomplete: true, mandatory_missing_fields: [string]
- 429: `Too many requests. Please try again later.` - per-IP rate limiter (RateLimitAvailability, RATE_LIMIT_AVAILABILITY_READ_PER_MIN, default 30/min per IP, group-level on /seeker/solver-availability) exceeded; body also has retry_after (Go duration string); X-RateLimit-Limit/-Remaining/-Reset and Retry-After headers are set on every response through the limiter
- 400: `Invalid solver ID format` - solver_id not a UUID
- 400: `Validation failed. Please check your input` - struct validation fails
- 400: `Failed to get availability. Please try again.` - service error (bad date, window query failure)

**Side effects:** ensureScheduleHorizon may extend the solver's recurring weekly pattern into solver_availability_windows (and update the schedule horizon) when it is materialised less than ~58 days ahead.

request.description:
Searches Explore-listable solvers with filters, sorting and pagination.

**Auth:** False | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** RateLimitGlobal(RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL_PER_HOUR, default 1000/hour per IP)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/explore_handler.go:26 ExploreHandler.SearchSolvers`

**Query params**
- `query` (string) required=False default= case-insensitive LIKE (contains) on first_name, last_name, pseudo_name, bio, or verified expertise
- `category` (string) required=False default= skill; must sit on a verified portfolio together with the focus areas from `skills` when given
- `skills` (string) required=False default= comma-separated; trimmed, blanks dropped, lower-cased. With category: focus areas within that skill; without: solver must hold at least one in verified expertise
- `country` (string) required=False default= case-insensitive exact match on solvers.country
- `tier` (string) required=False default= exact match on solver_levels.level_name (not validated)
- `language` (string) required=False default= case-insensitive match against solvers.spoken_languages JSONB elements
- `min_rating` (number) required=False default=(none) clamped to 0..5; applied only when > 0; unparsable ignored
- `max_rating` (number) required=False default=(none) clamped to 0..5; applied only when > 0; unparsable ignored
- `min_price` (number) required=False default=(none) applied only when > 0; compared with solvers.hourly_rate
- `max_price` (number) required=False default=(none) applied only when > 0; compared with solvers.hourly_rate
- `is_available` (boolean) required=False default=false only the literal 'true' enables: a 'sessions' availability window ending in the future
- `online_now` (boolean) required=False default=false only 'true' enables: a 'sessions' window covers NOW
- `available_before` (string<date-time>) required=False default=(none) RFC3339; unparsable ignored; an open 'sessions' window starting before this instant
- `sort_by` (string) required=False default=rating rating | price_asc | price_desc | sessions | newest; other values = rating order
- `page` (integer) required=False default=1 <= 0 -> 1 (service)
- `limit` (integer) required=False default=20 <= 0 -> 20; handler caps 100, service caps 50

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "solvers": [
      {
        "solver_id": "string<uuid>",
        "first_name": "string | null (omitempty)",
        "last_name": "string | null (omitempty)",
        "pseudo_name": "string | null (omitempty)",
        "bio": "string | null (omitempty)",
        "avatar_url": "string | null (omitempty)",
        "rating": "number",
        "total_sessions": "integer",
        "completed_sessions": "integer",
        "total_reviews": "integer",
        "price_per_minute": "number",
        "is_verified": "boolean",
        "country": "string | null (omitempty)",
        "city": "string | null (omitempty)",
        "skills": [
          "string"
        ],
        "verified_skills": [
          {
            "skill": "string",
            "focus_areas": [
              "string"
            ]
          }
        ],
        "languages": [
          "string"
        ],
        "level_name": "string",
        "is_online": "boolean",
        "last_seen": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
        "next_available_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
        "accept_podcast_bookings": "boolean",
        "resolution_rate": "number | null (omitempty)"
      }
    ],
    "pagination": {
      "page": "integer",
      "limit": "integer",
      "total": "integer"
    }

}
```
_Only solvers passing ListableSolverSQL (account_status active, is_verified, not role-switched, skill verified, KYC light+standard+full verified, non-empty first/last name, country, non-UTC timezone, currency, bio, and future availability). price_per_minute is scanned from solvers.hourly_rate; level_name defaults to 'basic'; avatar_url rewritten to a presigned/proxied URL; last_seen is never selected (absent); resolution_rate absent when the solver has no resolved bookings; skills/languages/verified_skills are [] when none; solvers is [] when empty._

request.description:
Files a suspicious-activity report as a support ticket (category defaults to 'suspicious') and broadcasts a 'report.submitted' alert to connected admins.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** any authenticated (seeker, solver, admin) | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware [support group .Use]
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/support_handler.go:484 SupportHandler.ReportSuspiciousActivity`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "subject": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "category": "string enum: suspicious|content_report|content_duplication|harassment|other (omitempty)",
  "target_user_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
  "report_type": "string (omitempty)",
  "evidence": [
    {
      "type": "string (free text; conventionally content_id|external_url|proof_link|screenshot|link)",
      "value": "string",
      "description": "string (omitempty)"
    }
  ]
}
```
**Required:** subject, message
**Validation:**
- subject: tag required,min=5,max=200 + service ValidateSupportSubject
- message: tag required,min=10,max=5000 + service ValidateSupportMessage('Description')
- category: omitempty,oneof=suspicious content_report content_duplication harassment other; empty -> 'suspicious'
- report_type: max=50 (stored verbatim)
- evidence: tag max=20; service rejects > 10 items in total and validates http(s) links (same rules as ticket creation)
- same hourly ticket limit as ticket creation
- no role check: a caller whose role is not seeker/solver fails the support_tickets.user_type CHECK -> 500

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "id": "string<uuid>",
    "ticket_id": "string ('TCT-<ticket_number>')",

    "message": "string ('Support ticket created successfully. Our team will respond soon.')",
    "user_type": "string (omitempty)",
    "category": "string (omitempty)",
    "subject": "string (omitempty)",
    "description": "string (omitempty)",
    "priority": "string (omitempty; 'medium')",
    "report_type": "string (omitempty)",
    "created_at": "string<date-time>",
    "updated_at": "string<date-time>",
    "initial_message": {
      "id": "string<uuid>",
      "ticket_id": "string<uuid>",
      "sender_id": "string<uuid>",
      "sender_type": "string enum: user|admin|system",
      "message": "string",
      "created_at": "string<date-time>",
      "_modifier": "object | null (omitempty; absent when the initial message insert failed)"
    }
  }
}
```

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid request format` - JSON bind failed
- 400: `Validation failed: message is required (min 10 chars)` - any validate-tag failure (same text whichever field failed)
- 400: `<service validation message>` - SupportValidationError (subject/description wording, evidence count/links)
- 429: `Too many reports submitted recently. Please try again later.` - hourly ticket limit reached
- 500: `Failed to submit report` - other error (DB, unknown target_user_id, admin caller)

**Side effects:** Same inserts as ticket creation (support_tickets, support_ticket_messages, support_ticket_logs 'created'). Admin WS broadcast: {type:'report.submitted', severity:'warning', kind:'suspicious_activity', payload:{report_id, reporter_id, reporter_type, report_type}, timestamp}. No 'ticket.created' push to the reporter.

request.description:
Creates a support ticket for the caller (seeker or solver) with its opening message and returns the stored ticket echo.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** any authenticated (seeker, solver, admin) | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware [support group .Use]
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/support_handler.go:145 SupportHandler.CreateTicket`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "category": "string enum: booking|payment|content|account|technical|suspicious|content_report|content_duplication|payment_dispute|harassment|other",
  "subject": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "context": "string (omitempty)",
  "target_user_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
  "report_type": "string (omitempty)",
  "evidence": [
    {
      "type": "string (free text; conventionally content_id|external_url|proof_link|screenshot|link)",
      "value": "string",
      "description": "string (omitempty)"
    }
  ],
  "transaction_id": "string (omitempty)",
  "amount": "number | null (omitempty)"
}
```
**Required:** category, subject, description
**Validation:**
- category: required, oneof booking payment content account technical suspicious content_report content_duplication payment_dispute harassment other
- subject: tag required,min=5,max=200; service ValidateSupportSubject: trimmed 5..200 runes, >= 3 letters and a letter run >= 2
- description: tag required,min=10,max=5000; service ValidateSupportMessage('Description'): trimmed 10..5000 runes, >= 8 letters and a letter run >= 3
- context: max=500 (stored trimmed)
- report_type: max=50
- evidence: tag max=20; service rejects more than 10 items in total; items with type 'link' or a value starting 'http' must be absolute http(s) URLs with a dotted host (or localhost), <= 2048 chars, no whitespace/quotes/<>, and are de-duplicated; other items stored verbatim
- transaction_id: max=100 (stored trimmed)
- amount: omitempty,gt=0,lt=100000000
- target_user_id: FK to users(id) - an unknown UUID fails the insert (500)
- rate limit: tickets created by this user in the last hour >= RATE_LIMIT_MAX_TICKETS_PER_HOUR (default 5) -> 429

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "id": "string<uuid>",
    "ticket_id": "string ('TCT-<ticket_number>')",
    "status": "string ('open')",
    "message": "string ('Support ticket created successfully. Our team will respond soon.')",
    "user_type": "string (omitempty)",
    "category": "string (omitempty)",
    "subject": "string (omitempty)",
    "description": "string (omitempty)",
    "priority": "string (omitempty; 'medium')",
    "report_type": "string (omitempty)",
    "created_at": "string<date-time>",
    "updated_at": "string<date-time>",
    "initial_message": {
      "id": "string<uuid>",
      "ticket_id": "string<uuid>",
      "sender_id": "string<uuid>",
      "sender_type": "string enum: user|admin|system",
      "message": "string",
      "created_at": "string<date-time>",
      "_modifier": "object | null (omitempty; absent when the initial message insert failed)"
    }
  }
}
```

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `Invalid user role for support tickets` - user_role not seeker|solver (e.g. admin)
- 400: `Invalid request format` - JSON bind failed
- 400: `Validation failed: please check your input` - any validate-tag failure
- 400: `<Subject|Description> is required | ... must be at least N characters | ... must be at most N characters | ... must describe the issue in words, not just numbers or symbols | You can attach at most 10 links to a report | Link cannot be empty | Link is too long (max 2048 characters) | "<v>" is not a valid link | "<v>" must start with http:// or https://` - SupportValidationError from the service
- 429: `Too many tickets created recently. Please try again later.` - hourly ticket limit reached
- 500: `Failed to create support ticket` - other service/DB error (e.g. unknown target_user_id)

**Side effects:** INSERT support_tickets (status open, priority medium, user_type = caller role; ticket_number SERIAL -> 'TCT-N'), INSERT support_ticket_messages (initial user message = description), INSERT support_ticket_logs (action 'created'), bump the caller's cached ticket-list version. Async WS push to the caller's own live connections: NotificationMessage type 'ticket.created' data {ticket_id, reference, subject, category, status} (subject to the notification-settings gate).

request.description:
Uploads one file (JPEG/PNG/WebP/PDF, <= 5 MB) to R2 under support/<ticket>/<user>/ and attaches it to the caller's ticket (max 6 per ticket).

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** any authenticated (seeker, solver, admin) | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware [support group .Use]
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/support_handler.go:401 SupportHandler.UploadAttachment`

**Path params**
- `ticket_id` (string<uuid>) Percent-decoded then trimmed before uuid.Parse; the ticket UUID (id), not the 'TCT-N' reference

**Request body** (multipart/form-data) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "file": "file (form field 'file')"
}
```
**Required:** file
**Validation:**
- Type detected from magic bytes (client Content-Type ignored). Handler accepts JPEG/PNG/WebP/PDF/MP4/DOC/DOCX signatures; the service then allows only image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, application/pdf (others -> 500)
- Size: handler rejects > 5 MiB for every type (service's 25 MiB PDF limit unreachable); empty file -> 500
- Filename reduced with filepath.Base
- Ticket must exist, be owned by the caller, not be 'closed' (resolved is allowed) and have < 6 attachments (fails closed if the count query errors)
- No turn-taking check on this path

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "id": "string<uuid>",
    "ticket_id": "string<uuid>",
    "user_id": "string<uuid>",
    "file_name": "string",
    "file_type": "string (detected MIME)",
    "file_size": "integer",
    "file_key": "string (raw R2 key 'support/<ticket_id>/<user_id>/<yyyyMMddHHmmss>_<filename>', not resolved)",
    "raw_file_key": "string (omitempty; never set)",
    "created_at": "string<date-time>"
  }
}
```

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid ticket ID` - bad UUID
- 400: `File is required` - no 'file' part
- 400: `Unsupported file type. Allowed: JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF` - unrecognised magic bytes
- 400: `File too large. Maximum size is 5MB` - size > 5 MiB
- 404: `Support ticket not found` - no ticket
- 403: `You do not have access to this ticket` - not the owner
- 409: `Cannot add attachments to a closed ticket` - status closed
- 409: `This ticket already has the maximum of 6 attachments.` - 6 attachments exist; body code:'ATTACHMENT_LIMIT'
- 500: `Failed to read file | Failed to read file data` - multipart read error
- 500: `Failed to upload attachment` - MP4/DOC/DOCX, empty file, attachment-count query error, R2 or DB error

**Side effects:** PutObject to R2 (key support/<ticket_id>/<user_id>/<timestamp>_<filename>); INSERT support_ticket_attachments. No WS push.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- correction: the handler's 409 AWAITING_SUPPORT_REPLY branch is unreachable - SupportService.UploadAttachment never returns ErrAwaitingSupportReply (v1 listed it as an error and an unresolved item)

request.description:
Adds a user reply to the caller's ticket; allowed only after support has answered the previous user message.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** any authenticated (seeker, solver, admin) | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware [support group .Use]
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/support_handler.go:305 SupportHandler.AddMessage`

**Path params**
- `ticket_id` (string<uuid>) Percent-decoded then trimmed before uuid.Parse; the ticket UUID (id), not the 'TCT-N' reference

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "message": "string"
}
```
**Required:** message
**Validation:**
- message: tag required,min=1,max=5000
- service ValidateSupportMessage('Message'): trimmed 10..5000 runes, >= 8 letters and a letter run >= 3 (after ownership/closed checks)
- ticket status closed or resolved -> 409
- turn-taking: newest message on the ticket must not be from 'user' -> 409 (check fails open on DB error)
- >= 20 messages by this sender on this ticket in the last hour -> 429 (fails open on DB error)

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "message": "string ('Message added successfully')"
}
```
_No data field._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid ticket ID` - bad UUID
- 400: `Invalid request format` - JSON bind failed
- 400: `Message is required` - any validate-tag failure
- 404: `Support ticket not found` - no ticket
- 403: `You do not have access to this ticket` - not the owner
- 409: `This ticket is already closed` - status closed or resolved
- 400: `Message is required | Message must be at least 10 characters | Message must be at most 5000 characters | Message must describe the issue in words, not just numbers or symbols` - service content validation
- 409: `Please wait for a reply from our support team before sending another message.` - last message is the user's own; body also has code:'AWAITING_SUPPORT_REPLY'
- 429: `Too many messages. Please slow down.` - 20 messages/hour/ticket reached
- 500: `Failed to add message` - insert error

**Side effects:** INSERT support_ticket_messages (sender_type 'user'); bump the owner's cached ticket list; when status is waiting_on_user it calls UpdateTicketStatus('open'), but the repository state machine does not allow waiting_on_user -> open, so the call fails (WARN logged) and the status stays waiting_on_user; INSERT support_ticket_logs ('message_added'). Async WS push to the caller's own connections: type 'ticket.message' data {ticket_id, sender:'user'}.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- correction: the waiting_on_user -> open status flip never succeeds (validTicketTransitions has no waiting_on_user -> open); v1 listed it as a side effect

request.description:
Lists the caller's tasks with optional status/type/due filters, server-side sort and pagination.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(tasks)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/task_handler.go:113 TaskHandler.GetTasks`

**Query params**
- `status` (string) required=False default= exact match on tasks.status; not validated
- `task_type` (string) required=False default= exact match on tasks.task_type; not validated
- `page` (integer) required=False default=1 ignored unless integer > 0
- `limit` (integer) required=False default=20 ignored unless integer > 0; clamped to 100
- `due` (string) required=False default= enum today|upcoming|overdue (others ignored); evaluated on the user's profile-timezone calendar; overdue = open (not completed/cancelled) tasks; when set, due_date_from/to are ignored
- `due_date_from` (string<date-time>) required=False default= RFC3339; unparseable ignored; due_date >= value
- `due_date_to` (string<date-time>) required=False default= RFC3339; unparseable ignored; due_date <= value
- `sort` (string) required=False default=due_date enum due_date|due_date_desc|priority|created|created_asc|title (case-insensitive); unknown -> due_date; daily-focus rows always first

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "tasks": [
      {
        "id": "string<uuid>",
        "title": "string",
        "task_type": "string",
        "status": "string",
        "priority": "string",
        "is_daily_focus": "boolean",
        "estimated_minutes": "integer (omitempty)",
        "due_date": "string<date-time> (omitempty)",
        "tags": [
          "string"
        ],
        "category": "string (omitempty)",
        "created_at": "string<date-time>",
        "updated_at": "string<date-time>"
      }
    ],
    "pagination": {
      "page": "integer",
      "limit": "integer",
      "total": "integer"
    }
  }
}
```
_tasks is [] when empty._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 500: `Failed to get tasks` - repository error
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - feature 'tasks' is blocked for the user/role (RequireFeatureAccess). Body also has restricted:true, feature:'tasks', source, optional reason, and expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true. Fails open on lookup error.
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window and the path neither starts with an allowed prefix nor contains the graced booking id string. Body: {success:false,error:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',error_code:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',message:'Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected.'}
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - seeker profile is missing mandatory fields (RequireCompleteProfile; /api/v1/seeker/tasks is not in the allow-list). Body adds error_code:'PROFILE_INCOMPLETE', profile_incomplete:true, mandatory_missing_fields:[string]

**Side effects:** None (read-only).

request.description:
Creates a manual task for the caller (seeker or solver), collapsing an identical repeat submit within 30 seconds into the existing task.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(tasks)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/task_handler.go:53 TaskHandler.CreateTask`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "title": "string",
  "description": "string | null",
  "priority": "string enum: low|medium|high",
  "due_date": "string<date-time> | string<date> | null",
  "estimated_minutes": "integer | null",
  "is_daily_focus": "boolean",
  "is_recurring": "boolean",
  "recurrence_pattern": "string | null enum: daily|weekly|monthly",
  "goal_id": "string<uuid> | null",
  "tags": [
    "string"
  ],
  "category": "string | null enum: Learning|Session Prep|Follow-up|Project|Review|Practice|Research|Other"
}
```
**Required:** title
**Validation:**
- title: required,min=1,max=255
- description: omitempty,max=5000
- priority: omitempty,oneof=low medium high (default 'medium')
- estimated_minutes: omitempty,gt=0
- recurrence_pattern: omitempty,oneof=daily weekly monthly; stored only when is_recurring=true
- category: omitempty,oneof=Learning 'Session Prep' Follow-up Project Review Practice Research Other
- due_date: RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD; must not be before the start of the user's current day in their profile timezone
- tags: trimmed, empties dropped, case-insensitive dedupe, each truncated to 50 chars, max 20 kept
- goal_id must be one of the caller's goals (DB trigger)
- is_daily_focus: DB trigger caps open focus tasks at 5

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "id": "string<uuid>",
    "user_id": "string<uuid>",
    "user_type": "string",
    "title": "string",
    "description": "string (omitempty)",
    "task_type": "string",
    "status": "string",
    "priority": "string",
    "is_daily_focus": "boolean",
    "is_recurring": "boolean",
    "recurrence_pattern": "string (omitempty)",
    "goal_id": "string<uuid> (omitempty)",
    "source_type": "string (omitempty)",
    "source_id": "string<uuid> (omitempty)",
    "estimated_minutes": "integer (omitempty)",
    "due_date": "string<date-time> (omitempty)",
    "completed_at": "string<date-time> (omitempty)",
    "tags": [
      "string"
    ],
    "category": "string (omitempty)",
    "created_at": "string<date-time>",
    "updated_at": "string<date-time>"
  }
}
```
_task_type='manual', status='pending'. If an identical open task (same user, title, due date) was created within 30 s, that existing task is returned instead (still 201)._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid request format` - body not valid JSON
- 400: `Validation failed: please check your input` - validator.Struct failed
- 403: `You do not have access to this goal` - goal_id not owned by caller / does not exist (tasks_goal_id_owner_fkey trigger)
- 409: `you can have at most 5 tasks in Today's Focus` - is_daily_focus=true and the focus cap trigger rejects the insert
- 500: `Failed to create task` - unparseable due_date or due date in the past (the handler's lowercase 'invalid due_date format' check never matches the service's capitalised message), or DB error
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - feature 'tasks' is blocked for the user/role (RequireFeatureAccess). Body also has restricted:true, feature:'tasks', source, optional reason, and expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true. Fails open on lookup error.
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window and the path neither starts with an allowed prefix nor contains the graced booking id string. Body: {success:false,error:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',error_code:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',message:'Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected.'}
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - seeker profile is missing mandatory fields (RequireCompleteProfile; /api/v1/seeker/tasks is not in the allow-list). Body adds error_code:'PROFILE_INCOMPLETE', profile_incomplete:true, mandatory_missing_fields:[string]

**Side effects:** INSERT tasks (UUID v7, user_type from token role).

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

request.description:
Partially updates one of the caller's tasks (title, description, priority, status, due date, estimate, tags, focus flag, category).

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(tasks)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/task_handler.go:235 TaskHandler.UpdateTask`

**Path params**
- `task_id` (string<uuid>) tasks.id; parsed with uuid.Parse

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "title": "string | null",
  "description": "string | null",
  "priority": "string | null enum: low|medium|high",
  "due_date": "string<date-time> | string<date> | null",
  "estimated_minutes": "integer | null",
  "status": "string | null enum: pending|in_progress|completed|cancelled",
  "tags": [
    "string"
  ],
  "is_daily_focus": "boolean | null",
  "category": "string | null enum: Learning|Session Prep|Follow-up|Project|Review|Practice|Research|Other"
}
```
**Validation:**
- omitted/null fields are left unchanged
- title: omitempty,min=1,max=255
- description: omitempty,max=5000
- estimated_minutes: omitempty,gt=0
- due_date: RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD; "" clears it; no past-date check on update
- tags: [] clears; same normalisation as create (20 max, 50 chars each)
- is_daily_focus=true on a task whose resulting status is completed/cancelled -> 409; focus cap 5 enforced by DB trigger
- status completed sets completed_at=now; completed/cancelled forces is_daily_focus=false
- goal_id ownership trigger can still fire on UPDATE (goal_id is rewritten with its current value)

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "id": "string<uuid>",
    "user_id": "string<uuid>",
    "user_type": "string",
    "title": "string",
    "description": "string (omitempty)",
    "task_type": "string",
    "status": "string",
    "priority": "string",
    "is_daily_focus": "boolean",
    "is_recurring": "boolean",
    "recurrence_pattern": "string (omitempty)",
    "goal_id": "string<uuid> (omitempty)",
    "source_type": "string (omitempty)",
    "source_id": "string<uuid> (omitempty)",
    "estimated_minutes": "integer (omitempty)",
    "due_date": "string<date-time> (omitempty)",
    "completed_at": "string<date-time> (omitempty)",
    "tags": [
      "string"
    ],
    "category": "string (omitempty)",
    "created_at": "string<date-time>",
    "updated_at": "string<date-time>"
  }
}
```
_Returns the updated task struct._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid task ID` - task_id is not a UUID
- 400: `Invalid request format` - body not valid JSON
- 400: `Validation failed: please check your input` - validator.Struct failed
- 404: `Task not found` - no task row (any repository error maps here)
- 403: `You do not have access to this task` - task.user_id != caller
- 403: `You do not have access to this goal` - goal ownership trigger rejects the update
- 409: `you can have at most 5 tasks in Today's Focus` - focus cap trigger rejects
- 409: `Only open tasks can be added to Today's Focus` - is_daily_focus=true on a completed/cancelled task
- 500: `Failed to update task` - unparseable due_date (handler's lowercase string check never matches 'Invalid due_date format, use RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD') or DB error
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - feature 'tasks' is blocked for the user/role (RequireFeatureAccess). Body also has restricted:true, feature:'tasks', source, optional reason, and expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true. Fails open on lookup error.
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window and the path neither starts with an allowed prefix nor contains the graced booking id string. Body: {success:false,error:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',error_code:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',message:'Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected.'}
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - seeker profile is missing mandatory fields (RequireCompleteProfile; /api/v1/seeker/tasks is not in the allow-list). Body adds error_code:'PROFILE_INCOMPLETE', profile_incomplete:true, mandatory_missing_fields:[string]

**Side effects:** UPDATE tasks (all mutable columns rewritten). Completing via this endpoint does not update goal progress or spawn the next recurring occurrence (only /complete does).

request.description:
Marks one of the caller's tasks completed, updates linked goal progress, and spawns the next occurrence for recurring tasks.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile; RequireFeatureAccess(tasks)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/task_handler.go:430 TaskHandler.MarkCompleted`

**Path params**
- `task_id` (string<uuid>) tasks.id; parsed with uuid.Parse

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "id": "string<uuid>",
    "user_id": "string<uuid>",
    "user_type": "string",
    "title": "string",
    "description": "string (omitempty)",
    "task_type": "string",
    "status": "string",
    "priority": "string",
    "is_daily_focus": "boolean",
    "is_recurring": "boolean",
    "recurrence_pattern": "string (omitempty)",
    "goal_id": "string<uuid> (omitempty)",
    "source_type": "string (omitempty)",
    "source_id": "string<uuid> (omitempty)",
    "estimated_minutes": "integer (omitempty)",
    "due_date": "string<date-time> (omitempty)",
    "completed_at": "string<date-time> (omitempty)",
    "tags": [
      "string"
    ],
    "category": "string (omitempty)",
    "created_at": "string<date-time>",
    "updated_at": "string<date-time>"
  }
}
```
_status='completed', completed_at=now, is_daily_focus=false._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 400: `Invalid task ID` - task_id is not a UUID
- 404: `Task not found` - no task row (any repository error maps here)
- 403: `You do not have access to this task` - task.user_id != caller
- 409: `Task is already completed` - status already completed, or a concurrent request completed it first
- 500: `Failed to mark task as completed` - DB error
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - feature 'tasks' is blocked for the user/role (RequireFeatureAccess). Body also has restricted:true, feature:'tasks', source, optional reason, and expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true. Fails open on lookup error.
- 403: `VERIFICATION_LOCKED` - seeker has an open custom-link KYC grace window and the path neither starts with an allowed prefix nor contains the graced booking id string. Body: {success:false,error:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',error_code:'VERIFICATION_LOCKED',message:'Complete identity verification to continue using Synap Mentor. Your booked session is unaffected.'}
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - seeker profile is missing mandatory fields (RequireCompleteProfile; /api/v1/seeker/tasks is not in the allow-list). Body adds error_code:'PROFILE_INCOMPLETE', profile_incomplete:true, mandatory_missing_fields:[string]

**Side effects:** UPDATE tasks status='completed', completed_at, is_daily_focus=false (conditional on owner and not already completed); if goal_id set, recomputes solver_goals progress (best-effort); if recurring and no pending sibling with same title+pattern, INSERT next task with due_date = now + 1 day/7 days/1 month (best-effort).

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- correction: AuthMiddleware is registered once on the seeker group (routes.go:195); the previous text said it was registered twice

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/seeker/tasks/{id}/complete` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:143)
**Evidence:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/routes/routes.go:621`, `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/task_handler.go:430-479`, `Backend/internal/core/usecases/task_service.go:470-576`, `Backend/internal/adapter/db/postgres/task_repository.go:328`, `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/task_handler.go`, `Backend/internal/core/usecases/task_service.go:57-80`, `Backend/internal/core/domain/task_dto.go:15-39`, `Backend/internal/adapter/http/routes/routes.go:194-210`, `Backend/pkg/middleware/verification_lock.go:90`, `Backend/pkg/middleware/profile_complete.go:36`, `Backend/internal/core/usecases/seeker_profile_service.go:424-475`, `Backend/pkg/middleware/feature_restriction.go:39`

response.name: 200 OK - status='completed', completed_at=now, is_daily_focus=false.

request.description:
Lets a discussion's creator correct its title and description exactly once.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireCompleteProfile (group .Use; evaluated for role=seeker only; no community/thread/event path is in ProfileGateAllows); RequireFeatureAccess("community") (passed after the handler; Fiber v3 register() runs trailing middleware before the handler, so it runs)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:477 CommunityHandler.UpdateThread`

**Path params**
- `thread_id` (string<uuid>) thread id

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "title": "string",
  "description": "string"
}
```
**Required:** title, description
**Validation:**
- title: required,min=5,max=200
- description: required,min=10,max=5000
- Validator failures -> 400 'Validation failed: <msgs>'
- Service: utils.ValidateDiscussionTitle (trimmed 5..200 runes, enough letters and a word of >=2 letters)

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "id": "string<uuid>",
    "community_id": "string<uuid>",
    "creator_id": "string<uuid>",
    "title": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "thread_state": "string enum: open|resolved|partial|archived",
    "message_count": "integer",
    "file_count": "integer",
    "pinned": "boolean",
    "is_locked": "boolean",
    "created_at": "string<date-time>",
    "updated_at": "string<date-time>",
    "edited_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)"
  }
}
```
_Returns the re-read thread (GetThreadByID): edited_at now set; pinned/is_locked populated; message_count and file_count are always 0 because GetThreadByID does not compute them._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - role=seeker with missing mandatory profile fields (body also has error_code=PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, profile_incomplete=true, mandatory_missing_fields=[string])

request.description:
Files a moderation report against a message in a community the caller belongs to.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** - | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireCompleteProfile (group .Use; evaluated for role=seeker only; no community/thread/event path is in ProfileGateAllows)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/community_handler.go:782 CommunityHandler.ReportMessage`

**Path params**
- `thread_id` (string<uuid>) thread id
- `message_id` (string<uuid>) message id (must belong to :thread_id)

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "reason": "string",
  "severity": "string (omitempty) enum: low|normal|high|critical",
  "category": "string (omitempty) enum: spam|harassment|abuse|nsfw|illegal|misinformation|other"
}
```
**Required:** reason
**Validation:**
- reason: required,min=5,max=1000
- severity: omitempty,oneof=low normal high critical (default 'normal')
- category: omitempty,oneof=spam harassment abuse nsfw illegal misinformation other (default 'other')
- ANY validation failure returns 400 'Reason must be at least 5 characters'

**Response 201** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "message": "string"
}
```
_message is 'Message reported successfully'._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `Please complete your profile to continue` - role=seeker with missing mandatory profile fields (body also has error_code=PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, profile_incomplete=true, mandatory_missing_fields=[string])
- 401: `Authentication required` - user_id missing from context (handler check)
- 400: `Invalid thread ID` - :thread_id not a UUID
- 400: `Invalid message ID` - :message_id not a UUID
- 400: `Invalid request format` - body is not valid JSON
- 400: `Reason must be at least 5 characters` - any DTO validation failure
- 404: `Message not found` - message missing or not in this thread
- 404: `Thread not found` - thread missing or soft-deleted
- 403: `You are not a member of this community` - reporter not a member
- 500: `Failed to report message` - DB error

**Side effects:** Inserts community_message_reports row (status=pending); publishes community.message.reported (thread_id, message_id, reporter_id, reason, severity, category).

request.description:
Starts a seeker live-face (enrollment) challenge: validates biometric consent, attempt limit and state, then returns a random action sequence and lighting probe.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock (no-op: /api/v1/seeker/verification allowlisted); RequireCompleteProfile (no-op: /api/v1/seeker/verification allowlisted); RequireFeatureAccess(kyc)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/kyc_handler.go:1065 KYCHandler.StartStandardVerification`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "biometric_consent": "boolean",
  "biometric_consent_version": "string",
  "capabilities": "any"
}
```
**Required:** biometric_consent, biometric_consent_version
**Validation:**
- body bind errors are ignored (`_ = c.Bind().JSON`) — a missing/invalid body behaves like consent=false
- biometric_consent must be true
- biometric_consent_version must equal BiometricConsentNoticeVersion = "2026-10-02"
- capabilities is parsed but unused

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "challenge_id": "string<uuid>",
  "challenge_sequence": [
    "string enum: blink|turn_left|turn_right|smile|nod|say_number"
  ],
  "challenge_number": "string (omitempty)",
  "lighting_probe_color": "string enum: red|blue|green|white",
  "lighting_probe_at_frame": "integer",
  "instructions": "string",
  "expires_in_seconds": "integer",
  "attempt_number": "integer",
  "max_attempts": "integer",
  "flow_type": "string (omitempty)"
}
```
_Response is the struct itself (no data wrapper). flow_type = 'enrollment'. expires_in_seconds = challengeExpiryMinutes*60 (RATE_LIMIT_FACE_CHALLENGE_EXPIRY_MIN, default 5; .env sets 50). max_attempts = faceChallengeMaxAttempts (RATE_LIMIT_FACE_CHALLENGE_MAX_ATTEMPTS, default 5; .env sets 100000). lighting_probe_at_frame is 8..12. challenge_sequence: admin face_auth_config challenge_count for flow 'enrollment' when > 0, else 3 or 4 random; clamped 1..6, distinct actions, always contains say_number (challenge_number then set). Every non-200 body written by this KYC handler is domain.KYCResponse {"success":false,"message":"..."} (key `message`, not `error`) unless stated otherwise._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(kyc) finds feature 'kyc' blocked for the user/role. Body: {success:false, restricted:true, feature:'kyc', error, source, reason?, expires_at? | permanent:true}. Fails open on lookup error.
- 400: `biometric consent is required before starting face verification` - biometric_consent false
- 400: `biometric consent was given for an outdated notice — please reload the page and review the current biometric consent notice` - consent version mismatch
- 403: `This identity is already registered with another account. Please contact support.` - kyc_verification.reject_reason = duplicate_blocked
- 409: `Standard verification already completed` - current_level is standard or full
- 429: `maximum verification attempts (N) exceeded, please contact support` - face challenge attempts >= faceChallengeMaxAttempts (default 5)
- 500: `Failed to start verification. Please try again.` - seeker not found, KYC init failure, attempt-count failure, biometric_consents insert failure ('failed to store the consent record' - deliberately not matched by the 'biometric consent' 400 branch), face_challenges insert failure

**Side effects:** May create kyc_verification/kyc_light rows and force email-verified + level 'light'; expires any active challenge; inserts a biometric_consents row (user_role seeker, notice_version, notice_text_sha256, challenge_id, IP/UA) BEFORE creating the challenge (failure aborts); inserts face_challenges row (status pending, flow_type enrollment); writes verification_logs rows (biometric_consent with notice version + IP/UA, and start).

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- side effect added: a biometric_consents row (role, notice version, SHA-256 of notice text, challenge_id, IP/UA) is written before the face challenge is created
- new 500 path: failure to store the consent record aborts the start (no challenge created) and returns 'Failed to start verification. Please try again.'

**Not determinable from code:**
- Route passes faceChallengeRateLimiter as the 2nd positional arg (routes.go:302); per Fiber v3 behaviour it never runs, so it is excluded from effective_middleware.

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/seeker/verification/full/start` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:146)
**Evidence:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/routes/routes.go:302`, `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/kyc_handler.go:1065`, `Backend/internal/core/usecases/kyc_service.go:970`, `Backend/internal/core/usecases/kyc_service.go:58`, `Backend/internal/core/usecases/kyc_service.go:1617`, `Backend/internal/adapter/db/postgres/kyc_repository.go:385`, `Backend/internal/core/domain/kyc_dto.go:240`, `Backend/internal/config/config.go:553`

request.description:
Submits seeker face-challenge JPEG frames for async ML processing via NATS (enrollment flow).

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock (no-op: /api/v1/seeker/verification allowlisted); RequireCompleteProfile (no-op: /api/v1/seeker/verification allowlisted); RequireFeatureAccess(kyc)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/kyc_handler.go:1203 KYCHandler.SubmitStandardVerification`

**Request body** (multipart/form-data) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "challenge_id": "string<uuid> (form field)",
  "frames[]": "file[] (JPEG, 5..20 files, each <=500KB, must start FF D8 FF)",
  "timings": "string (comma-separated integer ms timestamps; unparsable entries dropped)",
  "transcript": "string",
  "speech_confidence": "number (default 0 on parse failure)",
  "virtual_camera": "string ('true' => true, anything else false)",
  "challenge_action_ranges": "string (JSON [[start,end],...]; ignored if invalid or >16 pairs)"
}
```
**Required:** challenge_id, frames[]
**Validation:**
- DB-backed per-user rate limit checked FIRST: challenge attempts in the last RATE_LIMIT_FACE_VERIFY_WINDOW_MIN minutes (default 10) >= RATE_LIMIT_FACE_VERIFY_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 5; .env 100000), or 24h count >= 3x that cap; a failed rate-limit read is logged and ignored
- challenge_id required (non-empty)
- frames[] count 5..20
- each frame <= 500*1024 bytes and JPEG magic FF D8 FF
- challenge must belong to the seeker, be flow_type enrollment, status pending, not expired

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "message": "string",
  "challenge_id": "string<uuid> (omitempty)",
  "liveness_score": "number (omitempty)",
  "spoof_score": "number (omitempty)",
  "consistency_score": "number (omitempty)",
  "identity_score": "number (omitempty)",
  "final_score": "number (omitempty)",
  "passed": "boolean",
  "verification_level": "string (omitempty)",
  "processing_status": "string (omitempty)",
  "layer_results": "object<any> (omitempty)"
}
```
_On success: success=true, challenge_id, message='Face verification submitted for processing. Check status for results.', processing_status='processing', passed=false; score fields omitted. Status is 200 (not 202). Every non-200 body written by this KYC handler is domain.KYCResponse {"success":false,"message":"..."} (key `message`, not `error`) unless stated otherwise._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(kyc) finds feature 'kyc' blocked for the user/role. Body: {success:false, restricted:true, feature:'kyc', error, source, reason?, expires_at? | permanent:true}. Fails open on lookup error.
- 429: `Too many verification attempts. Please try again later.` - face verify rate limit hit
- 400: `challenge_id is required` - missing challenge_id
- 400: `Invalid multipart form data. Send frames[] as JPEG files.` - multipart parse failure
- 400: `Must submit between 5 and 20 face frames.` - frame count out of range
- 400: `Frame N exceeds 500KB limit. | Failed to read frame N. | Failed to read frame N data. | Frame N is not a valid JPEG image.` - per-frame checks (N is 0-based)
- 410: `<service message containing 'expired'> e.g. 'challenge has expired, please start a new one' or 'challenge already expired'` - challenge expired
- 404: `Challenge not found. Please start a new verification.` - challenge missing/not owned/not enrollment, or seeker profile not found
- 409: `challenge already <status> | challenge already submitted or processed` - challenge not pending / lost atomic transition
- 500: `Verification submission failed. Please try again.` - invalid challenge UUID, NATS publisher missing/publish failure, DB errors

**Side effects:** Atomically flips face_challenges status pending->submitted; marks expired challenges 'expired'; writes a verification_logs manual-review row when virtual_camera=true; publishes face verify message (flow enrollment) to NATS JetStream.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

- faceChallengeRateLimiter in route 2nd positional arg never runs (Fiber v3).

request.description:
Uploads the seeker's government-ID document (encrypted to storage) for admin review; requires completed face verification.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock (no-op: /api/v1/seeker/verification allowlisted); RequireCompleteProfile (no-op: /api/v1/seeker/verification allowlisted); RequireFeatureAccess(kyc)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/kyc_handler.go:1358 KYCHandler.UploadFullVerificationDocument`

**Request body** (multipart/form-data) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "document": "file (required)",
  "document_type": "string enum: citizen_card|passport|driving_license|other (case-insensitive, required)",
  "document_label": "string (required only when document_type=other; <=100 chars; ^[a-zA-Z0-9 ().,'\\-/]+$)",
  "file_type": "string enum: pdf|jpg|png|webp (required)"
}
```
**Required:** document, document_type, file_type
**Validation:**
- document_type required; retired values aadhaar|aadhar|aadhaar_card|aadhar_card|pan|pan_card|pancard rejected (also when they appear inside document_label for 'other')
- file size >0 and <= 5MB (usecases.MaxKYCDocumentBytes = 5*1024*1024)
- magic bytes must match file_type AND http.DetectContentType must agree; images fully decoded, max 12000x12000 and <=60,000,000 pixels; PDFs rejected if they contain /JavaScript,/Launch,/EmbeddedFile(s),/RichMedia,/GoToR,/SubmitForm,/ImportData (whole doc) or /JS,/AA,/XFA (outside streams), and must contain %%EOF in last 4096 bytes
- stored filename = sanitized client filename with extension replaced by file_type

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "message": "string"
}
```
_message = 'Government ID uploaded successfully. Awaiting admin review.' Every non-200 body written by this KYC handler is domain.KYCResponse {"success":false,"message":"..."} (key `message`, not `error`) unless stated otherwise._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(kyc) finds feature 'kyc' blocked for the user/role. Body: {success:false, restricted:true, feature:'kyc', error, source, reason?, expires_at? | permanent:true}. Fails open on lookup error.
- 400: `Government ID document is required` - no 'document' file
- 400: `File type is required (pdf, jpg, png, webp)` - file_type blank
- 400: `Document type is required. Choose Citizen Card, Passport, Driving License or Other` - document_type blank
- 400: `Aadhaar and PAN card are no longer accepted. Please upload a Citizen Card, Passport or Driving License` - retired document type or retired name inside label
- 400: `Invalid document type. Allowed: citizen_card, passport, driving_license, other` - unknown document_type
- 400: `Please specify the document type when selecting Other` - document_type=other and blank label
- 400: `Document description must be 100 characters or fewer` - label > 100
- 400: `Document description may only contain letters, numbers, spaces and . , ' - ( ) /` - label fails regex
- 400: `Invalid file type. Allowed: pdf, jpg, png, webp` - file_type not allowed
- 400: `File is empty` - file size <= 0
- 400: `File size exceeds 5MB limit` - file > 5MB (handler or service ErrKYCFileSizeExceeded)
- 400: `File content does not match the declared file type` - validateFileMagicBytes fails
- 500: `Failed to read file | Failed to read file data` - multipart file open/read failure
- 400: `Complete standard face verification before uploading government ID` - no kyc_verification row or standard_status != verified after self-heal attempt
- 409: `Your government ID is already approved or under review and cannot be replaced. Contact support if it needs to change.` - kyc_verification.full_status not in (not_started, rejected), or the repository's guarded upsert refuses the replacement (existing kyc_standard review_status 'verified' or full_status pending/verified)
- 500: `Failed to upload document` - seeker not found, storage/DB failure

**Side effects:** May self-heal standard_status to verified (+level standard); uploads encrypted file + key to object storage; under a per-owner advisory lock archives the current kyc_standard row to kyc_standard_history (archive_reason 'resubmitted') and upserts kyc_standard (review_status pending, document_type/label) - the replaced object stays in storage; on a failed/refused row write the NEW object + key are deleted; sets kyc_verification.full_status='pending'; writes verification_logs 'upload' row with IP/UA.

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Changed since 2026-10-02:**
- side effect changed: a replaced submission is no longer deleted from storage - it is archived to kyc_standard_history (archive_reason 'resubmitted') in the same transaction and its object is kept; only the new upload is removed when the row write fails

**Listed in:** seeker: `POST /api/v/seeker/verification/standard/upload` (docs/seeker-endpoints.md:149)

request.description:
Returns the seeker's custom-link KYC grace/lock status (self-heals and closes the window if the seeker is now verified).

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** seeker | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(seeker); tzMiddleware; RequireNoVerificationLock; RequireCompleteProfile(profileGate); RequireFeatureAccess(kyc) (seekerVerification Group("/verification").Use matches the raw prefix of /verification-lock)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/booking_link_handler.go:609 BookingLinkHandler.SeekerVerificationLock`

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "locked": "boolean",
    "verification_level": "string",
    "booking_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
    "deadline_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
    "remaining_seconds": "integer",
    "overdue": "boolean",
    "allowed_paths": [
      "string (omitempty)"
    ]
  }
}
```
_No open grace: only verification_level set (locked false). Open grace + level >= standard: booking_id/deadline_at set, locked false, window cleared. Open grace + unverified: locked true, remaining_seconds (0 when overdue, overdue true), allowed_paths = VerificationLockAllowedPaths()._

- 500: `internal error` - repository error
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(kyc): feature 'kyc' restricted for the caller; body also has restricted:true, feature:"kyc", source, reason (if set), expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true

**Side effects:** If an open grace window exists and the seeker reached 'standard', clears the grace (ClearSeekerKYCGrace) and emits EventSeekerKYCGraceCleared.

request.description:
Returns free time ranges for a solver (default: the caller) on one date; raw=true returns the saved windows in the solver's timezone for the schedule editor.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** solver | **CSRF header:** no
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(solver); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireFeatureAccess(availability)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/solver_availability_handler.go:162 SolverAvailabilityHandler.GetAvailability`

**Query params**
- `solver_id` (string<uuid>) required=False default=authenticated user's id uuid.Parse must succeed -> else 400 'Invalid solver ID format'
- `date` (string<date>) required=False default=today in the display timezone YYYY-MM-DD; unparsable -> 400 'Failed to get availability. Please try again.'
- `raw` (string) required=False default=false "true" or "1" -> raw mode: stored windows as saved, no booking subtraction or past trimming, displayed in the SOLVER's profile timezone

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "solver_id": "string<uuid>",
    "date": "string<date>",
    "solver_timezone": "string (omitempty; solver profile tz or UTC)",
    "display_timezone": "string (omitempty)",
    "available_slots": [
      {
        "start_time": "string (HH:MM in display tz)",
        "end_time": "string (HH:MM; \"24:00\" when the range ends at the day boundary)",
        "display_text": "string (\"HH:MM - HH:MM\")",
        "is_available": "boolean (true)"
      }
    ],
    "unavailable_slots": [
      {
        "start_time": "string (\"HH:00\")",
        "end_time": "string (\"HH:00\")",
        "display_text": "string (e.g. \"9:00 AM - 10:00 AM\")",
        "is_available": "boolean (false)"
      }
    ],
    "total_slots": "integer (available + unavailable)",
    "is_recurring": "boolean (first window's is_recurring)",
    "has_saved_windows": "boolean (windows on this date or any stored weekly schedule)",
    "explicit_off": "boolean (omitempty; true when the date has no slots and is an explicit day-off)"
  }
}
```
_solver_id may name ANY solver (no ownership check). The solverAvailRL limiter is in the 2nd positional slot and never runs. available_slots are contiguous free ranges (not hourly), serializes null when empty (var slice). Non-raw mode subtracts confirmed/held bookings, applies the window buffer after bookings, drops ranges < 10 min and trims to the earliest bookable start (now + max(5, solver min_advance_booking_minutes) min, rounded up to 5 min). unavailable_slots = the 24 hourly options whose exact HH:MM-HH:MM key is not in available_slots (only built when <= 24 available ranges; [] otherwise)._

request.description:
Saves the solver's weekly recurring pattern plus date overrides and materialises it into availability windows for the next N days (default 60).

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** solver | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(solver); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireFeatureAccess(availability)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/solver_availability_handler.go:118 SolverAvailabilityHandler.SetWeeklySchedule`

**Request body** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "weekly": {
    "<Sunday..Saturday>": [
      "string (\"HH:MM-HH:MM\")"
    ]
  },
  "overrides": {
    "<YYYY-MM-DD>": [
      "string (\"HH:MM-HH:MM\")"
    ]
  },
  "timezone": "string (IANA)",
  "schedule_type": "string (\"sessions\" default | \"podcast\")",
  "days_forward": "integer (omitempty)"
}
```
**Required:** weekly, timezone
**Validation:**
- validate: weekly required, timezone required (checked BEFORE the X-Timezone fallback, so a missing timezone is a 400)
- solver profile timezone must be set and not UTC
- every listed day and override: each slot HH:MM-HH:MM, no duplicates, end > start, no overlaps (adjacent OK) - first failure aborts with '<Day or date>: <reason>'
- unknown day names are ignored; an empty slot array = day off / date unavailable; a missing day = no change
- days_forward <= 0 or > 90 -> 60
- the PROFILE timezone is used; request timezone only as fallback when the profile can't be read
- per-date errors during propagation (e.g. exceeding max hours/day) are logged and skipped, not returned

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "message": "string (\"Weekly schedule saved\")",
    "days_saved": "integer",
    "days_cleared": "integer",
    "days_override": "integer"
  }
}
```

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(availability): feature blocked for the user (source user) / platform_all / platform_seeker|platform_solver; body also has restricted: true, feature: "availability", source, optional reason, expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent: true
- 400: `Invalid request body` - JSON bind fails
- 400: `Validation failed. Please check your input` - weekly or timezone missing
- 400: `Please set your timezone in Profile settings before setting availability` - profile tz empty/UTC
- 400: `<Day|YYYY-MM-DD>: invalid time slot format: <slot> (expected HH:MM-HH:MM) | duplicate time slot <slot> - ... | time slot <slot> ends at or before it starts | overlapping availability: ...` - slot validation fails

**Side effects:** Saves solver_weekly_schedule and solver_date_overrides; for each day in range replaces solver_availability_windows for that solver-local day (merged ranges, buffer 5 min); deletes overrides superseded by the pattern; records the schedule horizon (sessions only); audit rows per date; ONE availability.changed NATS event ('weekly_schedule_saved').

**Live check:** not_run - state-changing endpoint; live run was limited to read-only GETs

**Listed in:** solver: `POST /api/v1/solver/availability/weekly-schedule` (docs/audit/solver_endpoints.md:103)

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** solver | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(solver); tzMiddleware
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/payment_handler.go:530 PaymentHandler.CreateBookingLink`

```json
{
  "title": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "duration_minutes": "integer",
  "custom_price": "number enum: 5|10|15|20",
  "expires_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
  "max_bookings": "integer | null (omitempty)",
  "scheduled_at": "string<date-time> | null (omitempty)",
  "session_mode": "string enum: chat|meeting (omitempty)"
}
```
**Required:** title, duration_minutes, custom_price
**Validation:**
- title validate:required,min=3,max=255
- description validate:omitempty,max=1000
- duration_minutes validate:required,min=10,max=180
- custom_price validate:required,min=5,max=20 and service allows only 5|10|15|20
- max_bookings validate:omitempty,min=1,max=1000
- session_mode validate:omitempty,oneof=chat meeting (default meeting)
- custom_price must not exceed the solver's current price per minute
- scheduled_at >= now+5min, <= now+30 days, and not after expires_at

```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "id": "string<uuid>",
    "link_code": "string",
```

request.description:
Synchronous solver pre-session face match against the solver's enrolled gallery; flips solver_face_verified on success and blocks/cancels after max failed attempts.

**Auth:** True | **Roles:** solver | **CSRF header:** yes
**Middleware that runs:** AuthMiddleware; RequireRole(solver); TimezoneMiddleware; RequireFeatureAccess(booking_response); RequireVerification(standard)
**Handler:** `Backend/internal/adapter/http/handlers/booking_handler.go:732 BookingHandler.SolverFaceMatch`

**Path params**
- `booking_id` (string<uuid>) bookings.id

**Request body** (multipart/form-data) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "frames[] (or frames)": "file[] — JPEG images",
  "timings": "string (comma-separated integer ms timestamps, optional)"
}
```
**Required:** frames[] or frames
**Validation:**
- 3..10 files (frames[] preferred, falls back to frames)
- total size <= 3MB
- each file <= 500KB
- each file must start with JPEG magic bytes FF D8 FF
- timings missing/unparseable -> synthesized 0,200,400,...

**Response 200** (application/json) - field types from code:
```json
{
  "success": "boolean",
  "data": {
    "matched": "boolean",
    "score": "number",
    "spoof_score": "number",
    "gallery_size": "integer",
    "threshold": "number",
    "processing_ms": "integer",
    "reason": "string (omitempty)",
    "difficulty_used": "string enum: easy|medium|hard|very_hard",
    "session_id": "string<uuid> | null (omitempty)",
    "booking_id": "string<uuid>",
    "attempts": "integer",
    "attempts_remaining": "integer",
    "blocked": "boolean"
  }
}
```
_Always HTTP 200 on a completed match; top-level success mirrors data.matched (false on non-match). Within reverify grace (default 120s) returns matched:true, score 1.0, reason 'within reverify grace window'. When attempts already >= max: matched false, blocked true, reason 'maximum face verification attempts reached (n/max)'._

**Endpoint-specific errors**
- 403: `This feature is currently restricted for your account | This feature is temporarily unavailable platform-wide | This feature is temporarily unavailable for your role` - RequireFeatureAccess(booking_response): feature 'booking_response' is restricted for the user/role/platform. Body also carries restricted:true, feature:"booking_response", source, reason (when set), expires_at (RFC3339) or permanent:true
- 403: `This feature requires identity verification. Please complete KYC verification to access bookings, payments, and communities.` - RequireVerification(standard): solver verification level below 'standard'. Body also carries exploration_mode:true, verification_level, required_level:"standard"
- 403: `Unable to verify account status` - RequireVerification: verification level lookup failed
- 403: `Invalid verification level` - RequireVerification: stored level is not light/standard/full
- 403: `Only solvers can run face match` - role local != solver
- 400: `Invalid booking ID` - :booking_id is not a valid UUID
- 400: `Invalid multipart form data` - not multipart
- 400: `Expected 3-10 frames` - frame count out of range
- 400: `Total frame data exceeds 3MB limit` - sum of sizes > 3MB
- 400: `Frame <i> exceeds 500KB limit` - single frame too large
- 400: `Frame <i> is not a valid JPEG image` - bad magic bytes
- 500: `Failed to read frame | Failed to read frame data` - multipart file read failure
- 404: `Booking not found` - booking row not found (ErrBookingNotFound)
- 400: `solver face match pipeline is not available - please use the legacy challenge flow | booking does not belong to this solver | face verification is blocked for this booking - contact support | face match pipeline: <err> | failed to record verification: <err>` - service errors passed through handleBookingError default

**Side effects:** Increments solver face-verify attempts on pipeline error/non-match; on exhaustion handleFaceVerifyExhausted blocks + cancels booking/session and refunds the seeker; on success UPDATE bookings.solver_face_verified(+_at), mirrors lobby face_verified, WS face-verified notification.
